5204: function jewelryLooseSetVisual(itemId, gemId, shapeId = 'default', mode = 'large') {

5212:   const completionGemPx = itemId === 'pendant' ? 62 : itemId === 'ring' ? 72 : itemId === 'earrings' ? 58 : 76;

5215:   const styleLooseMarkup = (markup, sizePercent = '100%') => {
5216:     if (typeof markup !== 'string' || !markup) return markup;

5221:       return markup.replace('<img ', `<img style="${completionStyle}" `);

5230:     const slotWidth = isSmall ? '21%' : (isCompletion || isShowcaseSmall) ? `${resolvedGemPx}px` : '23%';

5234:     // v0.10.671: store showcase earrings use the same round-top-plate centers as Workshop completion.
5235:     // The mask is scaled with contain inside the earring artwork, so these stage-relative centers remain valid at showcase size.
5236:     const slotTop = isSmall ? '33%' : (isCompletion || isShowcaseSmall) ? '20.5%' : '31%';

5243:     </span>`;

5250:   }

11316: function shuffleEventAttempts(attempts) {
11317:   const shuffled = [...attempts];
11318:   for (let index = shuffled.length - 1; index > 0; index -= 1) {
11319:     const swapIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * (index + 1));
11320:     [shuffled[index], shuffled[swapIndex]] = [shuffled[swapIndex], shuffled[index]];
11321:   }
11322:   return shuffled;
11323: }

19076: function updateShowcaseDetailPricePreview(price, savedPrice, item) {
19077:   if (screen !== 'showcaseDetail' || !item) return false;
19078:   const panel = root.querySelector('.showcase-detail-panel');
19079:   if (!panel) return false;
19080:   const normalizedPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(price, item.recommendedPrice || savedPrice || 1000);
19081:   const normalizedSavedPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(savedPrice, item.recommendedPrice || normalizedPrice);
19082:   const priceStatus = sellingPriceStatus(item, normalizedPrice);
19083:   const expectedProfit = normalizedPrice - Math.max(0, Number(item.cost) || 0);
19084:   const priceValue = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-value]');
19085:   const expectedProfitValue = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-expected-profit]');
19086:   const priceStatusValue = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-status]');
19087:   const confirmButton = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-confirm]');
19088:   const downButton = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-down]');
19089:   if (priceValue) priceValue.textContent = yen(normalizedPrice);
19090:   if (expectedProfitValue) expectedProfitValue.textContent = yen(expectedProfit);
19091:   if (priceStatusValue) {
19092:     priceStatusValue.textContent = priceStatus.name;
19093:     priceStatusValue.className = `price-status ${priceStatus.id}`;
19094:   }
19095:   if (confirmButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) confirmButton.disabled = normalizedPrice === normalizedSavedPrice;
19096:   if (downButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) downButton.disabled = normalizedPrice <= 1000;
19097:   return Boolean(priceValue && expectedProfitValue && priceStatusValue && confirmButton && downButton);
19098: }

19100: function adjustShowcaseSellingPrice(button) {
19101:   if (!button || button.disabled || screen !== 'showcaseDetail') return false;
19102:   const branch = button.dataset.branch
19103:     ? state.store.branches?.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.branch)
19104:     : currentStoreBranch();
19105:   const showcaseIndex = Number(button.dataset.showcase);
19106:   const slotIndex = Number(button.dataset.slot);
19107:   const slot = branchShowcases(branch)?.[showcaseIndex]?.slots?.[slotIndex];
19108:   if (!slot) return false;
19109:   const item = state.inventory.jewelry.find((entry) => entry.id === slot.jewelryId);
19110:   if (!item) return false;
19111:   const savedPrice = showcaseSellingPrice(slot, item);
19112:   const currentPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(
19113:     Number.isFinite(Number(screenData.pendingSellingPrice)) ? screenData.pendingSellingPrice : savedPrice,
19114:     item.recommendedPrice || savedPrice
19115:   );
19116:   const delta = Number(button.dataset.delta) < 0 ? -1000 : 1000;
19117:   const nextPrice = Math.max(1000, currentPrice + delta);
19118:   if (nextPrice === currentPrice) return false;
19119:   screenData.pendingSellingPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(nextPrice, item.recommendedPrice || 1000);
19120:   if (!updateShowcaseDetailPricePreview(screenData.pendingSellingPrice, savedPrice, item)) render();
19121:   return true;
19122: }

4243:   const token = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`;
4244:   const toAmount = Math.round(Number(state.game.money) || 0);
4245:   const fromAmount = toAmount - delta;
4246:   const startedAt = performance.now();
4247: 
4248:   moneyFeedback = {
4249:     amount: Math.abs(delta),
4250:     delta,
4251:     direction: delta > 0 ? 'gain' : 'loss',
4252:     fromAmount,
4253:     toAmount,
4254:     displayAmount: fromAmount,
4255:     token,
4256:   };
4257:   playSfx(delta > 0 ? 'sale' : 'coin');
4258: 
4259:   const animateAmount = (now) => {
4260:     if (moneyFeedback?.token !== token) return;
4261:     const elapsed = Math.max(0, now - startedAt);
4262:     // 金額表示が大きくなった後から、現在額→変更後の金額へ切り替える。
4263:     const changeStart = duration * 0.18;
4264:     const changeEnd = duration * 0.72;
4265:     const rawProgress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (elapsed - changeStart) / Math.max(1, changeEnd - changeStart)));
4266:     const easedProgress = rawProgress < 0.5
4267:       ? 4 * rawProgress * rawProgress * rawProgress
4268:       : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * rawProgress + 2, 3) / 2;
4269:     const displayAmount = Math.round(fromAmount + ((toAmount - fromAmount) * easedProgress));
4270:     moneyFeedback.displayAmount = displayAmount;
4271: 
4272:     const valueEl = document.querySelector('.header-money-value');
4273:     if (valueEl) valueEl.textContent = yen(displayAmount);
4274: 
4275:     if (elapsed < duration) {
4276:       moneyAnimationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animateAmount);
4277:     } else {
4278:       moneyFeedback.displayAmount = toAmount;
4279:       const finalEl = document.querySelector('.header-money-value');
4280:       if (finalEl) finalEl.textContent = yen(toAmount);
4281:       moneyAnimationFrame = null;
4282:     }
4283:   };
4284:   moneyAnimationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animateAmount);
4285: 
4286:   moneyFeedbackTimer = setTimeout(() => {
4287:     if (moneyFeedback?.token !== token) return;
4288:     if (moneyAnimationFrame) cancelAnimationFrame(moneyAnimationFrame);
4289:     moneyAnimationFrame = null;
4290:     moneyFeedback = null;
4291:     if (state) render();
4292:   }, duration + 40);
4293: }

4430: function workshopStaffQualityRoll(definition = workshopStaffDefinition()) {
4431:   const premiumChance = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(definition?.premiumChance) || 0));
4432:   const goodChance = Math.max(0, Math.min(1 - premiumChance, Number(definition?.goodChance) || 0));
4433:   const roll = Math.random();
4434:   if (roll < premiumChance) return 'premium';
4435:   if (roll < premiumChance + goodChance) return 'good';
4436:   return 'standard';
4437: }

4443: function workshopStaffCraftCandidates(maxEffectiveMinutes) {
4444:   const maxMinutes = Math.max(0, Number(maxEffectiveMinutes) || 0);
4445:   if (maxMinutes < 120 || !workshopOperating() || !toolUsable('jewelryBench')) return [];
4446:   const storedCount = state.inventory.jewelry.filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length;
4447:   if (storedCount >= state.inventory.capacity) return [];
4448: 
4449:   const candidates = [];
4450:   const plainCandidates = [];
4451:   const looseCandidates = [];
4452:   const itemIds = Object.keys(ITEMS);
4453:   const designIds = Object.keys(DESIGNS);
4454:   const finishIds = Object.keys(FINISHES);
4455:   const metalIds = Object.keys(METALS);
4456:   const availableLooseVariants = [];
4457:   for (const gemId of Object.keys(GEMS)) {
4458:     for (const shapeId of looseShapeIdsForGem(gemId)) {
4459:       if (looseAvailableQuantity(gemId, shapeId) > 0) availableLooseVariants.push({ gemId, shapeId });
4460:     }
4461:   }
4462: 
4463:   for (const item of itemIds) {
4464:     for (const design of designIds) {
4465:       for (const finish of finishIds) {
4466:         const hours = productionHours({ item, design, finish });
4467:         if (hours * 60 > maxMinutes + 1e-9) continue;
4468:         for (const metal of metalIds) {
4469:           const plainDraft = { orderId: null, item, useLoose: false, gem: 'amethyst', looseShape: 'round', metal, design, finish };
4470:           const plainRequirements = materialRequirementsFor(plainDraft);
4471:           if (plainRequirements.enoughMetal) plainCandidates.push({ draft: plainDraft, hours, requirements: plainRequirements, usesLoose: false });
4472:           for (const variant of availableLooseVariants) {
4473:             const looseDraft = { orderId: null, item, useLoose: true, gem: variant.gemId, looseShape: variant.shapeId, metal, design, finish };
4474:             const looseRequirements = materialRequirementsFor(looseDraft);
4475:             if (looseRequirements.enoughMetal && looseRequirements.enoughLoose) {
4476:               looseCandidates.push({ draft: looseDraft, hours, requirements: looseRequirements, usesLoose: true });
4477:             }
4478:           }
4479:         }
4480:       }
4481:     }
4482:   }
4483: 
4484:   if (looseCandidates.length && plainCandidates.length) {
4485:     const preferLoose = Math.random() < 0.7;
4486:     candidates.push(...(preferLoose ? looseCandidates : plainCandidates));
4487:   } else candidates.push(...looseCandidates, ...plainCandidates);
4488:   return candidates;
4489: }
4490: 
4491: function workshopStaffCraftOne(maxEffectiveMinutes, definition = workshopStaffDefinition()) {
4492:   const candidates = workshopStaffCraftCandidates(maxEffectiveMinutes);
4493:   if (!candidates.length) return null;
4494:   const selected = randomFrom(candidates);
4495:   if (!selected) return null;
4496:   const { draft, hours, requirements } = selected;
4497:   if (draft.useLoose === true) adjustLooseInventory(draft.gem, draft.looseShape, -requirements.requiredLooseQuantity);
4498:   state.inventory.metals[draft.metal] = roundedMetalWeight(requirements.ownedMetalWeight - requirements.requiredMetalWeight);
4499:   const quality = workshopStaffQualityRoll(definition);
4500:   const staffArtisanLevel = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, 2 + (Math.max(1, Number(definition?.level) || 1) * 3)));
4501:   const craftsmanship = craftProductionProfile(draft, { artisanLevel: staffArtisanLevel });
4502:   const jewelry = {
4503:     id: uid(),
4504:     ...draft,
4505:     name: itemName(draft),
4506:     quality,
4507:     cost: productionCost(draft),
4508:     recommendedPrice: craftsmanshipRecommendedPrice(draft, quality, craftsmanship),
4509:     ...craftsmanshipSnapshot(craftsmanship),
4510:     xp: 0,
4511:     status: 'stored',
4512:     createdDay: state.game.day,
4513:     madeBy: 'workshopStaff',
4514:   };
4515:   state.inventory.jewelry.push(jewelry);
4516:   state.daily.crafted.push(jewelry.id);
4517:   state.daily.workshopStaffCrafted = Array.isArray(state.daily.workshopStaffCrafted) ? state.daily.workshopStaffCrafted : [];
4518:   const summary = { id: jewelry.id, name: jewelry.name, quality, hours };
4519:   state.daily.workshopStaffCrafted.push(summary);
4520:   const staff = workshopStaffState();
4521:   staff.craftedToday.push(summary);
4522:   staff.craftedToday = staff.craftedToday.slice(-20);
4523:   const brokenToolName = checkWorkshopToolFailure();
4524:   if (brokenToolName) addNotification(`${brokenToolName}が故障しました`, '職人スタッフの制作後に故障しました。修理が完了するまで自動制作は止まります。', 'warning');
4525:   return { jewelry, hours, brokenToolName };
4526: }

4528: function processWorkshopStaffElapsedTime(beforeMinutes, afterMinutes) {
4529:   if (!state || workshopStaffHoliday(gameDate())) return 0;
4530:   const staff = workshopStaffState();
4531:   if (!staff.hired || !staff.working || !workshopOperating() || Math.max(0, Number(staff.wageUnpaid) || 0) > 0) return 0;
4532:   const start = Math.max(WORKSHOP_STAFF_SHIFT_START_MINUTES, Number(beforeMinutes) || 0);
4533:   const end = Math.min(WORKSHOP_STAFF_SHIFT_END_MINUTES, Number(afterMinutes) || 0);
4534:   const elapsed = Math.max(0, end - start);
4535:   if (!elapsed) return 0;
4536:   staff.workedMinutesToday += elapsed;
4537:   if (!toolUsable('jewelryBench')) return 0;
4538:   const definition = workshopStaffDefinition(staff);
4539:   staff.workMinutesBank += elapsed * Math.max(0.1, Number(definition.speedMultiplier) || 1);
4540:   let crafted = 0;
4541:   let safety = 0;
4542:   while (staff.workMinutesBank >= 120 && safety < 12) {
4543:     safety += 1;
4544:     const result = workshopStaffCraftOne(staff.workMinutesBank, definition);
4545:     if (!result) break;
4546:     staff.workMinutesBank = Math.max(0, staff.workMinutesBank - (result.hours * 60));
4547:     crafted += 1;
4548:     if (result.brokenToolName || !toolUsable('jewelryBench')) break;
4549:   }
4550:   staff.workMinutesBank = Math.round(staff.workMinutesBank * 10) / 10;
4551:   return crafted;
4552: }

4554: function settleWorkshopStaffDay() {

4591:   if (leveledUp) {

4593:   }
4594:   return {
4595:     worked: true,
4596:     productive: true,
4597:     level: afterDefinition.level,
4598:     levelLabel: afterDefinition.label,
4599:     workDays: staff.workDays,
4600:     wage,
4601:     paidWage: wageResult.paid,
4602:     unpaidWage: wageResult.unpaid,
4603:     workedMinutes,
4604:     crafted: craftedRows.length,
4605:     items: structuredClone(craftedRows),
4606:     leveledUp,
4607:   };
4608: }

4852: function showcaseLocationForJewelry(itemId, branch = null) {
4853:   const branches = branch
4854:     ? [branch]
4855:     : (Array.isArray(state?.store?.branches) ? state.store.branches : []);
4856:   for (const candidateBranch of branches) {
4857:     const showcases = branchShowcases(candidateBranch);
4858:     for (let showcaseIndex = 0; showcaseIndex < showcases.length; showcaseIndex += 1) {
4859:       const showcase = showcases[showcaseIndex];
4860:       const slotIndex = (showcase?.slots || []).findIndex((entry) => entry?.jewelryId === itemId);
4861:       if (slotIndex >= 0) {
4862:         return { branch: candidateBranch, showcaseIndex, slotIndex, slot: showcase.slots[slotIndex] };
4863:       }
4864:     }
4865:   }
4866:   if (!branch && (!state?.store?.branches || state.store.branches.length === 0)) {
4867:     const showcases = branchShowcases(null);
4868:     for (let showcaseIndex = 0; showcaseIndex < showcases.length; showcaseIndex += 1) {
4869:       const slotIndex = (showcases[showcaseIndex]?.slots || []).findIndex((entry) => entry?.jewelryId === itemId);
4870:       if (slotIndex >= 0) return { branch: null, showcaseIndex, slotIndex, slot: showcases[showcaseIndex].slots[slotIndex] };
4871:     }
4872:   }
4873:   return null;
4874: }

4998: function syncStoreLevel(branch = currentStoreBranch()) {
4999:   if (branch) {
5000:     branch.level = storeLevel(branch);
5001:     branch.peakLevel = Math.max(branch.level, Math.floor(Number(branch.peakLevel) || branch.level));
5002:     branch.rating = storeRating(branch);

5004:     state.store.rating = branch.rating;
5005:     return branch.level;

5012: function addStoreProgress({ branchNumber = state?.store?.branchNumber || 1, rating = 0, sale = false, orderDelivery = false, revenue = 0, serviceSuccess = false } = {}) {
5013:   const branch = storeBranchByNumber(branchNumber);
5014:   if (!branch) return null;
5015:   let ratingDelta = Math.round(Number(rating) || 0);
5016:   if (sale) {
5017:     branch.salesCount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(branch.salesCount) || 0)) + 1;
5018:     branch.totalRevenue = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(branch.totalRevenue) || 0)) + Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(revenue) || 0));
5019:     if (serviceSuccess) branch.serviceSuccesses = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(branch.serviceSuccesses) || 0)) + 1;
5020:     if (branch.salesCount % 5 === 0) ratingDelta += 1;
5021:   }
5022:   if (orderDelivery) branch.orderDeliveries = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(branch.orderDeliveries) || 0)) + 1;
5023:   branch.rating = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, storeRating(branch) + ratingDelta));
5024:   syncStoreLevel(branch);
5025:   return branch;
5026: }

5028: function upgradeStoreLevel(branch = currentStoreBranch()) {
5029:   const status = storeUpgradeStatus(branch);
5030:   if (!branch || !status.requirement) return showToast('店舗は最大レベルです。');
5031:   if (!status.complete) return showToast('店舗改装の条件を満たしていません。', 'error');
5032:   if (status.cost > 0) {
5033:     state.game.money -= status.cost;
5034:     startMoneyFeedback(-status.cost);
5035:     addFinance(`${storeBranchLabel(branch.number)}を店舗レベル${status.requirement.level}へ改装`, 0, status.cost);
5036:     branch.paidThroughLevel = Math.max(Number(branch.paidThroughLevel) || 1, status.requirement.level);
5037:   }
5038:   branch.level = status.requirement.level;
5039:   branch.peakLevel = Math.max(Number(branch.peakLevel) || 1, branch.level);
5040:   syncStoreLevel(branch);
5041:   addNotification('店舗レベルが上がりました', `${storeBranchLabel(branch.number)}が店舗レベル${branch.level}になりました。`);
5042:   saveGame();
5043:   showToast(`店舗レベル${branch.level}になりました。`, 'info', false);
5044:   render();
5045: }

5114: function okachimachiFacilityAvailability(id, date = gameDate(), minutes = state?.game?.minutes ?? 9 * 60) {
5115:   if (!facilityUnlocked(id)) {
5116:     return { open: false, status: '未解放', reason: 'この施設はまだ利用できません。' };
5117:   }
5118: 
5119:   if (id === 'glab') {
5120:     if (glabAnnualHoliday(date)) {
5121:       return { open: false, status: '休業', reason: 'g-Lab.は12月31日、1月1日、1月2日は休業です。' };
5122:     }
5123:   } else {
5124:     const holidayName = japaneseHolidayName(date);
5125:     if (date.getDay() === 0 || date.getDay() === 6 || holidayName) {
5126:       return { open: false, status: '休業', reason: holidayName ? `本日は${holidayName}のため休業です。` : '本日は土日のため休業です。' };
5127:     }
5128:   }
5129: 
5130:   if (minutes >= OKACHIMACHI_CLOSE_MINUTES) {
5131:     return { open: false, status: '営業時間外', reason: '御徒町の施設を利用できるのは18:00までです。' };
5132:   }
5133: 
5134:   return { open: true, status: '営業中', reason: '' };
5135: }

5204: function jewelryLooseSetVisual(itemId, gemId, shapeId = 'default', mode = 'large') {
5205:   const gem = GEMS[gemId];
5206:   if (!gem) return '';
5207:   const isSmall = mode === 'small';
5208:   const isCompletion = mode === 'completion';
5209:   const isShowcaseSmall = mode === 'showcaseSmall';
5210:   const looseClass = (isSmall || isShowcaseSmall) ? 'small-jewelry-loose' : 'jewelry-loose-preview';
5211:   const wrapperClass = (isSmall || isShowcaseSmall) ? 'jewelry-loose-set small' : 'jewelry-loose-set';
5212:   const completionGemPx = itemId === 'pendant' ? 62 : itemId === 'ring' ? 72 : itemId === 'earrings' ? 58 : 76;
5213:   const showcaseSmallGemPx = itemId === 'pendant' ? 16 : itemId === 'ring' ? 18 : itemId === 'earrings' ? 15 : 19;
5214:   const resolvedGemPx = isCompletion ? completionGemPx : isShowcaseSmall ? showcaseSmallGemPx : 0;
5215:   const styleLooseMarkup = (markup, sizePercent = '100%') => {
5216:     if (typeof markup !== 'string' || !markup) return markup;
5217:     if (markup.startsWith('<img ')) {
5218:       const completionStyle = (isCompletion || isShowcaseSmall)
5219:         ? `display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-width:${resolvedGemPx}px;max-height:${resolvedGemPx}px;object-fit:contain;position:relative;z-index:5;pointer-events:none;`
5220:         : `display:block;width:${sizePercent};height:auto;max-width:none;object-fit:contain;position:relative;z-index:5;pointer-events:none;`;
5221:       return markup.replace('<img ', `<img style="${completionStyle}" `);
5222:     }
5223:     const renderSize = (isCompletion || isShowcaseSmall) ? '100%' : sizePercent;
5224:     return `<span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:${renderSize};height:${renderSize};position:relative;z-index:5;pointer-events:none;">${markup}</span>`;
5225:   };
5226:   const looseSize = isSmall ? '112%' : (isCompletion || isShowcaseSmall) ? '100%' : '120%';
5227:   const single = styleLooseMarkup(looseVisual(gemId, looseClass, '', shapeId), looseSize);
5228:   if (itemId === 'earrings') {
5229:     const pair = styleLooseMarkup(looseVisual(gemId, looseClass, '', shapeId), looseSize);
5230:     const slotWidth = isSmall ? '21%' : (isCompletion || isShowcaseSmall) ? `${resolvedGemPx}px` : '23%';
5231:     // v0.10.646: completion earrings are positioned against the actual earring-art stage,
5232:     // so each loose sits on the center of the round top plate instead of the full preview width.
5233:     // v0.10.672: showcaseSmall ring/pendant now use centered small-artwork stages so their stone placement matches Workshop completion proportions.
5234:     // v0.10.671: store showcase earrings use the same round-top-plate centers as Workshop completion.
5235:     // The mask is scaled with contain inside the earring artwork, so these stage-relative centers remain valid at showcase size.
5236:     const slotTop = isSmall ? '33%' : (isCompletion || isShowcaseSmall) ? '20.5%' : '31%';
5237:     const leftX = isSmall ? '28.5%' : (isCompletion || isShowcaseSmall) ? '24.8%' : '29%';
5238:     const rightX = isSmall ? '71.5%' : (isCompletion || isShowcaseSmall) ? '74.7%' : '71%';

5241:       <span class="center-gem earring-left" style="position:absolute;left:${leftX};top:${slotTop};width:${slotWidth};max-width:${maxWidthPx}px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:5;pointer-events:none;">${single}</span>

5243:     </span>`;
5244:   }
5245:   if (isShowcaseSmall && (itemId === 'ring' || itemId === 'pendant')) {
5246:     const stageWidth = itemId === 'pendant' ? 40 : 54;
5247:     const stageHeight = itemId === 'pendant' ? 58 : 54;
5248:     const centerTop = itemId === 'pendant' ? '66%' : '57%';
5249:     return `<span class="${wrapperClass} item-${itemId}" aria-hidden="true" style="position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:${stageWidth}px;height:${stageHeight}px;display:block;pointer-events:none;z-index:3;overflow:visible;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);"><span class="center-gem" style="position:absolute;left:50%;top:${centerTop};width:${resolvedGemPx}px;max-width:${resolvedGemPx}px;min-width:0;display:grid;place-items:center;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:5;pointer-events:none;">${single}</span></span>`;
5250:   }
5251:   const centerStyle = (isCompletion || isShowcaseSmall)
5252:     ? ` style="width:${resolvedGemPx}px;max-width:${resolvedGemPx}px;min-width:0;"`
5253:     : '';
5254:   return `<span class="${wrapperClass} item-${itemId}" aria-hidden="true"><span class="center-gem"${centerStyle}>${single}</span></span>`;

5324: function robberyItemsInBranch(branch) {
5325:   if (!branch) return [];
5326:   const found = [];
5327:   const seen = new Set();
5328:   for (const showcase of branchShowcases(branch)) {
5329:     for (const slot of showcase?.slots || []) {
5330:       if (!slot?.jewelryId || seen.has(slot.jewelryId)) continue;
5331:       const item = state.inventory.jewelry.find((entry) => entry.id === slot.jewelryId && entry.status !== 'sold');
5332:       if (!item) continue;
5333:       seen.add(item.id);
5334:       found.push({ item, sellingPrice: showcaseSellingPrice(slot, item) });
5335:     }
5336:   }
5337:   return found;
5338: }

5344: function maybeTriggerRobberyEvent(randomValue = Math.random()) {
5345:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) return false;
5346:   const robbery = robberyEventState();
5347:   if (robbery.pendingReport) return null;
5348:   const candidates = contractedStoreBranches()
5349:     .map((branch) => ({ branch, products: robberyItemsInBranch(branch) }))
5350:     .filter((entry) => entry.products.length > 0);
5351:   const robberyChance = hasBokuto() ? ROBBERY_DAILY_CHANCE * WOOD_SWORD_ROBBERY_MULTIPLIER : ROBBERY_DAILY_CHANCE;
5352:   if (!candidates.length || Number(randomValue) >= robberyChance) return null;
5353: 
5354:   const target = randomFrom(candidates, candidates[0]);
5355:   if (!target?.branch || !target.products.length) return null;
5356:   const branchNumber = Math.max(1, Number(target.branch.number) || 1);
5357:   const branchLabel = storeBranchLabel(branchNumber);
5358:   const lossAmount = target.products.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + Math.max(0, Number(entry.sellingPrice) || 0), 0);
5359:   const incidentDay = Math.max(1, Number(state.game.day) - 1);
5360:   const report = {
5361:     id: `robbery-${state.game.day}-${uid()}`,
5362:     incidentDay,
5363:     reportDay: state.game.day,
5364:     branchId: target.branch.id || `branch-${branchNumber}`,
5365:     branchNumber,
5366:     branchLabel,
5367:     itemCount: target.products.length,
5368:     lossAmount: Math.round(lossAmount),
5369:     itemNames: target.products.map(({ item }) => item.name),
5370:     stage: 'waitingMorning',
5371:   };
5372: 
5373:   for (const { item, sellingPrice } of target.products) {
5374:     item.stolenDay = state.game.day;
5375:     item.stolenBranchNumber = branchNumber;
5376:     item.stolenLossValue = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(sellingPrice) || 0));
5377:     removeJewelry(item.id);
5378:   }
5379:   mirrorCurrentStoreDisplay(currentStoreBranch());
5380: 
5381:   robbery.lastTriggeredDay = state.game.day;
5382:   robbery.pendingReport = report;
5383:   robbery.history.push(structuredClone(report));
5384:   robbery.history = robbery.history.slice(-ROBBERY_HISTORY_LIMIT);
5385:   addNotification(
5386:     '強盗事件が発生しました',
5387:     `${branchLabel}に強盗が入り、完成品${report.itemCount}点が盗まれました。損失額は${yen(report.lossAmount)}です。`,
5388:     'warning',
5389:   );
5390:   return report;
5391: }

5421: function craftRelevantToolWeights(draft = {}) {

5464:   if (finishId.includes('mirror')) {

5494: function processingKnowledgeKnownMatching(pattern) {
5495:   const records = Array.isArray(state?.workshop?.processingKnowledge) ? state.workshop.processingKnowledge : [];
5496:   return records.some((record) => {
5497:     const id = String(record?.id || record || '');
5498:     const document = PROCESSING_KNOWLEDGE[id];
5499:     if (!document) return false;
5500:     const haystack = [id, document.shortTitle, document.title, document.category].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
5501:     return pattern.test(haystack);
5502:   });

5505: function craftKnowledgeSupport(draft = {}) {
5506:   const labels = [];
5507:   let scoreBonus = 0;
5508:   const hasSizing = processingKnowledgeKnownMatching(/サイズ直し/i);
5509:   const hasSoldering = processingKnowledgeKnownMatching(/ロー付け|ろう付け|solder/i);
5510:   const hasFinishing = processingKnowledgeKnownMatching(/仕上げ|finishing/i);
5511:   const hasSetting = processingKnowledgeKnownMatching(/石留め|stone\s*setting/i);
5512: 
5513:   if (draft.item === 'ring' && hasSizing) {
5514:     labels.push('サイズ直し');
5515:     scoreBonus += 1.0;
5516:   }
5517:   if (hasSoldering) {
5518:     labels.push('ロー付け');
5519:     scoreBonus += toolUsable('torch') ? 3.0 : 1.0;
5520:   }
5521:   if (hasFinishing) {
5522:     labels.push('仕上げ');
5523:     scoreBonus += (toolUsable('buffer') || toolUsable('rotaryTool')) ? 3.0 : 1.0;
5524:   }
5525:   if (draft.useLoose !== false && hasSetting) {
5526:     labels.push('石留め');
5527:     scoreBonus += (toolUsable('graver') || toolUsable('magnifier')) ? 4.0 : 1.5;
5528:   }
5529:   return { labels: [...new Set(labels)], scoreBonus: Math.min(10, scoreBonus), hasSizing, hasSoldering, hasFinishing, hasSetting };
5530: }
5531: 
5532: function craftProductionTags(draft = {}, knowledge = craftKnowledgeSupport(draft)) {
5533:   const tags = [];
5534:   const allUsable = (...toolIds) => toolIds.every((toolId) => toolUsable(toolId));
5535:   if (allUsable('file', 'rotaryTool', 'dividers')) tags.push('精密成形');
5536:   if (knowledge.hasSoldering && allUsable('torch', 'file')) tags.push('安定ロー付け');
5537:   if (draft.useLoose !== false && knowledge.hasSetting && allUsable('graver', 'magnifier', 'engravingBlock')) tags.push('精密石留め');
5538:   if (knowledge.hasFinishing && allUsable('rotaryTool', 'buffer', 'ultrasonicCleaner')) tags.push('プロ仕上げ');
5539:   if (allUsable('magnifier', 'loupe')) tags.push('高精度検品');
5540:   const finishId = String(draft.finish || '');
5541:   if ((finishId.includes('Decorated') || finishId === 'decorated') && allUsable('graver', 'engravingBlock', 'milgrainTool')) tags.push('意匠加工');
5542:   if (draft.design === 'modern' && allUsable('computer', 'cadSoftware', 'printer3d')) tags.push('CAD設計');
5543:   return tags;
5544: }
5545: 
5546: function craftProductionProfile(draft = {}, options = {}) {
5547:   const toolWeights = craftRelevantToolWeights(draft);
5548:   const totalWeight = [...toolWeights.values()].reduce((total, weight) => total + weight, 0);
5549:   let usableWeight = 0;
5550:   let usableCount = 0;
5551:   let ownedCount = 0;
5552:   const missing = [];
5553:   for (const [toolId, weight] of toolWeights.entries()) {
5554:     if (toolOwned(toolId)) ownedCount += 1;
5555:     if (toolUsable(toolId)) {
5556:       usableWeight += weight;
5557:       usableCount += 1;
5558:     } else {
5559:       missing.push({ toolId, weight, name: WORKSHOP_TOOLS[toolId]?.name || toolId, owned: toolOwned(toolId) });
5560:     }
5561:   }
5562:   missing.sort((a, b) => b.weight - a.weight || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'ja'));
5563:   const toolRatio = totalWeight > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, usableWeight / totalWeight)) : 1;
5564:   const knowledge = craftKnowledgeSupport(draft);
5565:   const tags = craftProductionTags(draft, knowledge);
5566:   const artisanLevel = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, Math.floor(Number(options.artisanLevel ?? state?.artisan?.level) || 1)));
5567: 
5568:   // 工具の有無を価格へ強く反映。設備不足0.78倍～十分な設備1.25倍。
5569:   const equipmentMultiplier = 0.78 + (toolRatio * 0.47);
5570:   // 職人レベルは0.90～1.10倍。設備だけで熟練差を完全には埋められない。
5571:   const artisanMultiplier = 0.90 + ((artisanLevel - 1) / 19) * 0.20;
5572:   // 加工知識は該当工程で最大+10%。工具と組み合わさると評価が高くなる。
5573:   const knowledgeMultiplier = 1 + (knowledge.scoreBonus * 0.01);
5574:   // 工具セットが成立した場合は相乗効果。最大+7.5%。
5575:   const setMultiplier = 1 + Math.min(0.075, tags.length * 0.015);
5576:   const priceMultiplier = Math.max(0.72, Math.min(1.55, equipmentMultiplier * artisanMultiplier * knowledgeMultiplier * setMultiplier));
5577: 
5578:   const craftsmanshipScore = Math.max(20, Math.min(100, Math.round(
5579:     28
5580:     + ((artisanLevel - 1) / 19) * 28
5581:     + toolRatio * 36
5582:     + Math.min(8, knowledge.scoreBonus)
5583:     + Math.min(5, tags.length)
5584:   )));
5585:   const tier = craftsmanshipScore >= 95 ? '最高級'
5586:     : craftsmanshipScore >= 85 ? '高精度'
5587:       : craftsmanshipScore >= 72 ? '良好'
5588:         : craftsmanshipScore >= 55 ? '標準'
5589:           : '設備不足';
5590: 
5591:   return {
5592:     version: CRAFTSMANSHIP_PROFILE_VERSION,
5593:     artisanLevel,
5594:     craftsmanshipScore,
5595:     tier,
5596:     toolRatio,
5597:     usableToolCount: usableCount,
5598:     ownedToolCount: ownedCount,
5599:     relevantToolCount: toolWeights.size,
5600:     usableWeight,
5601:     totalWeight,
5602:     equipmentMultiplier,
5603:     artisanMultiplier,
5604:     knowledgeMultiplier,
5605:     setMultiplier,
5606:     priceMultiplier,
5607:     knowledgeLabels: knowledge.labels,
5608:     tags,
5609:     missingTools: missing.slice(0, 5),
5610:   };
5611: }
5612: 
5613: function craftsmanshipRecommendedPrice(draft = {}, quality = 'standard', profile = craftProductionProfile(draft)) {
5614:   const basePrice = recommendedPrice({ ...draft, quality });
5615:   const cost = Math.max(0, Number(productionCost(draft)) || 0);
5616:   const adjusted = roundThousand(basePrice * Math.max(0.1, Number(profile?.priceMultiplier) || 1));
5617:   return Math.max(roundThousand(cost * 1.2), adjusted);
5618: }

5620: function craftsmanshipSnapshot(profile = {}) {

5624:     craftsmanshipTier: String(profile.tier || ''),
5625:     craftsmanshipPriceMultiplier: Math.round((Number(profile.priceMultiplier) || 1) * 1000) / 1000,
5626:     craftsmanshipToolRatio: Math.round((Number(profile.toolRatio) || 0) * 1000) / 1000,
5627:     craftsmanshipUsableTools: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(profile.usableToolCount) || 0)),
5628:     craftsmanshipRelevantTools: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(profile.relevantToolCount) || 0)),
5629:     craftsmanshipTags: Array.isArray(profile.tags) ? profile.tags.slice(0, 12) : [],
5630:     craftsmanshipKnowledge: Array.isArray(profile.knowledgeLabels) ? profile.knowledgeLabels.slice(0, 12) : [],
5631:   };

5634: function workshopToolUnlockConditionsMet(tool) {
5635:   const unlock = tool?.unlock;
5636:   if (!unlock?.enabled) return false;
5637: 
5638:   const requiredTools = Array.isArray(unlock.requiresOwned) ? unlock.requiresOwned : [];
5639:   if (requiredTools.some((toolId) => !toolOwned(toolId))) return false;
5640: 
5641:   const minimumArtisanLevel = Math.max(0, Number(unlock.minArtisanLevel) || 0);
5642:   if (minimumArtisanLevel && Number(state?.artisan?.level || 0) < minimumArtisanLevel) return false;
5643: 
5644:   const minimumWorkshopLevel = Math.max(0, Number(unlock.minWorkshopLevel) || 0);
5645:   if (minimumWorkshopLevel && workshopLevel() < minimumWorkshopLevel) return false;
5646: 
5647:   const minimumMiningFinds = Math.max(0, Number(unlock.minMiningFinds) || 0);
5648:   if (minimumMiningFinds && Number(state?.miningProgress?.successfulFinds || 0) < minimumMiningFinds) return false;
5649: 
5650:   const minimumCrafted = Math.max(0, Number(unlock.minCrafted) || 0);
5651:   const craftedCount = Number(state?.daily?.crafted?.length || 0)
5652:     + Number(state?.inventory?.jewelry?.length || 0)
5653:     + Number(state?.store?.salesCount || 0);
5654:   if (minimumCrafted && craftedCount < minimumCrafted) return false;
5655: 
5656:   const minimumStores = Math.max(0, Number(unlock.minStores) || 0);
5657:   const storeCount = Array.isArray(state?.store?.branches) ? state.store.branches.length : Number(Boolean(state?.store?.rented));
5658:   if (minimumStores && storeCount < minimumStores) return false;
5659: 
5660:   const requiredFlag = String(unlock.requiredFlag || '');
5661:   if (requiredFlag && !state?.progressFlags?.[requiredFlag]) return false;
5662: 
5663:   return true;
5664: }

5685: function workshopToolFailureDueDay(toolId, fromDay = state.game.day) {
5686:   const definition = WORKSHOP_TOOLS[toolId];
5687:   if (!definition?.breakable) return null;
5688:   const prices = Object.values(WORKSHOP_TOOLS).filter((tool) => tool.breakable && tool.price > 0).map((tool) => tool.price);
5689:   const minimumPrice = Math.min(...prices);
5690:   const maximumPrice = Math.max(...prices);
5691:   const ratio = maximumPrice > minimumPrice ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (definition.price - minimumPrice) / (maximumPrice - minimumPrice))) : 0.5;
5692:   const minimumDays = Math.round(90 + ratio * 45);
5693:   const maximumDays = Math.round(120 + ratio * 60);
5694:   return Math.max(1, Number(fromDay) || state.game.day) + minimumDays + Math.floor(Math.random() * (maximumDays - minimumDays + 1));
5695: }

5736: function workshopUpgradeStatus() {
5737:   const current = workshopLevel();
5738:   const requirement = current >= 20 ? null : workshopLevelRequirement(current + 1);
5739:   if (!requirement) return { current, requirement: null, complete: true, conditions: [], cost: 0 };
5740:   const missingTools = cumulativeWorkshopRequiredTools(requirement.level).filter((id) => !toolUsable(id));
5741:   const activeHours = Math.max(0, Number(state?.workshop?.activeHours) || 0);
5742:   const quality = workshopQualityPoints();
5743:   const alreadyPaid = Math.max(1, Number(state?.workshop?.paidThroughLevel) || 1) >= requirement.level;
5744:   const cost = alreadyPaid ? 0 : requirement.cost;
5745:   const conditions = [
5746:     { id: 'hours', label: '累計工房稼働実績', current: activeHours, target: requirement.hours, suffix: '時間', met: activeHours >= requirement.hours },
5747:     { id: 'quality', label: '工房評価', current: quality, target: requirement.quality, suffix: '', met: quality >= requirement.quality },
5748:     { id: 'tools', label: '必須工具・設備', current: missingTools.length ? `不足 ${missingTools.length}点` : '使用可能', target: 'すべて', suffix: '', met: missingTools.length === 0, missingTools },
5749:   ];
5750:   return { current, requirement, conditions, cost, alreadyPaid, missingTools, complete: conditions.every((condition) => condition.met) && state.game.money >= cost && workshopOperating() };
5751: }

5779: function workshopToolImageSrc(tool, versioned = true) {
5780:   const source = String(tool?.image || './assets/images/tools/placeholder.svg');

5791: function workshopToolImageMarkup(tool, { className = 'equipment-icon equipment-image-icon', alt = '', decorative = true } = {}) {
5792:   const source = workshopToolImageSrc(tool);
5793:   const fallbackSource = workshopToolImageSrc(tool, false);
5794:   const fallbackSymbol = esc(tool?.symbol || '⚒');
5795:   return `<span class="${esc(className)}" data-workshop-tool-image-shell>
5796:     <img src="${esc(source)}" data-workshop-tool-image data-fallback-src="${esc(fallbackSource)}" data-tool-id="${esc(tool?.id || '')}" alt="${decorative ? '' : esc(alt || `${tool?.name || '工具'}の画像`)}" decoding="async">
5797:     <span class="workshop-tool-image-fallback" aria-hidden="true">${fallbackSymbol}</span>
5798:   </span>`;
5799: }
5800: 
5801: async function recoverWorkshopToolImage(image) {
5802:   if (!(image instanceof HTMLImageElement) || image.dataset.recoveryRunning === '1') return;
5803:   image.dataset.recoveryRunning = '1';
5804:   const shell = image.closest('[data-workshop-tool-image-shell]');
5805:   shell?.classList.remove('has-image-error');
5806:   const fallbackSource = String(image.dataset.fallbackSrc || '');
5807:   const candidates = [];
5808:   if (fallbackSource) {
5809:     candidates.push(fallbackSource);
5810:     try {
5811:       const freshUrl = new URL(fallbackSource, document.baseURI);
5812:       freshUrl.searchParams.set('tool-image-recovery', `${VERSION}-${Date.now()}`);
5813:       candidates.push(freshUrl.href);
5814:     } catch (_) {}
5815:   }
5816:   for (const candidate of [...new Set(candidates.filter(Boolean))]) {
5817:     try {
5818:       const response = await fetch(candidate, { cache: 'reload', credentials: 'same-origin' });
5819:       if (!response.ok) continue;
5820:       const blob = await response.blob();
5821:       if (!String(blob.type || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('image/')) continue;
5822:       const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
5823:       image.addEventListener('load', () => URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl), { once: true });
5824:       image.src = objectUrl;
5825:       image.dataset.recovered = '1';
5826:       image.dataset.recoveryRunning = '0';
5827:       shell?.classList.remove('has-image-error');
5828:       return;
5829:     } catch (_) {}
5830:   }
5831:   image.dataset.recoveryRunning = '0';
5832:   shell?.classList.add('has-image-error');
5833: }

5850: function checkWorkshopToolFailure() {

5945: function canSleepNow() {
5946:   if (!state) return false;
5947:   if (winterColdTextActive()) return true;
5948:   // v0.10.552: 誕生日当日は時刻に関係なく「寝る」から誕生日イベントへ入れる。
5949:   if (birthdaySleepAvailableToday()) return true;
5950:   // 宇宙滞在中は食事へ移動できない。19時以降、または空腹度0なら必ず就寝できる。
5951:   // この判定を地球上の食事可否から完全に分離し、宇宙での進行不能を防ぐ。
5952:   if (isAlienAbducted()) return Number(state.game.minutes) >= SLEEP_UNLOCK_MINUTES || hungerLocked();
5953:   if (Number(state.game.minutes) >= SLEEP_UNLOCK_MINUTES) return true;
5954:   return hungerLocked() && !hasSelectableRegularMeal();

5967: function spendMinutes(minutes, { consumeHunger = true } = {}) {
5968:   const elapsedMinutes = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(minutes) || 0));
5969:   const hungerCost = consumeHunger ? Math.floor(elapsedMinutes / 60) : 0;
5970:   const before = hungerLevel();
5971:   const beforeMinutes = state.game.minutes;
5972:   state.game.minutes = Math.min(DAY_END_MINUTES, state.game.minutes + elapsedMinutes);
5973:   const storeOpenStart = Math.max(beforeMinutes, STORE_OPEN_MINUTES);
5974:   const storeOpenEnd = Math.min(state.game.minutes, STORE_CLOSE_MINUTES);
5975:   const storeElapsed = Math.max(0, storeOpenEnd - storeOpenStart);
5976:   if (storeElapsed > 0) contractedStoreBranches().filter((branch) => storeBranchOperating(branch)).forEach((branch) => { branch.openMinutesToday = Math.max(0, Number(branch.openMinutesToday) || 0) + storeElapsed; });
5977:   processWorkshopStaffElapsedTime(beforeMinutes, state.game.minutes);
5978:   if (beforeMinutes < STORE_CLOSE_MINUTES && state.game.minutes >= STORE_CLOSE_MINUTES) closeVisitingCustomersAtStoreClosing();
5979:   state.wellbeing.hunger = Math.max(0, before - hungerCost);
5980:   // v0.10.552: 現行ゲームでは空腹度が行動可能量を兼ねる。
5981:   // 誕生日当日に空腹度が1以下へ到達したら、現在の行動結果を反映した後で強制休息へ移る。
5982:   if (consumeHunger && birthdaySleepAvailableToday() && state.wellbeing.hunger <= 1) {
5983:     const birthdayEvent = birthdaySleepEventState();
5984:     birthdayEvent.restPending = true;
5985:     birthdayEvent.triggerReason = 'energy';
5986:   }
5987: }

6173: }

6230: function calendarSystemEventsForDate(date) {
6231:   if (!(date instanceof Date) || Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return [];
6232:   const key = dateKey(date);
6233:   const events = [];

6241:

6243:     Object.keys(CUSTOMERS)
6244:       .filter((id) => state.customers[id]?.visiting)
6245:       .forEach((id) => events.push(`${CUSTOMERS[id].name}さんが来店中`));
6246:   }

6249:     .filter(([, record]) => record?.status === 'repairing' && Number(record.repairCompleteDay) >= state.game.day)
6250:     .filter(([, record]) => dateKey(gameDateForDay(record.repairCompleteDay)) === key)
6251:     .forEach(([toolId]) => events.push(`${WORKSHOP_TOOLS[toolId]?.name || '工具'}の修理完了`));

6315: function winterColdEventState() {
6316:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
6317:   const saved = state.events.winterColdEvent && typeof state.events.winterColdEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.winterColdEvent)
6318:     ? state.events.winterColdEvent
6319:     : {};
6320:   const validStages = new Set(['idle', 'intro', 'sick', 'completed']);
6321:   const normalizedDaysCompleted = Math.max(0, Math.min(WINTER_COLD_EVENT_DAYS, Math.floor(Number(saved.daysCompleted) || 0)));
6322:   // 旧保存で active=false / stage=sick が残っていても、療養日数が未完了なら体調不良を継続して復旧する。
6323:   const legacySickState = saved.stage === 'sick' && normalizedDaysCompleted < WINTER_COLD_EVENT_DAYS;
6324:   state.events.winterColdEvent = {
6325:     active: Boolean(saved.active) || legacySickState,
6326:     stage: validStages.has(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : 'idle',
6327:     seasonKey: /^\d{4}-\d{4}$/.test(String(saved.seasonKey || '')) ? String(saved.seasonKey) : '',
6328:     lastCompletedSeason: /^\d{4}-\d{4}$/.test(String(saved.lastCompletedSeason || '')) ? String(saved.lastCompletedSeason) : '',
6329:     lastCheckedDate: /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(saved.lastCheckedDate || '')) ? String(saved.lastCheckedDate) : '',
6330:     startDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.startDay) || 0)),
6331:     daysCompleted: normalizedDaysCompleted,
6332:     totalTriggered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)),
6333:     recoveryNoticePending: Boolean(saved.recoveryNoticePending),
6334:   };
6335:   if (!state.events.winterColdEvent.active && !['idle', 'completed'].includes(state.events.winterColdEvent.stage)) {
6336:     state.events.winterColdEvent.stage = 'completed';
6337:   }
6338:   return state.events.winterColdEvent;
6339: }

6887: async function showMorningBrief() {
6888:   if (!morningBriefEl || !state || morningBriefShowing) return;
6889:   cancelWinterColdDuringBlackout({ save: true });
6890:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) {

6892:     repairIllnessPaymentBirthdayOverlapV481({ save: true });
6893:     completeMorningTransition({ save: true });
6894:     if (screen !== 'main') goMain();
6895:     return;
6896:   }
6897:   morningBriefShowing = true;

6899:   const date = gameDate();
6900:   const todayGem = dailyGemForDate(date);
6901:   const coldRecoveryPending = Boolean(winterColdEventState().recoveryNoticePending);
6902:   const events = [...repairMessages, `今日の宝石：${todayGem.name}`, ...currentCalendarEvents()];
6903:   const hasEvents = events.length > 0;

6905:   const morningWeekdays = ['日', '月', '火', '水', '木', '金', '土'];
6906:   const morningDateLabel = `${date.getFullYear()}年${date.getMonth() + 1}月${date.getDate()}日（${morningWeekdays[date.getDay()]}）`;
6907:   morningBriefEl.innerHTML = `
6908:     <section class="morning-brief-card" role="status" aria-live="polite">
6909:       <div class="morning-date-summary">
6910:         <strong>${esc(morningDateLabel)}</strong>
6911:         <span>${state.game.day}日目</span>
6912:         <span>${weatherIcon(state.game.weather)} ${esc(state.game.weather)}</span>
6913:       </div>
6914:       <p class="morning-greeting">おはようございます、${esc(playerName)}</p>
6915:       ${coldRecoveryPending ? '<p class="morning-cold-recovery" data-illness-readable="true">体調が戻った</p>' : ''}
6916:       <div class="morning-events ${hasEvents ? 'has-events' : 'is-empty'}">
6917:         <small>本日の予定・お知らせ</small>
6918:         ${hasEvents
6919:           ? events.map((event) => `<p>${esc(event)}</p>`).join('')
6920:           : ''}
6921:       </div>
6922:       <button type="button" class="primary-button morning-main-button" data-action="morning-main" data-illness-readable="true">メイン画面へ</button>
6923:     </section>`;
6924:   morningBriefEl.classList.remove('persistent');
6925:   morningBriefEl.classList.add('active');
6926: 
6927:   if (repairMessages.length) state.tools.morningMessages = [];
6928:   if (coldRecoveryPending) winterColdEventState().recoveryNoticePending = false;
6929:   if (repairMessages.length || coldRecoveryPending) saveGame();
6930: 
6931:   const displayDuration = events.length > 1
6932:     ? Math.min(6500, 3500 + (events.length - 1) * 650)
6933:     : 3000;
6934:   await wait(displayDuration);
6935:   if (!morningBriefShowing) return;
6936:   morningBriefEl.classList.remove('active');
6937:   await wait(300);
6938:   if (!morningBriefShowing) return;
6939:   finishMorningBriefAndContinue();
6940: }

6942: async function beginNextDay() {
6943:   // 日次結果画面で朝表示フラグが異常に残っていても、翌日へ進めるように復旧する。
6944:   cancelWinterColdDuringBlackout();
6945:   repairIllnessBirthdayDeadlock();
6946:   repairIllnessPaymentBirthdayOverlapV481();
6947:   repairLegacyTransientEventDeadlocksV462();
6948:   repairMorningOverlapDeadlockV475();
6949:   if (morningBriefShowing) clearMorningBrief();
6950:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) {
6951:     suppressBirthdaySleepEventForIllness();
6952:     suppressAllTransientEventsForIllness();
6953:   }
6954:   if (nextDayTransitionPromise) return nextDayTransitionPromise;
6955: 
6956:   nextDayTransitionPromise = (async () => {
6957:     const waitStartedAt = Date.now();
6958:     while (sleepTransitioning && Date.now() - waitStartedAt < 5000) await wait(50);
6959:     if (sleepTransitioning) {
6960:       console.warn('就寝処理のロックを解除して翌日処理を継続します。');
6961:       sleepTransitioning = false;
6962:     }
6963: 
6964:     sleepTransitioning = true;
6965:     try {
6966:       sleepCurtainEl?.classList.add('next-day-blackout', 'active');
6967:       playSfx('sleep', { gain: .9 });
6968:       await wait(2000);
6969:       const recoveredFromCold = finishWinterColdRecoveryAfterNight();
6970:       const cancelledForBlackout = cancelWinterColdDuringBlackout();
6971:       if (recoveredFromCold || cancelledForBlackout) await saveGame();
6972:       const stillSick = illnessEventSuppressionActive();
6973:       const returningFromSpace = alienAbductionEventState().active && alienAbductionEventState().stage === 'returnPending';
6974:       let coldStarted = false;
6975:       let bluesJukeStarted = false;
6976:       let hospitalStarted = false;
6977:       if (returningFromSpace) {
6978:         grantAlienBodyChip();
6979:         setScreen('alienReturnEvent', {}, false);
6980:       } else if (stillSick) {
6981:         clearMorningBrief();
6982:         repairIllnessPaymentBirthdayOverlapV481({ save: true });
6983:         completeMorningTransition({ save: true });
6984:         goMain();
6985:       } else {
6986:         const morningEvent = tryRandomNamedEventStarters([
6987:           { id: 'hospital', start: () => maybeStartHospitalEvent() },
6988:           { id: 'bluesJuke', start: () => maybeStartBluesJukeEvent() },
6989:           { id: 'winterCold', start: () => maybeStartWinterColdEvent() },
6990:         ]);
6991:         hospitalStarted = morningEvent === 'hospital';
6992:         bluesJukeStarted = morningEvent === 'bluesJuke';
6993:         coldStarted = morningEvent === 'winterCold';
6994:         if (!morningEvent) goMain();
6995:       }
6996:       await wait(40);
6997:       sleepCurtainEl?.classList.remove('active', 'next-day-blackout');
6998:       if (!bluesJukeStarted && !hospitalStarted) playSfx(returningFromSpace ? 'success' : coldStarted ? 'impact' : stillSick ? 'sleep' : 'alarm', { gain: .92 });
6999:       if (!returningFromSpace && !coldStarted && !stillSick && !bluesJukeStarted && !hospitalStarted) await showMorningBrief();
7000:     } catch (error) {
7001:       console.error('翌日表示復帰エラー', error);
7002:       clearMorningBrief();
7003:       screen = 'main';
7004:       screenData = {};
7005:       navigation = [];
7006:       if (state?.game) state.game.screen = 'main';
7007:       try { await saveGame(); } catch (saveError) { console.error('翌日復帰後の保存エラー', saveError); }
7008:       render();
7009:       try { showToast('翌日へ進みました。競合したイベント表示は安全にスキップしました。', 'warning'); } catch (_) {}
7010:     } finally {
7011:       sleepCurtainEl?.classList.remove('active', 'next-day-blackout');
7012:       sleepTransitioning = false;
7013:     }
7014:   })();
7015: 
7016:   try {
7017:     return await nextDayTransitionPromise;
7018:   } finally {
7019:     nextDayTransitionPromise = null;
7020:   }
7021: }

7023: function gameDayOfYear(date) {
7024:   const start = new Date(date.getFullYear(), 0, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0);
7025:   return Math.floor((date.getTime() - start.getTime()) / 86400000) + 1;
7026: }

7028: function daysInGameYear(year) {
7029:   return new Date(year, 1, 29, 12, 0, 0, 0).getMonth() === 1 ? 366 : 365;
7030: }

7032: function westernUnionEventState() {
7033:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
7034:   const saved = state.events.westernUnionEvent && typeof state.events.westernUnionEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.westernUnionEvent)
7035:     ? state.events.westernUnionEvent
7036:     : {};
7037:   const dialogueStages = new Set(['choice', 'declined', 'gift', 'explain1', 'explain2', 'explain3']);
7038:   state.events.westernUnionEvent = {
7039:     scheduleYear: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.scheduleYear) || 0)),
7040:     eligibleDayOfYear: Math.max(0, Math.min(366, Math.floor(Number(saved.eligibleDayOfYear) || 0))),
7041:     lastCheckedDate: /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(saved.lastCheckedDate || '')) ? String(saved.lastCheckedDate) : '',
7042:     lastTriggeredYear: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastTriggeredYear) || 0)),
7043:     totalTriggered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)),
7044:     active: Boolean(saved.active),
7045:     stage: WESTERN_UNION_EVENT_STAGES.has(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : 'idle',
7046:     rewardGranted: Boolean(saved.rewardGranted),
7047:     eventDate: /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(saved.eventDate || '')) ? String(saved.eventDate) : '',
7048:     introVideoCompleted: Boolean(saved.introVideoCompleted),
7049:     stageAfterVideo: dialogueStages.has(saved.stageAfterVideo) ? saved.stageAfterVideo : '',
7050:   };
7051:   const eventState = state.events.westernUnionEvent;
7052:   if (!eventState.active) {
7053:     eventState.stageAfterVideo = '';
7054:     if (eventState.stage === 'completed') eventState.introVideoCompleted = true;
7055:     return eventState;
7056:   }
7057:   // v0.10.584より前からイベント途中のセーブでも、動画を飛ばさず
7058:   // 視聴後に元の進行段階へ戻す。
7059:   if (!eventState.introVideoCompleted) {
7060:     if (eventState.stage !== 'video') {
7061:       eventState.stageAfterVideo = dialogueStages.has(eventState.stage) ? eventState.stage : (eventState.stageAfterVideo || 'choice');
7062:     }
7063:     if (!eventState.stageAfterVideo) eventState.stageAfterVideo = 'choice';
7064:     eventState.stage = 'video';
7065:   }
7066:   return eventState;
7067: }

7069: function ensureWesternUnionAnnualSchedule(eventState, date = gameDate()) {
7070:   const year = date.getFullYear();
7071:   if (eventState.scheduleYear === year && eventState.eligibleDayOfYear >= 1) return false;
7072:   eventState.scheduleYear = year;
7073:   eventState.eligibleDayOfYear = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * daysInGameYear(year));
7074:   eventState.lastCheckedDate = '';
7075:   if (!eventState.active) {
7076:     eventState.stage = eventState.lastTriggeredYear === year ? 'completed' : 'idle';
7077:     eventState.rewardGranted = false;
7078:     eventState.eventDate = '';
7079:     eventState.introVideoCompleted = eventState.stage === 'completed';
7080:     eventState.stageAfterVideo = '';
7081:   }
7082:   return true;
7083: }

7137: function maybeStartWesternUnionEvent() {
7138:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) return false;
7139:   if (!state || state.game.weather !== '雨' || Number(state.game.minutes) !== DAY_START_MINUTES) return false;
7140:   const date = gameDate();
7141:   const year = date.getFullYear();
7142:   const todayKey = dateKey(date);
7143:   const eventState = westernUnionEventState();
7144:   let changed = ensureWesternUnionAnnualSchedule(eventState, date);
7145:   if (eventState.active) {
7146:     if (changed) saveGame();
7147:     return resumeWesternUnionEvent();
7148:   }
7149:   if (eventState.lastCheckedDate === todayKey) {
7150:     if (changed) saveGame();
7151:     return false;
7152:   }
7153:   eventState.lastCheckedDate = todayKey;
7154:   changed = true;
7155:   const eligible = eventState.lastTriggeredYear !== year
7156:     && gameDayOfYear(date) >= eventState.eligibleDayOfYear;
7157:   if (!eligible) {
7158:     saveGame();
7159:     return false;
7160:   }
7161:   eventState.lastTriggeredYear = year;
7162:   eventState.totalTriggered += 1;
7163:   eventState.active = true;
7164:   eventState.stage = 'video';
7165:   eventState.stageAfterVideo = 'choice';
7166:   eventState.introVideoCompleted = false;
7167:   eventState.rewardGranted = false;
7168:   eventState.eventDate = todayKey;
7169:   saveGame();
7170:   setScreen('westernUnionEvent', {}, false);
7171:   vibrate([18, 34, 18]);
7172:   return true;
7173: }

7241: function randomEventTriggerDay(minimumDays, maximumDays, fromDay = state?.game?.day || 1) {
7242:   const minimum = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(minimumDays) || 1));
7243:   const maximum = Math.max(minimum, Math.floor(Number(maximumDays) || minimum));
7244:   const offset = minimum + Math.floor(Math.random() * (maximum - minimum + 1));
7245:   return Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(fromDay) || 1)) + offset;
7246: }

7248: function simpleEventState(key, validStages, defaults = {}) {
7249:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
7250:   const saved = state.events[key] && typeof state.events[key] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events[key]) ? state.events[key] : {};
7251:   state.events[key] = {
7252:     nextTriggerDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.nextTriggerDay) || 0)),
7253:     lastTriggeredDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastTriggeredDay) || 0)),
7254:     totalTriggered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)),
7255:     active: Boolean(saved.active),
7256:     stage: validStages.includes(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : 'idle',
7257:     ...defaults,
7258:     ...Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(defaults).map((keyName) => [keyName, Boolean(saved[keyName])])),
7259:   };
7260:   if (!state.events[key].active && !['idle', 'completed'].includes(state.events[key].stage)) state.events[key].stage = 'completed';
7261:   return state.events[key];
7262: }

7312: function bluesJukeEventState() {
7313:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
7314:   const saved = state.events.bluesJukeEvent && typeof state.events.bluesJukeEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.bluesJukeEvent)
7315:     ? state.events.bluesJukeEvent
7316:     : {};
7317:   const episode = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Math.floor(Number(saved.episode) || 1)));
7318:   const scenes = BLUES_JUKE_EVENT_SCENES[episode];
7319:   const step = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, scenes.length - 1), Math.floor(Number(saved.step) || 0)));
7320:   const stage = ['idle', 'playing', 'completed'].includes(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : (saved.active ? 'playing' : 'idle');
7321:   state.events.bluesJukeEvent = {
7322:     nextTriggerDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.nextTriggerDay) || 0)),
7323:     lastTriggeredDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastTriggeredDay) || 0)),
7324:     totalTriggered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)),
7325:     active: Boolean(saved.active),
7326:     stage,
7327:     episode,
7328:     step,
7329:     rewardGranted: Boolean(saved.rewardGranted),
7330:     knowledgeUnlocked: Boolean(saved.knowledgeUnlocked),
7331:   };
7332:   if (!state.events.bluesJukeEvent.active && state.events.bluesJukeEvent.stage === 'playing') state.events.bluesJukeEvent.stage = 'completed';
7333:   return state.events.bluesJukeEvent;
7334: }

7336: function bluesJukeScenes(eventState = bluesJukeEventState()) {
7337:   return BLUES_JUKE_EVENT_SCENES[Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Number(eventState.episode) || 1))] || BLUES_JUKE_EVENT_SCENES[1];
7338: }

7340: function bluesJukeCurrentScene(eventState = bluesJukeEventState()) {
7341:   const scenes = bluesJukeScenes(eventState);
7342:   const index = Math.max(0, Math.min(scenes.length - 1, Math.floor(Number(eventState.step) || 0)));
7343:   return scenes[index] || scenes[0];
7344: }

7346: function ensureBluesJukeSchedule(eventState = bluesJukeEventState()) {
7347:   if (eventState.nextTriggerDay > 0) return false;
7348:   if (eventState.totalTriggered <= 0 && eventState.episode === 1) {
7349:     eventState.nextTriggerDay = BLUES_JUKE_EVENT_FIRST_TRIGGER_MIN
7350:       + Math.floor(Math.random() * (BLUES_JUKE_EVENT_FIRST_TRIGGER_MAX - BLUES_JUKE_EVENT_FIRST_TRIGGER_MIN + 1));
7351:   } else {
7352:     eventState.nextTriggerDay = randomEventTriggerDay(BLUES_JUKE_EVENT_REPEAT_MIN_DAYS, BLUES_JUKE_EVENT_REPEAT_MAX_DAYS);
7353:   }
7354:   return true;
7355: }

7357: function scheduleNextBluesJukeEvent(eventState = bluesJukeEventState()) {
7358:   const currentDay = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(state?.game?.day) || 1));
7359:   eventState.nextTriggerDay = randomEventTriggerDay(BLUES_JUKE_EVENT_REPEAT_MIN_DAYS, BLUES_JUKE_EVENT_REPEAT_MAX_DAYS, currentDay);
7360:   return eventState.nextTriggerDay;
7361: }

7363: function resumeBluesJukeEvent() {

7370: function maybeStartBluesJukeEvent() {
7371:   if (!state || illnessEventSuppressionActive() || isAlienAbducted()) return false;
7372:   const eventState = bluesJukeEventState();
7373:   const scheduleChanged = ensureBluesJukeSchedule(eventState);
7374:   if (eventState.active) {
7375:     if (scheduleChanged) saveGame();
7376:     return resumeBluesJukeEvent();
7377:   }
7378:   const day = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(state.game.day) || 1));
7379:   if (day < eventState.nextTriggerDay) {
7380:     if (scheduleChanged) saveGame();
7381:     return false;
7382:   }
7383:   eventState.active = true;
7384:   eventState.stage = 'playing';
7385:   eventState.step = 0;
7386:   eventState.rewardGranted = false;
7387:   eventState.lastTriggeredDay = day;
7388:   eventState.totalTriggered += 1;
7389:   saveGame();
7390:   setScreen('bluesJukeEvent', {}, false);
7391:   playSfx('impact', { gain: .72 });
7392:   return true;
7393: }

7395: function finalizeBluesJukeEventState(eventState = bluesJukeEventState()) {
7396:   const episode = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Math.floor(Number(eventState.episode) || 1)));
7397:   eventState.episode = episode < 3 ? episode + 1 : 3;
7398:   eventState.active = false;
7399:   eventState.stage = 'completed';
7400:   eventState.step = 0;
7401:   eventState.rewardGranted = false;
7402:   scheduleNextBluesJukeEvent(eventState);
7403:   return eventState;
7404: }

7425: function completeBluesJukeEvent() {

7438: function bluesJukeStepSfx(scene, previousScene) {
7439:   if (scene?.cheer) {
7440:     playSfx(BLUES_JUKE_EVENT_CHEER_SFX, { gain: 1.35 });
7441:     vibrate([35, 25, 45, 25, 70]);
7442:     return;
7443:   }
7444:   if (scene?.kind === 'reward') return;
7445:   if (previousScene?.place !== scene?.place) {
7446:     playSfx('impact', { gain: .62, rate: .84 });
7447:     return;
7448:   }
7449:   if (!previousScene?.character && scene?.character) {
7450:     playSfx('impact', { gain: .72 });
7451:     return;
7452:   }
7453:   if (previousScene?.character && !scene?.character) {
7454:     playSfx('select', { gain: .62 });
7455:     return;
7456:   }
7457:   playSfx('select', { gain: .58 });
7458: }

7460: async function advanceBluesJukeEvent() {
7461:   if (bluesJukeTransitioning) return;
7462:   const eventState = bluesJukeEventState();
7463:   if (!eventState.active || eventState.stage !== 'playing') {
7464:     completeBluesJukeEvent();
7465:     return;
7466:   }
7467:   const scenes = bluesJukeScenes(eventState);
7468:   const previousScene = bluesJukeCurrentScene(eventState);
7469:   if (eventState.step >= scenes.length - 1) {
7470:     completeBluesJukeEvent();
7471:     return;
7472:   }
7473:   bluesJukeTransitioning = true;
7474:   try {
7475:     eventState.step += 1;
7476:     const scene = bluesJukeCurrentScene(eventState);
7477:     if (scene.kind === 'reward') grantBluesJukeBlackDiamond(eventState);
7478:     saveGame();
7479:     if (previousScene.pauseAfterMs) {
7480:       // 「歌った」をタップした直後は、次の人物を一瞬も先出しせず店内背景だけを表示する。
7481:       screenData = { ...screenData, bluesJukePause: true };
7482:       render();
7483:       playSfx('select', { gain: .48 });
7484:       await wait(previousScene.pauseAfterMs);
7485:       if (screen !== 'bluesJukeEvent' || !bluesJukeEventState().active) return;
7486:       screenData = { ...screenData, bluesJukePause: false };
7487:       render();
7488:       bluesJukeStepSfx(scene, previousScene);
7489:       playSfx('success', { gain: .72 });
7490:     } else {
7491:       render();
7492:       bluesJukeStepSfx(scene, previousScene);
7493:     }
7494:   } finally {
7495:     bluesJukeTransitioning = false;
7496:   }
7497: }

7598: function kappaJadeEventState() {

7780: function oneLoveEventState() {
7781:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
7782:   const saved = state.events.oneLoveEvent && typeof state.events.oneLoveEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.oneLoveEvent)

7785:   const activeStages = new Set(['intro1', 'intro2', 'intro3', 'intro4', 'intro5']);

7788:   const primarySnapshot = saved.purchasePriceSnapshotByMetalId && typeof saved.purchasePriceSnapshotByMetalId === 'object' && !Array.isArray(saved.purchasePriceSnapshotByMetalId)
7789:     ? saved.purchasePriceSnapshotByMetalId
7790:     : null;

7792:     ? saved.basePurchasePerGramByMetalId

7795:   const purchasePriceSnapshotByMetalId = {};

7800:     else if (lastTriggeredDay > 0 && validPositivePrice(migrationFallback)) purchasePriceSnapshotByMetalId[id] = Math.round(migrationFallback);
7801:   });

7803:   const migratedStage = saved.stage === 'intro' ? 'intro1' : saved.stage;

7806:       ONE_LOVE_EVENT_FIRST_ELIGIBLE_DAY,
7807:       Math.floor(Number(saved.nextTriggerDay) || 0),
7808:       lastTriggeredDay > 0 ? lastTriggeredDay + ONE_LOVE_EVENT_COOLDOWN_DAYS + 1 : ONE_LOVE_EVENT_FIRST_ELIGIBLE_DAY,
7809:     ),
7810:     lastTriggeredDay,
7811:     totalTriggered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)),
7812:     lastCheckedDate: /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(saved.lastCheckedDate || '')) ? String(saved.lastCheckedDate) : '',
7813:     active,
7814:     stage: active
7815:       ? (activeStages.has(migratedStage) ? migratedStage : 'intro1')
7816:       : (validStages.has(migratedStage) ? migratedStage : 'idle'),
7817:     purchasePriceSnapshotByMetalId,
7818:   };
7819:   if (!state.events.oneLoveEvent.active && !['idle', 'completed'].includes(state.events.oneLoveEvent.stage)) state.events.oneLoveEvent.stage = 'completed';
7820:   return state.events.oneLoveEvent;

7907: function hospitalEventRandomOffset(minDays, maxDays) {
7908:   const min = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(minDays) || 0));
7909:   const max = Math.max(min, Math.floor(Number(maxDays) || min));
7910:   return min + Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1));
7911: }

7914:   const index = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(episode) || 1)) - 1;

7918: function hospitalEventState() {
7919:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
7920:   const saved = state.events.hospitalEvent && typeof state.events.hospitalEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.hospitalEvent)
7921:     ? state.events.hospitalEvent
7922:     : {};
7923:   const totalTriggered = Math.max(0, Math.min(HOSPITAL_EVENT_EPISODES.length, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)));
7924:   const active = Boolean(saved.active);
7925:   const episode = Math.max(1, Math.min(HOSPITAL_EVENT_EPISODES.length, Math.floor(Number(saved.episode) || Math.max(1, totalTriggered))));
7926:   const lines = hospitalEventDialogueForEpisode(episode);
7927:   const validActiveStages = new Set(HOSPITAL_EVENT_STAGE_ORDER.slice(0, lines.length));
7928:   const rawStage = String(saved.stage || 'idle');
7929:   const stage = active
7930:     ? (validActiveStages.has(rawStage) ? rawStage : 'line1')
7931:     : (['idle', 'completed'].includes(rawStage) ? rawStage : 'completed');
7932: 
7933:   state.events.hospitalEvent = {
7934:     active,
7935:     stage,
7936:     episode,
7937:     totalTriggered,
7938:     lastTriggeredDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastTriggeredDay) || 0)),
7939:     nextTriggerDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.nextTriggerDay) || 0)),
7940:     pendingSleepDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.pendingSleepDay) || 0)),
7941:   };
7942:   if (state.events.hospitalEvent.totalTriggered >= HOSPITAL_EVENT_EPISODES.length && !state.events.hospitalEvent.active) {
7943:     state.events.hospitalEvent.nextTriggerDay = 0;
7944:   }
7945:   return state.events.hospitalEvent;
7946: }

7948: function scheduleNextHospitalEvent(eventState = hospitalEventState(), fromDay = state?.game?.day) {
7949:   if (!eventState) return 0;

7951:   if (Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(eventState.totalTriggered) || 0)) >= HOSPITAL_EVENT_EPISODES.length) {
7952:     eventState.nextTriggerDay = 0;
7953:     return 0;

7956:   return eventState.nextTriggerDay;

7972: function hospitalEventCanStartToday(eventState = hospitalEventState()) {
7973:   if (!state || eventState.active) return false;

7975:   if (day < HOSPITAL_EVENT_FIRST_ELIGIBLE_DAY) return false;

7977:   if (Math.floor(Number(eventState.totalTriggered) || 0) >= HOSPITAL_EVENT_EPISODES.length) return false;
7978:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive() || isAlienAbducted()) return false;
7979:   if (pendingRobberyReport()) return false;

7983: function maybeStartHospitalEvent() {
7984:   const eventState = hospitalEventState();

7986:   if (!hospitalEventCanStartToday(eventState)) return false;
7987:

7989:   if (eventState.nextTriggerDay <= 0) {
7990:     eventState.nextTriggerDay = day + hospitalEventRandomOffset(HOSPITAL_EVENT_FIRST_WAIT_MIN_DAYS, HOSPITAL_EVENT_FIRST_WAIT_MAX_DAYS);
7991:     void saveGame();
7992:   }
7993:   if (day < eventState.nextTriggerDay) return false;
7994: 
7995:   const episode = Math.min(HOSPITAL_EVENT_EPISODES.length, Math.max(1, eventState.totalTriggered + 1));
7996:   eventState.active = true;
7997:   eventState.stage = 'line1';
7998:   eventState.episode = episode;
7999:   eventState.totalTriggered = episode;
8000:   eventState.lastTriggeredDay = day;
8001:   eventState.nextTriggerDay = 0;
8002:   eventState.pendingSleepDay = 0;

8004:   saveGame();

8031:     finishHospitalEvent();

8225: function tattooWomanAmberEventState() {
8226:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
8227:   const saved = state.events.tattooWomanAmberEvent && typeof state.events.tattooWomanAmberEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.tattooWomanAmberEvent)

8446: 
8447: // 共通ルール：場所へ行く・施設へ入る・同じ行動を繰り返すことで判定するイベントは、
8448: // 同じゲーム内日付では何度試しても1回分だけ数える／抽選する。
8449: function markVisitEventCheckOncePerDay(eventState, field = 'lastCheckedDate') {
8450:   if (!eventState || typeof eventState !== 'object') return false;
8451:   const todayKey = visitEventDateKey();

8457: function sushiChefEventState() {
8458:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
8459:   const saved = state.events.sushiChefEvent && typeof state.events.sushiChefEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.sushiChefEvent)
8460:     ? state.events.sushiChefEvent

8462:   const validStages = new Set(['idle', 'intro1', 'intro2', 'playing', 'farewell', 'completed']);
8463:   state.events.sushiChefEvent = {
8464:     lastCheckedDate: /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(saved.lastCheckedDate || '')) ? String(saved.lastCheckedDate) : '',

8470:     lastHungerAfter: Math.max(0, Math.min(7, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastHungerAfter) || 0))),
8471:   };

8814: function childhoodFriendEventState() {
8815:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
8816:   const saved = state.events.childhoodFriendEvent && typeof state.events.childhoodFriendEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.childhoodFriendEvent)

8820:   Object.assign(saved, {
8821:     nextTriggerDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.nextTriggerDay) || 0)),
8822:     lastTriggeredDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastTriggeredDay) || 0)),
8823:     totalTriggered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)),
8824:     active: Boolean(saved.active),
8825:     stage: validStages.has(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : 'idle',

8827:     mealCompleted: Boolean(saved.mealCompleted),

8829:     hungerAfter: Math.max(0, Math.min(7, Math.floor(Number(saved.hungerAfter) || 0))),

8838: function randomEventDayOffset(minimum, maximum) {
8839:   const min = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(minimum) || 0));
8840:   const max = Math.max(min, Math.floor(Number(maximum) || min));
8841:   return min + Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1));
8842: }

8886: function finishChildhoodFriendMeal({ manual = false } = {}) {
8887:   const eventState = childhoodFriendEventState();
8888:   if (!eventState.active || !['eating', 'postMeal'].includes(eventState.stage)) return false;
8889:   clearChildhoodFriendMealWatchdog();
8890:   const meal = MEALS.ramen;
8891:   if (!eventState.mealCompleted) {
8892:     const before = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, Number(eventState.hungerBefore) || hungerLevel()));
8893:     spendMealTime();
8894:     state.wellbeing.hunger = Math.min(7, hungerLevel() + meal.recovery);
8895:     state.wellbeing.lastMeal = 'ramen';
8896:     state.wellbeing.mealsEaten = Math.max(0, Number(state.wellbeing.mealsEaten) || 0) + 1;
8897:     eventState.hungerAfter = state.wellbeing.hunger;
8898:     state.daily.meals.push({ id: 'ramen', name: meal.name, price: meal.price, recovery: state.wellbeing.hunger - before });
8899:     eventState.mealCompleted = true;
8900:   }
8901:   eventState.stage = 'postMeal';
8902:   mealTransitioning = false;
8903:   saveGame();
8904:   if (manual) playSfx('select', { gain: .42 });
8905:   else playSfx('success', { gain: .54 });
8906:   render();
8907:   return true;
8908: }

8919:   return Promise.race([
8920:     new Promise((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve))),

8925: async function preloadChildhoodFriendMealAssets() {
8926:   const assets = Promise.all([
8927:     preloadImage(childhoodFriendBackgroundImage(false)),
8928:     preloadImage(childhoodFriendBackgroundImage(true)),
8929:     preloadImage(mealFoodImage('ramen')),
8930:   ]);

8935: async function startChildhoodFriendMeal() {
8936:   const eventState = childhoodFriendEventState();
8937:   if (!eventState.active || !['intro3', 'eating'].includes(eventState.stage) || mealTransitioning) return;
8938:   const meal = MEALS.ramen;
8939:   mealTransitioning = true;
8940:   let stateBeforeMeal = null;
8941:   try {
8942:     stateBeforeMeal = structuredClone(state);
8943:     await preloadChildhoodFriendMealAssets();
8944:     if (!eventState.mealPaid) {
8945:       const before = hungerLevel();
8946:       if (before >= 7) throw new Error('空腹度は満タンです。');
8947:       if (state.wellbeing.mealsEaten > 0 && state.wellbeing.lastMeal === 'ramen') throw new Error('同じ食事は連続で選べません。');
8948:       if (state.game.money < meal.price) throw new Error('所持金が足りません。');
8949:       eventState.hungerBefore = before;
8950:       state.game.money -= meal.price;
8951:       addFinance(`${meal.name}で食事`, 0, meal.price);
8952:       startMoneyFeedback(-meal.price, 1200);
8953:       eventState.mealPaid = true;
8954:     }
8955:     eventState.stage = 'eating';
8956:     state.game.screen = 'childhoodFriendEvent';
8957:     saveGame();
8958:     render();
8959:     scheduleChildhoodFriendMealWatchdog();
8960:     await waitForNextPaintWithTimeout();
8961:     await wait(420);
8962:     if (childhoodFriendEventState().stage !== 'eating') return;
8963:     playSfx('eat');
8964:     await wait(2080);
8965:     finishChildhoodFriendMeal();
8966:   } catch (error) {
8967:     console.error('幼なじみとの再会イベント食事処理エラー', error);
8968:     clearChildhoodFriendMealWatchdog();
8969:     if (stateBeforeMeal) state = stateBeforeMeal;
8970:     repairChildhoodFriendEventDeadlock({ save: true, force: true });
8971:     render();
8972:     showToast('ラーメン屋イベントを安全に終了し、メイン画面へ戻りました。', 'warning');
8973:   } finally {
8974:     mealTransitioning = false;
8975:   }
8976: }

8978: async function advanceChildhoodFriendEvent() {
8979:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) {
8980:     repairChildhoodFriendEventDeadlock({ save: true, force: true });
8981:     render();
8982:     return;
8983:   }
8984:   const eventState = childhoodFriendEventState();
8985:   if (!eventState.active) return goMain();
8986:   if (eventState.stage === 'intro1') eventState.stage = 'intro2';
8987:   else if (eventState.stage === 'intro2') eventState.stage = 'intro3';
8988:   else if (eventState.stage === 'intro3') {
8989:     saveGame();
8990:     await startChildhoodFriendMeal();
8991:     return;
8992:   } else if (eventState.stage === 'postMeal') {
8993:     const before = eventState.hungerBefore;
8994:     const after = eventState.hungerAfter;
8995:     eventState.active = false;
8996:     eventState.stage = 'completed';
8997:     eventState.nextTriggerDay = state.game.day + randomEventDayOffset(CHILDHOOD_FRIEND_REPEAT_TRIGGER_MIN, CHILDHOOD_FRIEND_REPEAT_TRIGGER_MAX);
8998:     saveGame();
8999:     hungerFeedback = { before, after, mealName: 'ラーメン' };
9000:     clearTimeout(hungerFeedbackTimer);
9001:     goMain();
9002:     hungerFeedbackTimer = setTimeout(() => {
9003:       hungerFeedback = null;
9004:       if (screen === 'main') render();
9005:     }, 1550);
9006:     return;
9007:   } else if (eventState.stage === 'eating') {
9008:     await startChildhoodFriendMeal();
9009:     return;
9010:   } else {
9011:     repairChildhoodFriendEventDeadlock({ save: true, force: true });
9012:     render();
9013:     return;
9014:   }
9015:   saveGame();
9016:   render();
9017: }

9851: function validOkachimachiQuizQuestion(row) {
9852:   return Boolean(row
9853:     && typeof row.question === 'string'
9854:     && row.question.trim()
9855:     && Array.isArray(row.choices)
9856:     && row.choices.length === 4
9857:     && row.choices.every((choice) => typeof choice === 'string' && choice.trim())
9858:     && Number.isInteger(row.answerIndex)

9863: async function loadOkachimachiQuizQuestions() {
9864:   if (!okachimachiQuizQuestionsPromise) {
9865:     okachimachiQuizQuestionsPromise = (async () => {
9866:       const controller = new AbortController();
9867:       const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 5000);
9868:       try {
9869:         const response = await fetch(OKACHIMACHI_QUIZ_DATA_URL, { cache: 'no-store', signal: controller.signal });
9870:         if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`クイズデータを読み込めませんでした（${response.status}）`);
9871:         const rows = await response.json();
9872:         const questions = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows.filter(validOkachimachiQuizQuestion) : [];
9873:         if (!questions.length) throw new Error('使用できるクイズ問題がありません。');
9874:         return questions;
9875:       } catch (error) {
9876:         okachimachiQuizQuestionsPromise = null;
9877:         throw error;
9878:       } finally {
9879:         window.clearTimeout(timeout);
9880:       }
9881:     })();
9882:   }
9883:   return okachimachiQuizQuestionsPromise;
9884: }
9885: 
9886: async function loadLooseShopOriginalQuizQuestions() {
9887:   if (!looseShopOriginalQuizQuestionsPromise) {
9888:     looseShopOriginalQuizQuestionsPromise = (async () => {
9889:       const controller = new AbortController();
9890:       const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 5000);
9891:       try {
9892:         const response = await fetch(LOOSE_SHOP_ORIGINAL_QUIZ_DATA_URL, { cache: 'no-store', signal: controller.signal });
9893:         if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`ルース屋クイズデータを読み込めませんでした（${response.status}）`);
9894:         const payload = await response.json();
9895:         const rows = Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : (Array.isArray(payload?.questions) ? payload.questions : []);
9896:         const questions = rows.filter(validOkachimachiQuizQuestion);
9897:         if (questions.length !== 50) throw new Error(`ルース屋クイズは50問必要です（有効問題数: ${questions.length}）`);
9898:         return questions;
9899:       } catch (error) {
9900:         looseShopOriginalQuizQuestionsPromise = null;
9901:         throw error;
9902:       } finally {
9903:         window.clearTimeout(timeout);
9904:       }
9905:     })();
9906:   }
9907:   return looseShopOriginalQuizQuestionsPromise;
9908: }

9910: function chooseOkachimachiQuizQuestion(questions, previousIndex = -1) {
9911:   let index = Math.floor(Math.random() * questions.length);
9912:   if (questions.length > 1 && index === previousIndex) {
9913:     index = (index + 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (questions.length - 1))) % questions.length;
9914:   }
9915:   return { index, question: questions[index] };
9916: }
