10632: function normalizeOkachimachiDailyEventState(key, validStages, defaults = {}) {
10633:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
10634:   const saved = state.events[key] && typeof state.events[key] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events[key]) ? state.events[key] : {};
10635:   const next = {
10636:     lastAttemptDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastAttemptDay) || 0)),
10637:     lastTriggeredDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastTriggeredDay) || 0)),
10638:     totalTriggered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)),
10639:     active: Boolean(saved.active),
10640:     stage: validStages.includes(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : 'idle',
10641:     ...defaults,
10642:   };
10643:   for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(defaults)) {
10644:     if (typeof value === 'boolean') next[name] = Boolean(saved[name]);
10645:     else if (typeof value === 'number') next[name] = Number.isFinite(Number(saved[name])) ? Number(saved[name]) : value;
10646:     else if (typeof value === 'string') next[name] = typeof saved[name] === 'string' ? saved[name] : value;
10647:   }
10648:   if (!next.active && !['idle', 'completed'].includes(next.stage)) next.stage = 'completed';
10649:   state.events[key] = next;
10650:   return next;
10651: }

10662:     effectStartDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.effectStartDay) || 0)),
10663:     effectEndDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.effectEndDay) || 0)),
10664:     lastGuaranteedCustomerDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastGuaranteedCustomerDay) || 0)),
10665:     totalTriggered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)),
10666:   };

10687: function schedulePearlHumanGuaranteedCustomer({ preserveExistingToday = false } = {}) {
10688:   if (!pearlHumanEffectActive()) return false;
10689:   const e = pearlHumanEventState();
10690:   const currentDay = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.game.day) || 0));
10691:   if (e.lastGuaranteedCustomerDay === currentDay) return true;
10692:   if (!storeBusinessOpen()) return false;
10693: 
10694:   const normalIds = normalCustomerIdsForPearlHumanEvent();
10695:   if (!normalIds.length) return false;
10696: 
10697:   if (preserveExistingToday) {
10698:     const alreadyVisitedToday = normalIds.some((id) => {
10699:       const customer = state.customers[id];
10700:       return Boolean(customer?.visiting) || Number(customer?.lastVisitDay) === currentDay;
10701:     });
10702:     if (alreadyVisitedToday) {
10703:       e.lastGuaranteedCustomerDay = currentDay;
10704:       return true;
10705:     }
10706:   }
10707: 
10708:   Object.values(state.customers || {}).forEach((customer) => {
10709:     customer.visiting = false;
10710:     customer.visitingBranchNumber = null;
10711:   });
10712: 
10713:   const branches = contractedStoreBranches().filter((branch) => storeBranchOperating(branch));
10714:   if (!branches.length) return false;
10715:   const branch = randomFrom(branches);
10716: 
10717:   let eligible = normalIds.filter((id) => {
10718:     const customer = state.customers[id];
10719:     if (!customer.met) return currentDay >= 2;
10720:     return currentDay - (customer.lastVisitDay || 0) >= CUSTOMER_REPEAT_COOLDOWN_DAYS;
10721:   });
10722:   if (!eligible.length) eligible = normalIds.slice();
10723:   const customerId = randomFrom(eligible);
10724:   if (!customerId || !branch || !startCustomerVisit(customerId, branch.number)) return false;
10725: 
10726:   e.lastGuaranteedCustomerDay = currentDay;
10727:   addNotification('お客様が来店しています', `${CUSTOMERS[customerId].name}さんが${storeBranchLabel(branch.number)}に来ています。`, 'special');
10728:   return true;
10729: }

10830: async function loadStorytellerQuestions() {
10831:   if (Array.isArray(storytellerQuizQuestions) && storytellerQuizQuestions.length) return storytellerQuizQuestions;
10832:   if (!storytellerQuizLoadPromise) {
10833:     storytellerQuizLoadPromise = fetch(`${STORYTELLER_QUIZ_URL}?v=${VERSION}`, { cache: 'no-store' })
10834:       .then((response) => { if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`); return response.json(); })
10835:       .then((payload) => {
10836:         const rows = Array.isArray(payload?.questions) ? payload.questions : [];
10837:         storytellerQuizQuestions = rows.filter((row) => row && row.question && row.choices && ['A','B','C','D'].every((key) => String(row.choices[key] || '').trim()) && ['A','B','C','D'].includes(row.correct));
10838:         return storytellerQuizQuestions;
10839:       }).finally(() => { storytellerQuizLoadPromise = null; });
10840:   }
10841:   return storytellerQuizLoadPromise;
10842: }

10997: function tropicalShopProducts(category = 'fish') {
10998:   const source = TROPICAL_FISH_SHOP_PRODUCTS[category] || TROPICAL_FISH_SHOP_PRODUCTS.fish;
10999:   return source.map(([id,name,price,image,family='']) => ({ id,name,price,image,family,category }));

11001: function tropicalShopFamilyCount(family) {
11002:   return AQUARIUM_CONFIG.displayItems.filter((def) => def.family === family).reduce((sum, def) => sum + Math.max(0, Number(aquariumState().displayItems?.[def.id]?.owned) || 0), 0);
11003: }
11004: function tropicalShopMaxQuantity(product) {
11005:   const aquarium = aquariumState();
11006:   let cap = 0;
11007:   if (product.category === 'fish') {
11008:     const def = aquariumFishDefinition(product.id), row = aquarium.fish?.[product.id]; if (!def || !row) return 0;
11009:     const speciesRemain = Math.max(0, def.speciesMax - row.inTank);
11010:     const loadRemain = Math.max(0, AQUARIUM_CONFIG.capacity.fishLoadMax - aquariumFishLoad(aquarium));
11011:     cap = Math.min(speciesRemain, Math.floor(loadRemain / def.loadPoint));
11012:   } else if (product.category === 'plant') {
11013:     cap = Math.max(0, AQUARIUM_CONFIG.capacity.plantTotalMax - aquariumPlantTotal(aquarium));
11014:   } else {
11015:     const familyMax = product.family === 'driftwood' ? 3 : 5;
11016:     cap = Math.max(0, familyMax - tropicalShopFamilyCount(product.family));
11017:   }
11018:   const affordable = Math.floor(Math.max(0, Number(state.game.money) || 0) / product.price);
11019:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(cap, affordable));
11020: }
11021: function tropicalShopFindProduct(category,id) { return tropicalShopProducts(category).find((row)=>row.id===id) || null; }

11025:   screenData={...screenData,tropicalCategory:category,tropicalModal:{category,id,qty:1}}; render();
11026: }

11316: function shuffleEventAttempts(attempts) {
11317:   const shuffled = [...attempts];
11318:   for (let index = shuffled.length - 1; index > 0; index -= 1) {
11319:     const swapIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * (index + 1));
11320:     [shuffled[index], shuffled[swapIndex]] = [shuffled[swapIndex], shuffled[index]];
11321:   }
11322:   return shuffled;
11323: }

11326:   for (const start of shuffleEventAttempts(starters)) {
11327:     if (start()) return true;
11328:   }
11329:   return false;
11330: }

11394: function applyRetroBattleInventoryChange(detail) {
11395:   const itemKey = String(detail?.itemKey || '');
11396:   const delta = Math.trunc(Number(detail?.delta) || 0);
11397:   if (!RETRO_BATTLE_ITEM_KEYS.includes(itemKey) || delta >= 0) return false;
11398:   state.inventory.items = state.inventory.items && typeof state.inventory.items === 'object' ? state.inventory.items : {};
11399:   const owned = retroBattleOwnedItemCount(itemKey);
11400:   if (owned <= 0) return false;
11401:   state.inventory.items[itemKey] = Math.max(0, owned + delta);
11402:   saveGame();
11403:   return true;
11404: }
11405: 
11406: function syncRetroBattleInventoryFromResult(inventory) {
11407:   if (!inventory || typeof inventory !== 'object') return false;
11408:   state.inventory.items = state.inventory.items && typeof state.inventory.items === 'object' ? state.inventory.items : {};
11409:   let changed = false;
11410:   RETRO_BATTLE_ITEM_KEYS.forEach((itemKey) => {
11411:     if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(inventory, itemKey)) return;
11412:     const owned = retroBattleOwnedItemCount(itemKey);
11413:     const reported = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory[itemKey]) || 0));
11414:     const next = Math.min(owned, reported);
11415:     if (next === owned) return;
11416:     state.inventory.items[itemKey] = next;
11417:     changed = true;
11418:   });
11419:   return changed;
11420: }

11422: function retroBattleMoneyChange(baseMoney) {
11423:   const money = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(baseMoney) || 0));
11424:   return Math.min(RETRO_BATTLE_MONEY_CAP, Math.floor(money * RETRO_BATTLE_MONEY_RATE));
11425: }

11427: function finishRetroBattleEvent(detail, session = retroBattleSession) {
11428:   if (!session || session !== retroBattleSession || session.settled) return false;
11429:   const result = String(detail?.result || '');
11430:   if (!['victory', 'defeat', 'escaped'].includes(result)) return false;
11431:   session.settled = true;
11432:   if (typeof session.cleanup === 'function') session.cleanup();
11433:   syncRetroBattleInventoryFromResult(detail?.inventory);
11434: 
11435:   const baseMoney = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state?.game?.money) || 0));
11436:   const amount = retroBattleMoneyChange(baseMoney);
11437:   if (result === 'victory') {
11438:     state.game.money = baseMoney + amount;
11439:     if (amount > 0) addFinance('御徒町・戦闘ミニゲーム勝利', amount, 0);
11440:     if (amount !== 0) startMoneyFeedback(amount, 1600);
11441:   } else if (result === 'defeat') {
11442:     state.game.money = Math.max(0, baseMoney - amount);
11443:     if (amount > 0) addFinance('御徒町・戦闘ミニゲーム敗北', 0, amount);
11444:     if (amount !== 0) startMoneyFeedback(-amount, 1600);
11445:     state.wellbeing.hunger = 0;
11446:     state.game.minutes = DAY_END_MINUTES;
11447:   }
11448: 
11449:   saveGame();
11450:   retroBattleSession = null;
11451:   if (result === 'defeat') goMain();
11452:   else setScreen('okachimachi', {}, false);
11453:   return true;
11454: }

11465: function bindRetroBattleFrame() {
11466:   if (screen !== 'retroBattleEvent' || !retroBattleSession) return;
11467:   const session = retroBattleSession;
11468:   const frame = root.querySelector('iframe[data-retro-battle-frame]');
11469:   if (!(frame instanceof HTMLIFrameElement) || frame.dataset.retroBattleBound === '1') return;
11470:   frame.dataset.retroBattleBound = '1';
11471: 
11472:   const start = () => {
11473:     if (screen !== 'retroBattleEvent' || session !== retroBattleSession || session.settled) return;
11474:     try {
11475:       const battleWindow = frame.contentWindow;
11476:       const battleApi = battleWindow?.RetroBattle;
11477:       if (!battleWindow || !battleApi || typeof battleApi.start !== 'function') {
11478:         throw new Error('RetroBattle API が見つかりません');
11479:       }
11480:       const inventoryHandler = (event) => {
11481:         if (session !== retroBattleSession || session.settled) return;
11482:         applyRetroBattleInventoryChange(event?.detail);
11483:       };
11484:       const endHandler = (event) => {
11485:         finishRetroBattleEvent(event?.detail, session);
11486:       };
11487:       battleWindow.addEventListener('retroBattleInventoryChange', inventoryHandler);
11488:       battleWindow.addEventListener('retroBattleEnd', endHandler);
11489:       session.cleanup = () => {
11490:         battleWindow.removeEventListener('retroBattleInventoryChange', inventoryHandler);
11491:         battleWindow.removeEventListener('retroBattleEnd', endHandler);
11492:       };
11493:       battleApi.start({
11494:         playerName: retroBattlePlayerName(),
11495:         inventory: retroBattleInventorySnapshot(),
11496:       });
11497:       frame.style.visibility = 'visible';
11498:     } catch (error) {
11499:       failRetroBattleEventLoad(error);
11500:     }
11501:   };
11502: 
11503:   try {
11504:     if (frame.contentDocument?.readyState === 'complete') start();
11505:     else frame.addEventListener('load', start, { once: true });
11506:   } catch (error) {
11507:     failRetroBattleEventLoad(error);
11508:   }
11509: }

11522: async function tryRandomOkachimachiEntryEvent(eventState) {
11523:   // v0.10.799: 御徒町イベントは固定優先順を廃止し、外部から入るたびに判定順をシャッフルする。
11524:   // 各イベント固有の発生率・日次制限・条件はそのまま維持し、特定イベントが常に後回しになる偏りをなくす。
11525:   const attempts = [
11526:     () => maybeStartOkachimachiInvasiveTurtlesEvent(),
11527:     () => maybeStartWristFoundEvent(),
11528:     () => maybeStartPandaMusicEvent(),
11529:     () => maybeStartOkachimachiTollEvent(),
11530:     () => maybeStartApprenticeCinemaEvent(),
11531:     () => maybeStartCinemaVisitEvent(),
11532:     () => maybeStartClockTowerDonationEvent(),
11533:     () => maybeStartOyatsuDaisukiEvent(),
11534:     () => maybeStartSpeedStarEvent(),
11535:     () => maybeStartStorytellerEvent(),
11536:     () => maybeStartRetroBattleEvent(),
11537:   ];
11538:   if (eventState && eventState.visitsSinceLast >= eventState.nextTriggerAt && canSpendHours(1)) {
11539:     attempts.push(() => startOkachimachiQuizIfDue(eventState));
11540:   }
11541:   for (const attempt of shuffleEventAttempts(attempts)) {
11542:     if (await attempt()) return true;
11543:   }
11544:   return false;
11545: }

11547: async function enterOkachimachiFromOutside() {
11548:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) {
11549:     setScreen('okachimachi', {});
11550:     return;
11551:   }
11552:   // 進行中イベントの再開は抽選ではないため、従来どおり最優先で復帰する。
11553:   if (resumeOkachimachiInvasiveTurtlesEvent()) return;
11554:   if (resumePandaMusicEvent()) return;
11555:   if (resumeWristFoundEvent()) return;
11556:   if (resumeOkachimachiTollEvent()) return;
11557:   if (resumeApprenticeCinemaEvent()) return;
11558:   if (resumeCinemaVisitEvent()) return;
11559:   if (resumeClockTowerDonationEvent()) return;
11560:   if (resumePearlHumanEvent()) return;
11561:   if (resumeOyatsuDaisukiEvent()) return;
11562:   if (resumeSpeedStarEvent()) return;
11563:   if (resumeStorytellerEvent()) return;
11564: 
11565:   const eventState = okachimachiQuizEventState();
11566:   const todayKey = dateKey(gameDate());
11567:   if (eventState.lastCountedDate !== todayKey) {
11568:     eventState.totalVisits += 1;
11569:     eventState.visitsSinceLast += 1;
11570:     eventState.lastCountedDate = todayKey;
11571:   }
11572:   saveGame();
11573: 
11574:   if (await tryRandomOkachimachiEntryEvent(eventState)) return;
11575:   setScreen('okachimachi', {});
11576: }

11647: function grantOkachimachiQuizReward({ renderAfter = true, saveAfter = true } = {}) {
11648:   const session = okachimachiQuizSession;
11649:   if (!session || session.stage !== 'correct') return false;
11650:   const gemIds = Object.values(GEMS)
11651:     .filter((gem) => !gem.eventOnly && (gem.id !== 'diamond' || toolOwned('diamondPolishingLap')))
11652:     .map((gem) => gem.id);
11653:   if (!gemIds.length) return false;
11654:   const gemId = gemIds[Math.floor(Math.random() * gemIds.length)];
11655:   state.inventory.rough[gemId] = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.inventory.rough[gemId]) || 0)) + 1;
11656:   session.rewardGemId = gemId;
11657:   session.stage = 'reward';
11658:   persistQuizSession('okachimachi');
11659:   if (saveAfter) saveGame();
11660:   if (renderAfter) render();
11661:   playSfx('loose-sparkle', { gain: 1.06 });
11662:   vibrate([28, 35, 58]);
11663:   return true;

11973: function syncTodayGemHeaderLayout() {
11974:   if (screen !== 'todayGem') {
11975:     document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--today-gem-header-offset');
11976:     return;
11977:   }
11978:   const shellEl = root.querySelector('.screen-shell');
11979:   const headerEl = root.querySelector('.game-header');

11981:   const headerRect = headerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
11982:   const shellRect = shellEl.getBoundingClientRect();
11983:   const headerStyles = getComputedStyle(headerEl);
11984:   const extraBottom = parseFloat(headerStyles.marginBottom || '0') || 0;
11985:   const offset = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((headerRect.bottom - shellRect.top) + extraBottom));
11986:   document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--today-gem-header-offset', `${offset}px`);
11987: }

11990: function visibleHeaderBottom(headerEl) {
11991:   if (!(headerEl instanceof HTMLElement)) return 0;
11992:   let bottom = headerEl.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
11993:   const elements = [headerEl, ...headerEl.querySelectorAll('*')];
11994:   for (const element of elements) {
11995:     if (!(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
11996:     const styles = getComputedStyle(element);
11997:     if (styles.display === 'none' || styles.visibility === 'hidden') continue;
11998:     const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
11999:     if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) continue;
12000:     bottom = Math.max(bottom, rect.bottom);
12001:   }
12002:   return bottom;
12003: }

12011: function syncScreenContentTopOffset() {
12012:   const shellEl = root.querySelector('.screen-shell:not(.event-shell-no-header)');
12013:   const headerEl = shellEl?.querySelector(':scope > .game-header');
12014:   const spacerEl = shellEl?.querySelector(':scope > .screen-header-spacer');
12015:   const contentEl = shellEl?.querySelector(':scope > .screen-content');
12016:   if (!(shellEl instanceof HTMLElement) || !(headerEl instanceof HTMLElement) || !(contentEl instanceof HTMLElement)) {
12017:     document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--jwj-content-top-offset');
12018:     document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--jwj-screen-header-reserved');
12019:     return;
12020:   }
12021: 
12022:   // 食事中は専用レイアウトを使う。縦画面は従来位置を維持し、横画面だけ
12023:   // 実測した上部バー最下端 + 余白より食べ物パネルが上へ入らないよう補正する。
12024:   if (shellEl.classList.contains('meal-eating-shell')) {
12025:     document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--jwj-screen-header-reserved');
12026:     if (spacerEl instanceof HTMLElement) {
12027:       spacerEl.style.removeProperty('height');
12028:       spacerEl.style.removeProperty('min-height');
12029:       spacerEl.style.removeProperty('flex-basis');
12030:     }
12031: 
12032:     const landscapeMeal = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight;
12033:     if (!landscapeMeal) {
12034:       document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--jwj-content-top-offset', '0px');
12035:       contentEl.style.setProperty('padding-top', '8px', 'important');
12036:       contentEl.style.setProperty('scroll-padding-top', '0px', 'important');
12037:       return;
12038:     }
12039: 
12040:     const mealGap = 16;
12041:     const headerBottom = visibleHeaderBottom(headerEl);
12042:     // 再計測のたびに前回値を加算しないよう、一度ゼロ基準へ戻してから算出する。
12043:     contentEl.style.setProperty('padding-top', '0px', 'important');
12044:     contentEl.style.setProperty('scroll-padding-top', '0px', 'important');
12045:     const contentRect = contentEl.getBoundingClientRect();
12046:     let offset = Math.max(mealGap, Math.ceil(headerBottom + mealGap - contentRect.top));
12047:     contentEl.style.setProperty('padding-top', `${offset}px`, 'important');
12048:     contentEl.style.setProperty('scroll-padding-top', `${offset}px`, 'important');
12049: 
12050:     // CSS側のmargin/transformが残っていても、食べ物の枠そのものを最終基準にして再確認する。
12051:     const mealPanel = contentEl.querySelector('.meal-eating-panel');
12052:     if (mealPanel instanceof HTMLElement) {
12053:       const panelRect = mealPanel.getBoundingClientRect();
12054:       const missing = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(headerBottom + mealGap - panelRect.top));
12055:       if (missing > 0) {
12056:         offset += missing;
12057:         contentEl.style.setProperty('padding-top', `${offset}px`, 'important');
12058:         contentEl.style.setProperty('scroll-padding-top', `${offset}px`, 'important');
12059:       }
12060:     }
12061:     document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--jwj-content-top-offset', `${offset}px`);
12062:     return;
12063:   }
12064: 
12065:   if (screen === 'main') {
12066:     document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--jwj-content-top-offset');
12067:     document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--jwj-screen-header-reserved');
12068:     contentEl.style.removeProperty('padding-top');
12069:     contentEl.style.removeProperty('scroll-padding-top');
12070:     return;
12071:   }
12072: 
12073:   const isDocumentGuideScreen = screen === 'looseGemGuide' || screen === 'looseCutGuide' || screen === 'metalProfessionalGuide';
12074:   const desiredGap = isDocumentGuideScreen ? 4 : (screen === 'polishing' ? 16 : (screen === 'meal' ? 14 : (['store', 'inventory', 'showcaseSelect', 'showcaseDetail'].includes(screen) ? 36 : (screen === 'completion' ? 20 : 8))));
12075:   const headerBottom = visibleHeaderBottom(headerEl);
12076:   const phoneTwoBar = document.documentElement.dataset.deviceClass === 'phone'
12077:     && document.body.dataset.headerMode === 'two-bar';
12078: 
12079:   // v0.10.615: 携帯のサブ画面は「実測した上部バーの高さ」と同じ透明スペーサーを
12080:   // 本文の前に確保する。本文自身のpaddingで位置を推測しないため、長いタイトル・説明・
12081:   // 端末倍率・フォント読込・縦横切替でバー内部が伸びても本文が裏へ潜り込まない。
12082:   if (phoneTwoBar && spacerEl instanceof HTMLElement) {
12083:     const shellRect = shellEl.getBoundingClientRect();
12084:     let reserved = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(headerBottom - shellRect.top));
12085:     spacerEl.style.setProperty('height', `${reserved}px`, 'important');
12086:     spacerEl.style.setProperty('min-height', `${reserved}px`, 'important');
12087:     spacerEl.style.setProperty('flex-basis', `${reserved}px`, 'important');
12088:     contentEl.style.setProperty('padding-top', `${desiredGap}px`, 'important');
12089:     contentEl.style.setProperty('scroll-padding-top', `${desiredGap}px`, 'important');
12090: 
12091:     // 実際の本文開始位置も確認し、CSSの古い個別指定や子要素の変形が残っていても
12092:     // 最低限「ヘッダー最下端 + 余白」より上へ来ないよう追加補正する。
12093:     const contentRect = contentEl.getBoundingClientRect();
12094:     const missing = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(headerBottom - contentRect.top));
12095:     if (missing > 0) {
12096:       reserved += missing;
12097:       spacerEl.style.setProperty('height', `${reserved}px`, 'important');
12098:       spacerEl.style.setProperty('min-height', `${reserved}px`, 'important');
12099:       spacerEl.style.setProperty('flex-basis', `${reserved}px`, 'important');
12100:     }
12101: 
12102:     document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--jwj-screen-header-reserved', `${reserved}px`);
12103:     document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--jwj-content-top-offset', `${reserved + desiredGap}px`);
12104:     return;
12105:   }
12106: 
12107:   // PCなど透明スペーサーを使用しない画面は、従来の実測padding補正を維持する。
12108:   contentEl.style.setProperty('padding-top', '0px', 'important');
12109:   contentEl.style.setProperty('scroll-padding-top', '0px', 'important');
12110:   const contentRect = contentEl.getBoundingClientRect();
12111:   let offset = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(headerBottom + desiredGap - contentRect.top));
12112:   contentEl.style.setProperty('padding-top', `${offset}px`, 'important');
12113:   contentEl.style.setProperty('scroll-padding-top', `${offset}px`, 'important');
12114: 
12115:   const polishingAnchor = polishingTopAnchor();
12116:   if (polishingAnchor) {
12117:     const anchorRect = polishingAnchor.getBoundingClientRect();
12118:     const missing = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(headerBottom + desiredGap - anchorRect.top));
12119:     if (missing > 0) {
12120:       offset += missing;
12121:       contentEl.style.setProperty('padding-top', `${offset}px`, 'important');
12122:       contentEl.style.setProperty('scroll-padding-top', `${offset}px`, 'important');
12123:     }
12124:   }
12125: 
12126:   const mealAnchor = screen === 'meal' ? root.querySelector('.meal-eating-panel, .meal-choice-panel') : null;
12127:   if (mealAnchor instanceof HTMLElement) {
12128:     const anchorRect = mealAnchor.getBoundingClientRect();
12129:     const missing = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(headerBottom + desiredGap - anchorRect.top));
12130:     if (missing > 0) {
12131:       offset += missing;
12132:       contentEl.style.setProperty('padding-top', `${offset}px`, 'important');
12133:       contentEl.style.setProperty('scroll-padding-top', `${offset}px`, 'important');
12134:     }
12135:   }
12136:   document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--jwj-content-top-offset', `${offset}px`);
12137: }

12315: function setScreen(target, data = {}, push = true) {
12316:   if (target === 'displayShop' && state && maybeStartPearlHumanEvent()) target = 'pearlHumanEvent';
12317:   if (target === 'tropicalFishShop' && screen !== 'tropicalFishShop') {
12318:     data = { ...data, tropicalResetScroll: true };
12319:   }
12320:   if (target !== 'pandaMusicEvent') stopPandaMusicEventAudio();
12321:   if (target !== 'wristFoundEvent') stopWristFoundDarkDrone();
12322:   if (target !== 'kaitenzushi') clearKaitenzushiLoadWatch();
12323:   if (state && illnessEventSuppressionActive() && ILLNESS_SUPPRESSED_EVENT_SCREENS.has(target)) {
12324:     target = 'main';
12325:     data = {};
12326:     push = false;
12327:   }
12328:   if (push && screen !== target) navigation.push({ screen, data: screenData });
12329:   if (target === 'mining' && screen !== 'mining') selectedMining = null;
12330:   if (target === 'phone' && screen !== 'phone') {
12331:     const requestedPhoneTab = typeof data?.phoneTab === 'string' ? data.phoneTab : '';
12332:     phoneTab = requestedPhoneTab || 'notifications';
12333:     if (state?.game) state.game.phoneTab = phoneTab;
12334:   }
12335:   screen = target;
12336:   screenData = data;
12337:   if (state) state.game.screen = target;
12338:   if (['supplier', 'supplierMetals', 'supplierMetalHistory', 'pureMetalProfessionalGuide'].includes(target)
12339:     && !metalMarketTradeReady() && !['live', 'cached'].includes(metalMarket.status)) {
12340:     metalMarket.status = 'loading';
12341:   }
12342:   render();
12343:   scheduleAutosave(`screen:${target}`);
12344:   queueMicrotask(() => maybeStartForcedBirthdayRest());
12345:   if (target === 'supplier' || target === 'supplierMetals' || target === 'supplierMetalHistory' || target === 'pureMetalProfessionalGuide') {
12346:     loadMetalMarket().then(() => {
12347:       if ((screen === 'supplier' || screen === 'supplierMetals' || screen === 'supplierMetalHistory' || screen === 'pureMetalProfessionalGuide') && state) render();
12348:     });
12349:   }
12350: }
12351: 
12352: function goBack() {
12353:   const previous = navigation.pop();
12354:   if (previous) {
12355:     if (previous.screen === 'mining' && screen !== 'mining') selectedMining = null;
12356:     screen = previous.screen;
12357:     screenData = previous.data || {};
12358:     if (state) state.game.screen = screen;
12359:     render();
12360:     scheduleAutosave(`screen:${screen}`);
12361:     return;
12362:   }
12363:   setScreen(state ? 'main' : 'title', {}, false);
12364: }

12375: function gameTimePanel() {
12376:   const minutes = Math.max(DAY_START_MINUTES, Number(state?.game?.minutes) || DAY_START_MINUTES);
12377:   const clockTone = minutes >= 19 * 60 ? 'time-red' : minutes >= 17 * 60 ? 'time-yellow' : 'time-default';
12378:   let tone = 'normal';
12379:   let note = '';
12380:   if (minutes >= DAY_END_MINUTES) {
12381:     tone = 'ended';
12382:     note = '本日の行動時間は終了しました';
12383:   } else if (minutes >= DAY_END_MINUTES - 60) {
12384:     tone = 'ending';
12385:     note = `行動終了まで ${timeRemainingLabel(DAY_END_MINUTES - minutes)}`;
12386:   } else if (minutes >= OKACHIMACHI_CLOSE_MINUTES - 60 && minutes < OKACHIMACHI_CLOSE_MINUTES) {
12387:     tone = 'okachimachi-warning';
12388:     note = `御徒町終了まで ${timeRemainingLabel(OKACHIMACHI_CLOSE_MINUTES - minutes)}`;
12389:   }
12390:   return `<span class="jwj-status-item jwj-status-time game-time-panel ${tone} ${clockTone}" role="status" aria-label="現在時刻 ${clock(minutes)}${note ? `、${esc(note)}` : ''}" ${note ? `title="${esc(note)}"` : ''}>${clock(minutes)}</span>`;
12391: }

12413: function header(title, { back = true, main = true, help = '' } = {}) {

12453: function shell(title, body, options = {}) {

12455:   const shellClass = [
12456:     'screen-shell',

12462:     ? ''
12463:     : `${header(title, options)}<div class="screen-header-spacer" aria-hidden="true"></div>`;

12484: function captureSettingsScrollState() {
12485:   const settingsForm = root.querySelector('.settings-form');
12486:   if (!settingsForm) return null;
12487:   if (screen === 'phone' && phoneTab === 'settings') {
12488:     const scroller = root.querySelector('.phone-content');
12489:     if (!scroller || !scroller.contains(settingsForm)) return null;
12490:     return { screen: 'phone', phoneTab: 'settings', top: scroller.scrollTop, left: scroller.scrollLeft };
12491:   }
12492:   if (screen === 'settings' || screen === 'settingsTitle') {
12493:     const scroller = root.querySelector('.screen-content');
12494:     if (!scroller || !scroller.contains(settingsForm)) return null;
12495:     return { screen, phoneTab: '', top: scroller.scrollTop, left: scroller.scrollLeft };
12496:   }
12497:   return null;
12498: }

12500: function restoreSettingsScrollState(snapshot) {
12501:   if (!snapshot || screen !== snapshot.screen) return;
12502:   if (snapshot.screen === 'phone' && phoneTab !== snapshot.phoneTab) return;
12503:   const scroller = snapshot.screen === 'phone'
12504:     ? root.querySelector('.phone-content')
12505:     : root.querySelector('.screen-content');
12506:   if (!scroller || !scroller.querySelector('.settings-form')) return;
12507:   scroller.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, Number(snapshot.left) || 0);
12508:   scroller.scrollTop = Math.max(0, Number(snapshot.top) || 0);
12509: }

12830: function openTopLevelGoogleLogin() {
12831:   const authUrlObject = new URL('./auth.html', window.location.href);
12832:   authUrlObject.searchParams.set('from', 'game');
12833:   authUrlObject.searchParams.set('browser', '1');
12834:   if (window.matchMedia?.('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || window.navigator.standalone === true) authUrlObject.searchParams.set('source', 'pwa');
12835:   const authUrl = authUrlObject.href;
12836:   const openAndroidChrome = () => {
12837:     if (!/Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent || '')) return false;
12838:     const scheme = authUrlObject.protocol.replace(':', '');
12839:     const intentPath = `${authUrlObject.host}${authUrlObject.pathname}${authUrlObject.search}${authUrlObject.hash}`;
12840:     const intentUrl = `intent://${intentPath}#Intent;scheme=${scheme};action=android.intent.action.VIEW;category=android.intent.category.BROWSABLE;package=com.android.chrome;S.browser_fallback_url=${encodeURIComponent(authUrl)};end`;
12841:     try {
12842:       window.top.location.href = intentUrl;
12843:       return true;
12844:     } catch (_) {
12845:       return false;
12846:     }
12847:   };
12848:   // 通常表示ではゲーム本体がindex.html内のiframeに入っているため、
12849:   // OAuthポップアップをiframe内から直接開かず、最上位ページへ認証を委譲する。
12850:   if (window.parent && window.parent !== window) {
12851:     window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'jwj-game-google-login', url: authUrl }, window.location.origin);
12852:     // 更新直後に古いviewport-shell.jsが一時的に残っていても止まらないよう、
12853:     // 同一オリジンの最上位画面へ直接移動する予備経路も用意する。
12854:     window.setTimeout(() => {
12855:       try {
12856:         if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') window.top.location.assign(authUrl);
12857:       } catch (_) {}
12858:     }, 700);
12859:     return;
12860:   }
12861:   if (openAndroidChrome()) return;
12862:   window.location.assign(authUrl);
12863: }

13001: function randomFrom(values, fallback = null) {
13002:   const rows = Array.isArray(values) ? values.filter(Boolean) : [];
13003:   return rows.length ? rows[Math.floor(Math.random() * rows.length)] : fallback;
13004: }

13006: function storeCustomerProfile(branchNumber = state?.store?.branchNumber || 1) {
13007:   const number = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Math.floor(Number(branchNumber) || 1)));
13008:   return STORE_CUSTOMER_PROFILES[number] || STORE_CUSTOMER_PROFILES[1];

13011: function customerVisitDifficulty(branchNumber, baseDifficulty = 'basic') {
13012:   const branch = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Math.floor(Number(branchNumber) || 1)));
13013:   const artisan = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, Math.floor(Number(state?.artisan?.level) || 1)));
13014:   const fallback = ORDER_DIFFICULTIES[baseDifficulty] ? baseDifficulty : 'basic';
13015:   if (branch === 1 || artisan < 4) return fallback;
13016:   const roll = Math.random();
13017:   if (branch === 2) {
13018:     if (artisan >= 8 && roll < 0.10) return 'complex';
13019:     if (artisan >= 4 && roll < 0.55) return 'general';
13020:     return fallback;
13021:   }
13022:   if (artisan >= 16) {
13023:     if (roll < 0.20) return 'special';
13024:     if (roll < 0.45) return 'high';
13025:     if (roll < 0.75) return 'complex';
13026:     if (roll < 0.95) return 'general';
13027:     return 'basic';
13028:   }
13029:   if (artisan >= 12) {
13030:     if (roll < 0.25) return 'high';
13031:     if (roll < 0.60) return 'complex';
13032:     if (roll < 0.90) return 'general';
13033:     return 'basic';
13034:   }
13035:   if (artisan >= 8) {
13036:     if (roll < 0.30) return 'complex';
13037:     if (roll < 0.75) return 'general';
13038:     return 'basic';
13039:   }
13040:   return roll < 0.55 ? 'general' : 'basic';
13041: }

13043: function orderMinimumProfitablePrice(request = {}) {
13044:   const looseShape = normalizeLooseShape(request.gem, request.looseShape);
13045:   const draft = { ...request, looseShape, finish: 'mirror', quality: 'standard' };
13046:   const materialCost = Math.max(0, Math.round(productionCost(draft)));
13047:   const difficultyId = orderDifficultyId(request);
13048:   const laborFee = ORDER_LABOR_FEES[difficultyId] || ORDER_LABOR_FEES.basic;
13049:   const profitAllowance = Math.max(5000, Math.round(materialCost * 0.35));
13050:   return roundThousand(materialCost + laborFee + profitAllowance);
13051: }

13053: function normalizeOrderRequestBudget(request = {}) {
13054:   const normalized = { ...request };
13055:   normalized.looseShape = normalizeLooseShape(normalized.gem, normalized.looseShape);
13056:   const minimumBudget = orderMinimumProfitablePrice(normalized);
13057:   normalized.budget = roundThousand(Math.max(minimumBudget, Number(normalized.budget) || 0));
13058:   return normalized;
13059: }

13071: function randomCustomerPreference(request = {}) {
13072:   const preferences = [
13073:     { type: 'gem', value: request.gem, label: GEMS[request.gem]?.name || '石指定' },
13074:     { type: 'metal', value: request.metal, label: METALS[request.metal]?.name || '地金指定' },
13075:     { type: 'design', value: request.design, label: DESIGNS[request.design]?.name || 'デザイン指定' },
13076:   ];
13077:   return structuredClone(randomFrom(preferences, preferences[0]));
13078: }

13080: function buildRandomCustomerVisitRequest(customerId, branchNumber) {
13081:   const customer = CUSTOMERS[customerId];
13082:   const baseRequest = structuredClone(customer?.request || {});
13083:   const branch = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Math.floor(Number(branchNumber) || 1)));
13084:   const allGemIds = Object.values(GEMS).filter((gem) => !gem.eventOnly).map((gem) => gem.id);
13085:   const commonGemIds = allGemIds.filter((gemId) => !HIGH_VALUE_GEMS.includes(gemId));
13086:   const gemPool = branch === 3 ? HIGH_VALUE_GEMS.filter((gemId) => GEMS[gemId]) : (commonGemIds.length ? commonGemIds : allGemIds);
13087:   const metalPool = branch === 3 ? HIGH_VALUE_METALS.filter((metalId) => METALS[metalId]) : Object.keys(METALS);
13088:   const request = {
13089:     ...baseRequest,
13090:     item: randomFrom(Object.keys(ITEMS), baseRequest.item || 'ring'),
13091:     gem: randomFrom(gemPool, baseRequest.gem || 'amethyst'),
13092:     metal: randomFrom(metalPool, baseRequest.metal || 'silver'),
13093:     design: randomFrom(Object.keys(DESIGNS), baseRequest.design || 'simple'),
13094:   };
13095:   request.looseShape = randomFrom(looseShapeIdsForGem(request.gem), defaultLooseShapeForGem(request.gem));
13096:   request.difficulty = customerVisitDifficulty(branch, baseRequest.difficulty || 'basic');
13097:   request.requiredArtisanLevel = ORDER_DIFFICULTIES[request.difficulty]?.artisanLevel || 1;
13098:   request.deadlineDays = ORDER_DIFFICULTIES[request.difficulty]?.days || 7;
13099:   request.requiredTools = Array.isArray(baseRequest.requiredTools) && baseRequest.requiredTools.length
13100:     ? [...new Set(baseRequest.requiredTools.map(String))]
13101:     : ['jewelryBench'];
13102:   request.preference = randomCustomerPreference(request);
13103:   const quality = branch === 3 ? 'premium' : branch === 2 ? 'good' : 'standard';
13104:   const recommended = recommendedPrice({ ...request, quality, useLoose: true });
13105:   const budgetRate = branch === 3
13106:     ? 1.15 + Math.random() * 0.35
13107:     : branch === 2
13108:       ? 1.05 + Math.random() * 0.25
13109:       : 0.95 + Math.random() * 0.25;
13110:   request.budget = roundThousand(recommended * budgetRate);
13111:   request.storeProfile = branch === 3 ? 'premium' : branch === 2 ? 'quality' : 'general';
13112:   return normalizeOrderRequestBudget(request);
13113: }

13115: function customerVisitRequest(customerId, branchNumber) {
13116:   const customerState = state?.customers?.[customerId];
13117:   const previousSignature = String(customerState?.lastRequestSignature || customerRequestSignature(customerState?.activeRequest || {}));
13118:   let candidate = null;
13119:   for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 16; attempt += 1) {
13120:     candidate = buildRandomCustomerVisitRequest(customerId, branchNumber);
13121:     if (!previousSignature || customerRequestSignature(candidate) !== previousSignature) return candidate;
13122:   }
13123:   // 極端に同じ抽選が続いた場合も、デザインを必ず次へ送って前回と同じ要望にならないようにする。
13124:   const designIds = Object.keys(DESIGNS);
13125:   const currentIndex = Math.max(0, designIds.indexOf(candidate?.design));
13126:   candidate.design = designIds[(currentIndex + 1) % designIds.length] || 'simple';
13127:   candidate.preference = { type: 'design', value: candidate.design, label: DESIGNS[candidate.design]?.name || 'デザイン指定' };
13128:   return normalizeOrderRequestBudget(candidate);
13129: }

13207: function storeProductSaleBonus(item, branchNumber = state?.store?.branchNumber || 1) {
13208:   const branch = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Math.floor(Number(branchNumber) || 1)));
13209:   if (!item || branch === 1) return 0;
13210:   if (branch === 2) {
13211:     if (item.quality === 'premium') return 0.16;
13212:     if (item.quality === 'good') return 0.10;
13213:     return -0.03;
13214:   }
13215:   let bonus = item.quality === 'premium' ? 0.12 : item.quality === 'good' ? 0.04 : 0;
13216:   if ((item.useLoose !== false && HIGH_VALUE_GEMS.includes(item.gem)) || HIGH_VALUE_METALS.includes(item.metal)) bonus += 0.08;
13217:   return bonus;
13218: }

13229: function orderDifficulty(orderLike = {}) {

13240:   if (level <= 3) return 1;
13241:   if (level <= 7) return 2;

13253: function orderMaterialsObtainable(request = {}) {
13254:   const shape = normalizeLooseShape(request.gem, request.looseShape);
13255:   return Boolean(ITEMS[request.item] && GEMS[request.gem] && METALS[request.metal] && DESIGNS[request.design] && looseShapeIdsForGem(request.gem).includes(shape));
13256: }

13258: function orderFeasibility(request = {}) {
13259:   const difficulty = orderDifficulty(request);
13260:   const requiredArtisanLevel = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, Number(request.requiredArtisanLevel) || difficulty.artisanLevel));
13261:   const requiredTools = orderRequiredTools(request);
13262:   const artisanReady = Math.max(1, Number(state?.artisan?.level) || 1) >= requiredArtisanLevel;
13263:   const equipmentReady = requiredTools.every((toolId) => toolUsable(toolId));
13264:   const materialsObtainable = orderMaterialsObtainable(request);
13265:   const reasons = [];
13266:   if (!artisanReady) reasons.push(`職人Lv.${requiredArtisanLevel}が必要`);
13267:   if (!equipmentReady) reasons.push(`必要設備：${requiredTools.map((toolId) => WORKSHOP_TOOLS[toolId]?.name || toolId).join('、')}`);
13268:   if (!materialsObtainable) reasons.push('材料をゲーム内で入手できない');
13269:   return { possible: artisanReady && equipmentReady && materialsObtainable, difficulty, requiredArtisanLevel, requiredTools, artisanReady, equipmentReady, materialsObtainable, reasons };
13270: }

13272: function orderEstimatedFigures(request = {}) {
13273:   const normalizedRequest = normalizeOrderRequestBudget(request);
13274:   const looseShape = normalizeLooseShape(normalizedRequest.gem, normalizedRequest.looseShape);
13275:   const draft = { ...normalizedRequest, looseShape, finish: 'mirror', quality: 'standard' };
13276:   const estimatedCost = Math.max(0, Math.round(productionCost(draft)));
13277:   const minimumPrice = orderMinimumProfitablePrice(draft);
13278:   const difficultyId = orderDifficultyId(draft);
13279:   const targetPrice = Math.max(minimumPrice, roundThousand(recommendedPrice({ ...draft, quality: 'good' }) + (ORDER_LABOR_FEES[difficultyId] || 0)));
13280:   const budget = roundThousand(Math.max(minimumPrice, Number(normalizedRequest.budget) || targetPrice));
13281:   const price = Math.max(minimumPrice, Math.min(budget, targetPrice));
13282:   return { estimatedCost, price, estimatedProfit: price - estimatedCost, budget, minimumPrice };
13283: }

13291:     return requirements.enoughMetal && requirements.enoughLoose && feasibility.artisanReady && feasibility.equipmentReady ? '製作可能' : '未製作';
13292:   }
13293:   return order?.status || '未製作';

13391: function aquariumDailyPlantMortalityFactor() {
13392:   const roll = Math.random();
13393:   // 水草は魚より安定。ごくまれな「調子の悪い日」だけ複数株が同時に枯れやすくなる。
13394:   if (roll < 0.010) return 2.5 + Math.random() * 2.0;
13395:   if (roll < 0.080) return 1.15 + Math.random() * 0.65;
13396:   return 0.70 + Math.random() * 0.50;
13397: }

13399: function aquariumIndividualPlantDeathChance(plantId, individual, currentDay, tankFactor = 1) {
13400:   const profile = aquariumPlantMortalityProfile(plantId);
13401:   const acquiredDay = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(individual?.acquiredDay) || currentDay));
13402:   const ageDays = Math.max(0, currentDay - acquiredDay);
13403:   const lifespanTarget = Math.max(120, Math.floor(Number(individual?.lifespanTargetDays) || randomAquariumPlantLifespanTarget(profile)));
13404:   const vulnerability = Math.max(0.30, Math.min(2.5, Number(individual?.vulnerability) || 1));
13405:   const ageRatio = ageDays / lifespanTarget;
13406:   let ageMultiplier = 1;
13407:   if (ageRatio >= 1) ageMultiplier = Math.min(12, 2.2 + (ageRatio - 1) * 6.5);
13408:   else if (ageRatio >= 0.70) ageMultiplier = 1 + ((ageRatio - 0.70) / 0.30) * 1.25;
13409:   const acclimationProgress = Math.min(1, ageDays / 35);
13410:   const acclimationRisk = ageDays <= 34
13411:     ? Math.max(0, Number(profile.acclimationRisk) || 0) * Math.pow(1 - acclimationProgress, 1.45)
13412:     : 0;
13413:   const baseRisk = Math.max(0, Number(profile.baseRisk) || 0.00010) * ageMultiplier;
13414:   return clamp((baseRisk + acclimationRisk) * vulnerability * Math.max(0.30, Number(tankFactor) || 1), 0, 0.12);
13415: }

13418: // 購入直後・同日複数死亡・連日死亡を禁止する保護ルールは置かない。
13419: // v0.10.816: 魚の最終死亡抽選だけを従来計算値の50%へ下げ、種類別寿命・個体差・日ごとの揺らぎは維持する。

13427:   black_molly: Object.freeze({ lifespanMin: 200, lifespanMax: 580, baseRisk: 0.0018, acclimationRisk: 0.0090 }),
13428:   corydoras: Object.freeze({ lifespanMin: 420, lifespanMax: 1100, baseRisk: 0.0010, acclimationRisk: 0.0060 }),

13481: function aquariumDailyMortalityFactor() {
13482:   const roll = Math.random();
13483:   // 普段の日にも揺らぎを出し、まれに水槽全体で死亡が重なる日を作る。
13484:   // 原因名はプレイヤーへ表示しないため、「なぜか今日は何匹か死んだ」という見え方になる。
13485:   if (roll < 0.025) return 4 + Math.random() * 5;
13486:   if (roll < 0.14) return 1.35 + Math.random() * 1.65;
13487:   return 0.62 + Math.random() * 0.90;
13488: }

13490: function aquariumIndividualDeathChance(fishId, individual, currentDay, tankFactor = 1) {
13491:   const profile = aquariumFishMortalityProfile(fishId);
13492:   const acquiredDay = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(individual?.acquiredDay) || currentDay));
13493:   const ageDays = Math.max(0, currentDay - acquiredDay);
13494:   const lifespanTarget = Math.max(30, Math.floor(Number(individual?.lifespanTargetDays) || randomAquariumFishLifespanTarget(profile)));
13495:   const vulnerability = Math.max(0.25, Math.min(3, Number(individual?.vulnerability) || 1));
13496:   const ageRatio = ageDays / lifespanTarget;
13497:   let ageMultiplier = 1;
13498:   if (ageRatio >= 1) ageMultiplier = Math.min(18, 2.8 + (ageRatio - 1) * 10);
13499:   else if (ageRatio >= 0.55) ageMultiplier = 1 + ((ageRatio - 0.55) / 0.45) * 1.8;
13500:   const acclimationProgress = Math.min(1, ageDays / 22);
13501:   const acclimationRisk = ageDays <= 21
13502:     ? Math.max(0, Number(profile.acclimationRisk) || 0) * Math.pow(1 - acclimationProgress, 1.35)
13503:     : 0;
13504:   const baseRisk = Math.max(0, Number(profile.baseRisk) || 0.0014) * ageMultiplier;
13505:   return clamp((baseRisk + acclimationRisk) * vulnerability * Math.max(0.2, Number(tankFactor) || 1), 0, 0.45) * AQUARIUM_FISH_MORTALITY_RATE_MULTIPLIER;
13506: }

13508: function aquariumMortalityState(aquarium = aquariumState()) {
13509:   const saved = aquarium.mortality && typeof aquarium.mortality === 'object' && !Array.isArray(aquarium.mortality)
13510:     ? aquarium.mortality
13511:     : {};
13512:   aquarium.mortality = {
13513:     lastProcessedDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastProcessedDay) || 0)),
13514:     totalDeaths: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalDeaths) || 0)),
13515:     lastViewedDeathDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastViewedDeathDay) || 0)),
13516:     pendingNotices: Array.isArray(saved.pendingNotices) ? saved.pendingNotices : [],
13517:     plantLastProcessedDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.plantLastProcessedDay) || 0)),
13518:     totalWithered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalWithered) || 0)),
13519:     lastViewedWitherDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastViewedWitherDay) || 0)),
13520:     plantPendingNotices: Array.isArray(saved.plantPendingNotices) ? saved.plantPendingNotices : [],
13521:   };
13522:   return aquarium.mortality;
13523: }

13525: function processAquariumFishMortality() {
13526:   if (!state || !aquariumUnlocked()) return [];
13527:   const currentDay = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(state.game.day) || 1));
13528:   const aquarium = ensureAquariumFishIndividuals(aquariumState(), currentDay);
13529:   const mortality = aquariumMortalityState(aquarium);
13530:   if (mortality.lastProcessedDay >= currentDay) return [];
13531:   mortality.lastProcessedDay = currentDay;
13532:   const tankFactor = aquariumDailyMortalityFactor();
13533:   const deaths = [];
13534: 
13535:   for (const def of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.fish) {
13536:     const row = aquarium.fish?.[def.id];
13537:     if (!row || row.inTank <= 0 || !Array.isArray(row.individuals) || !row.individuals.length) continue;
13538:     const inTankCount = Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(row.inTank) || 0)), row.individuals.length);
13539:     const deadIndexes = [];
13540:     for (let index = 0; index < inTankCount; index += 1) {
13541:       const individual = row.individuals[index];
13542:       const chance = aquariumIndividualDeathChance(def.id, individual, currentDay, tankFactor);
13543:       if (Math.random() < chance) deadIndexes.push(index);
13544:     }
13545:     if (!deadIndexes.length) continue;
13546:     for (let index = deadIndexes.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) row.individuals.splice(deadIndexes[index], 1);
13547:     const count = deadIndexes.length;
13548:     row.inTank = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(row.inTank) || 0) - count);
13549:     row.owned = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(row.owned) || 0) - count);
13550:     deaths.push({ id: def.id, name: def.name, count });
13551:   }
13552: 
13553:   if (deaths.length) {
13554:     const total = deaths.reduce((sum, death) => sum + death.count, 0);
13555:     mortality.totalDeaths += total;
13556:     mortality.pendingNotices.push({
13557:       id: `aquarium-death-${currentDay}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
13558:       day: currentDay,
13559:       tone: Math.floor(Math.random() * 6),
13560:       deaths,
13561:     });
13562:     mortality.pendingNotices = mortality.pendingNotices.slice(-30);
13563:     aquarium.lastSyncRevision += 1;
13564:     refreshAquariumLoad(aquarium);
13565:   }
13566:   return deaths;
13567: }
13568: 
13569: function processAquariumPlantMortality() {
13570:   if (!state || !aquariumUnlocked()) return [];
13571:   const currentDay = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(state.game.day) || 1));
13572:   const aquarium = ensureAquariumPlantIndividuals(aquariumState(), currentDay);
13573:   const mortality = aquariumMortalityState(aquarium);
13574:   if (mortality.plantLastProcessedDay >= currentDay) return [];
13575:   mortality.plantLastProcessedDay = currentDay;
13576:   const tankFactor = aquariumDailyPlantMortalityFactor();
13577:   const withered = [];
13578: 
13579:   for (const def of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.plants) {
13580:     const row = aquarium.plants?.[def.id];
13581:     if (!row || row.inTank <= 0 || !Array.isArray(row.individuals) || !row.individuals.length) continue;
13582:     const inTankCount = Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(row.inTank) || 0)), row.individuals.length);
13583:     const deadIndexes = [];
13584:     for (let index = 0; index < inTankCount; index += 1) {
13585:       const individual = row.individuals[index];
13586:       const chance = aquariumIndividualPlantDeathChance(def.id, individual, currentDay, tankFactor);
13587:       if (Math.random() < chance) deadIndexes.push(index);
13588:     }
13589:     if (!deadIndexes.length) continue;
13590:     for (let index = deadIndexes.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) row.individuals.splice(deadIndexes[index], 1);
13591:     const count = deadIndexes.length;
13592:     row.inTank = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(row.inTank) || 0) - count);
13593:     row.owned = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(row.owned) || 0) - count);
13594:     withered.push({ id: def.id, name: def.name, count });
13595:   }
13596: 
13597:   if (withered.length) {
13598:     const total = withered.reduce((sum, loss) => sum + loss.count, 0);
13599:     mortality.totalWithered += total;
13600:     mortality.plantPendingNotices.push({
13601:       id: `aquarium-wither-${currentDay}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
13602:       day: currentDay,
13603:       tone: Math.floor(Math.random() * 6),
13604:       withered,
13605:     });
13606:     mortality.plantPendingNotices = mortality.plantPendingNotices.slice(-30);
13607:     aquarium.lastSyncRevision += 1;
13608:   }
13609:   return withered;
13610: }

13612: function aquariumDeathNoticeSummary(aquarium = aquariumState()) {
13613:   const mortality = aquariumMortalityState(aquarium);
13614:   const fishPending = mortality.pendingNotices;
13615:   const plantPending = mortality.plantPendingNotices;
13616:   if (!fishPending.length && !plantPending.length) return null;
13617: 
13618:   const fishById = new Map();
13619:   for (const notice of fishPending) {
13620:     for (const death of notice.deaths || []) {
13621:       if (!death?.id || !death?.name) continue;
13622:       const current = fishById.get(death.id) || { id: death.id, name: death.name, count: 0 };
13623:       current.count += Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(death.count) || 1));
13624:       fishById.set(death.id, current);
13625:     }
13626:   }
13627:   const plantById = new Map();
13628:   for (const notice of plantPending) {
13629:     for (const loss of notice.withered || []) {
13630:       if (!loss?.id || !loss?.name) continue;
13631:       const current = plantById.get(loss.id) || { id: loss.id, name: loss.name, count: 0 };
13632:       current.count += Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(loss.count) || 1));
13633:       plantById.set(loss.id, current);
13634:     }
13635:   }
13636: 
13637:   const deaths = [...fishById.values()];
13638:   const withered = [...plantById.values()];
13639:   const fishTotal = deaths.reduce((sum, death) => sum + death.count, 0);
13640:   const plantTotal = withered.reduce((sum, loss) => sum + loss.count, 0);
13641:   if (!fishTotal && !plantTotal) return null;
13642: 
13643:   const latestToneSource = [fishPending[fishPending.length - 1], plantPending[plantPending.length - 1]]
13644:     .filter(Boolean)
13645:     .sort((a, b) => (Number(a.day) || 0) - (Number(b.day) || 0))
13646:     .at(-1);
13647:   const tone = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, Math.floor(Number(latestToneSource?.tone) || 0)));
13648:   const fishSingleName = deaths.length === 1 ? deaths[0].name : '';
13649:   const plantSingleName = withered.length === 1 ? withered[0].name : '';
13650: 
13651:   const singleFishPhrases = [
13652:     `水槽の底に、${fishSingleName}が一匹沈んでいる。`,
13653:     `昨日まで泳いでいた${fishSingleName}が、動かなくなっている。`,
13654:     `${fishSingleName}が一匹、静かに横たわっている。`,
13655:     `水槽を見ると、${fishSingleName}が一匹いなくなっている。`,
13656:     `${fishSingleName}が一匹、もう泳いでいない。`,
13657:     `水槽の隅で、${fishSingleName}が動かなくなっている。`,
13658:   ];
13659:   const multipleFishPhrases = [
13660:     '水槽を見ると、何匹か動かなくなっている。',
13661:     '水槽の様子がいつもと違う。何匹か死んでいる。',
13662:     '昨日より、水槽が少し静かになっている。',
13663:     '水槽を覗くと、何匹かいなくなっている。',
13664:     '水槽の中で、何匹かがもう泳いでいない。',
13665:     '水槽を見ていると、何匹かの姿がないことに気づく。',
13666:   ];
13667:   const singlePlantPhrases = [
13668:     `${plantSingleName}が一株、茶色く枯れている。`,
13669:     `水槽を見ると、${plantSingleName}が一株しおれている。`,
13670:     `${plantSingleName}が一株、昨日より弱って枯れている。`,
13671:     `水槽の${plantSingleName}が一株なくなっている。`,
13672:     `${plantSingleName}の一株が、静かに枯れている。`,
13673:     `水槽の隅で、${plantSingleName}が一株枯れている。`,
13674:   ];
13675:   const multiplePlantPhrases = [
13676:     '水草の一部が茶色く枯れている。',
13677:     '水槽を見ると、いくつかの水草がしおれている。',
13678:     '昨日より、水草が少し減っている。',
13679:     '水槽を覗くと、何株かの水草が枯れている。',
13680:     '水草の一部が弱り、そのままなくなっている。',
13681:     '水槽の景色が少し変わっている。何株か枯れたようだ。',
13682:   ];
13683:   const mixedPhrases = [
13684:     '水槽を見ると、魚と水草の様子が昨日と違う。',
13685:     '水槽の中で、魚も水草もいくつか失われている。',
13686:     '昨日より水槽が少し静かで、水草も減っている。',
13687:     '水槽を覗くと、魚と水草の両方に変化がある。',
13688:     '水槽の景色が変わっている。魚も水草もいくつかなくなった。',
13689:     '水槽の中に、昨日とは違う静けさがある。',
13690:   ];
13691: 
13692:   let message = '';
13693:   if (fishTotal && plantTotal) message = mixedPhrases[tone];
13694:   else if (fishTotal) message = fishTotal === 1 && deaths.length === 1 ? singleFishPhrases[tone] : multipleFishPhrases[tone];
13695:   else message = plantTotal === 1 && withered.length === 1 ? singlePlantPhrases[tone] : multiplePlantPhrases[tone];
13696: 
13697:   return { total: fishTotal + plantTotal, fishTotal, plantTotal, deaths, withered, message };
13698: }

13755: function setAquariumItemQuantity(id, quantity, metadata = {}) {
13756:   const aquarium = aquariumState(), safeId = String(id || '').trim().slice(0, 100), qty = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(quantity) || 0)); if (!safeId) return false;
13757:   const category = metadata.category || (aquarium.fish[safeId] ? 'fish' : aquarium.plants[safeId] ? 'plant' : aquarium.displayItems[safeId] ? 'display' : '');
13758:   const collection = category === 'fish' ? aquarium.fish : category === 'plant' ? aquarium.plants : category === 'display' ? aquarium.displayItems : null;
13759:   if (!collection?.[safeId]) return false;
13760:   const key = category === 'display' ? 'owned' : 'owned', previous = collection[safeId][key]; collection[safeId][key] = qty;
13761:   if (category === 'fish') { collection[safeId].inTank = Math.min(collection[safeId].inTank, qty); ensureAquariumFishIndividuals(aquarium, state?.game?.day || 1); }
13762:   if (category === 'plant') { collection[safeId].inTank = Math.min(collection[safeId].inTank, qty); ensureAquariumPlantIndividuals(aquarium, state?.game?.day || 1); }
13763:   if (category === 'display') collection[safeId].installed = Math.min(collection[safeId].installed, qty);
13764:   const changed = previous !== qty; if (changed) { aquarium.lastSyncRevision += 1; refreshAquariumLoad(aquarium); }
13765:   return changed;
13766: }
13767: function addAquariumItem(id, quantity = 1, metadata = {}) {
13768:   const aquarium = aquariumState(), safeId = String(id || '').trim().slice(0, 100), qty = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(quantity) || 0)); if (!safeId || !qty) return false;
13769:   const category = metadata.category || (aquarium.fish[safeId] ? 'fish' : aquarium.plants[safeId] ? 'plant' : aquarium.displayItems[safeId] ? 'display' : '');
13770:   const check = category === 'fish' ? canAcquireAquariumFish(safeId, qty) : category === 'plant' ? canAcquireAquariumPlant(safeId, qty) : category === 'display' ? canAcquireAquariumDisplay(safeId, qty) : aquariumLimitResult(false, 'unknown');
13771:   if (!check.ok) { if (check.message) showToast(check.message); return false; }
13772:   const row = category === 'fish' ? aquarium.fish[safeId] : category === 'plant' ? aquarium.plants[safeId] : aquarium.displayItems[safeId];
13773:   if (category === 'fish') ensureAquariumFishIndividuals(aquarium, state?.game?.day || 1);
13774:   if (category === 'plant') ensureAquariumPlantIndividuals(aquarium, state?.game?.day || 1);
13775:   row.owned += qty;
13776:   if (category === 'fish') addAquariumFishIndividuals(safeId, qty, aquarium, state?.game?.day || 1);
13777:   if (category === 'plant') addAquariumPlantIndividuals(safeId, qty, aquarium, state?.game?.day || 1);
13778:   aquarium.lastSyncRevision += 1; return true;
13779: }

13818: function aquariumCurrentObservationNames(snapshot = aquariumSnapshot(), engine = null) {
13819:   const names = new Set();
13820:   const fishRegistry = engine?.config?.speciesProfiles || {};
13821:   const decorationRegistry = engine?.config?.decorationProfiles || {};
13822:   for (const definition of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.fish) {
13823:     if (Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.fish?.[definition.id]?.inTank) || 0)) <= 0) continue;
13824:     names.add(normalizeAquariumObservationName(definition.name));
13825:     const engineId = aquariumEngineCompatibleId(fishRegistry, definition.id, AQUARIUM_ENGINE_FISH_ALIASES);
13826:     if (engineId) names.add(normalizeAquariumObservationName(fishRegistry[engineId]?.displayName));
13827:   }
13828:   for (const definition of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.plants) {
13829:     if (Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.plants?.[definition.id]?.inTank) || 0)) <= 0) continue;
13830:     names.add(normalizeAquariumObservationName(definition.name));
13831:     const engineId = aquariumEngineCompatibleId(decorationRegistry, definition.id, AQUARIUM_ENGINE_PLANT_ALIASES);
13832:     if (engineId) names.add(normalizeAquariumObservationName(decorationRegistry[engineId]?.displayName));
13833:   }

13835:   for (const definition of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.displayItems) {
13836:     const installed = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.displayItems?.[definition.id]?.installed) || 0));
13837:     if (!definition.required && installed <= 0) continue;
13838:     names.add(normalizeAquariumObservationName(definition.name));
13839:     const engineId = aquariumEngineCompatibleId(decorationRegistry, definition.id, AQUARIUM_ENGINE_LAYOUT_ALIASES);
13840:     if (engineId) names.add(normalizeAquariumObservationName(decorationRegistry[engineId]?.displayName));
13841:   }
13842:   names.delete('');
13843:   return names;
13844: }

13846: function aquariumPlacedDiscoveryNames(snapshot = aquariumSnapshot(), engine = null) {
13847:   const names = new Set();
13848:   const fishRegistry = engine?.config?.speciesProfiles || {};
13849:   const decorationRegistry = engine?.config?.decorationProfiles || {};
13850:   for (const definition of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.fish) {
13851:     // v0.10.619: 所持しただけでは図鑑・一覧・詳細を解放しない。
13852:     // 実際に水槽へ入っている魚だけを既知扱いにする。
13853:     if (Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.fish?.[definition.id]?.inTank) || 0)) <= 0) continue;
13854:     names.add(normalizeAquariumObservationName(definition.name));
13855:     const engineId = aquariumEngineCompatibleId(fishRegistry, definition.id, AQUARIUM_ENGINE_FISH_ALIASES);
13856:     if (engineId) names.add(normalizeAquariumObservationName(fishRegistry[engineId]?.displayName));
13857:   }
13858:   for (const definition of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.plants) {
13859:     // 水草も実際に水槽へ入っている種類だけ表示・詳細閲覧を許可する。
13860:     if (Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.plants?.[definition.id]?.inTank) || 0)) <= 0) continue;
13861:     names.add(normalizeAquariumObservationName(definition.name));
13862:     const engineId = aquariumEngineCompatibleId(decorationRegistry, definition.id, AQUARIUM_ENGINE_PLANT_ALIASES);
13863:     if (engineId) names.add(normalizeAquariumObservationName(decorationRegistry[engineId]?.displayName));
13864:   }
13865:   for (const definition of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.displayItems) {
13866:     // 任意用品は設置されているものだけ既知扱いにする。必須用品は既存仕様を維持。
13867:     if (!definition.required && Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.displayItems?.[definition.id]?.installed) || 0)) <= 0) continue;
13868:     if (definition.required || Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.displayItems?.[definition.id]?.installed) || 0)) > 0) {
13869:       names.add(normalizeAquariumObservationName(definition.name));
13870:       const engineId = aquariumEngineCompatibleId(decorationRegistry, definition.id, AQUARIUM_ENGINE_LAYOUT_ALIASES);
13871:       if (engineId) names.add(normalizeAquariumObservationName(decorationRegistry[engineId]?.displayName));
13872:     }
13873:   }
13874:   return names;
13875: }

13909: 
13910:     // 名前がDOMに出ていないカードや詳細ボタンも、IDから未解放種を判定して消す。
13911:     // これにより画像だけのカード・selectのvalue・data属性経由の詳細導線も先に見えない。
13912:     const fishRegistry = engine?.config?.speciesProfiles || {};
13913:     const decorationRegistry = engine?.config?.decorationProfiles || {};
13914:     const allowedIds = new Set();
13915:     const knownIds = new Set();
13916:     const addIds = (set, values) => values.filter(Boolean).forEach((value) => set.add(String(value).trim().toLowerCase()));
13917:     for (const definition of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.fish) {
13918:       const engineId = aquariumEngineCompatibleId(fishRegistry, definition.id, AQUARIUM_ENGINE_FISH_ALIASES);
13919:       addIds(knownIds, [definition.id, engineId]);
13920:       if (Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.fish?.[definition.id]?.inTank) || 0)) > 0) addIds(allowedIds, [definition.id, engineId]);
13921:     }
13922:     for (const definition of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.plants) {
13923:       const engineId = aquariumEngineCompatibleId(decorationRegistry, definition.id, AQUARIUM_ENGINE_PLANT_ALIASES);
13924:       addIds(knownIds, [definition.id, engineId]);
13925:       if (Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.plants?.[definition.id]?.inTank) || 0)) > 0) addIds(allowedIds, [definition.id, engineId]);
13926:     }
13927:     for (const definition of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.displayItems) {
13928:       const engineId = aquariumEngineCompatibleId(decorationRegistry, definition.id, AQUARIUM_ENGINE_LAYOUT_ALIASES);
13929:       addIds(knownIds, [definition.id, engineId]);
13930:       if (definition.required || Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.displayItems?.[definition.id]?.installed) || 0)) > 0) addIds(allowedIds, [definition.id, engineId]);
13931:     }
13932:     const hiddenIds = new Set([...knownIds].filter((id) => !allowedIds.has(id)));
13933:     const containsHiddenName = (text) => {
13934:       const normalized = normalizeAquariumObservationName(text);
13935:       return normalized && hiddenNames.some((name) => name && normalized.includes(name));
13936:     };
13937:     const containsHiddenId = (node) => {
13938:       if (!(node instanceof Element)) return false;
13939:       const values = [
13940:         node.getAttribute('value'), node.getAttribute('data-item-id'), node.getAttribute('data-species'),
13941:         node.getAttribute('data-species-id'), node.getAttribute('data-id'), node.getAttribute('data-detail-id'),
13942:         node.getAttribute('data-fish-id'), node.getAttribute('data-plant-id'),
13943:       ].filter(Boolean).map((value) => String(value).trim().toLowerCase());
13944:       return values.some((value) => hiddenIds.has(value));
13945:     };
13946: 
13947:     documentRef.querySelectorAll('option').forEach((option) => {
13948:       if (containsHiddenName(option.textContent) || containsHiddenId(option)) option.remove();
13949:     });
13950: 
13951:     documentRef.querySelectorAll('[data-item-id],[data-species],[data-species-id],[data-id],[data-detail-id],[data-fish-id],[data-plant-id]').forEach((node) => {
13952:       if (!containsHiddenId(node)) return;
13953:       const row = node.closest('.item-card,.inventory-item,.collection-item,.catalog-item,.option-card,.shop-item,.list-item,tr,li');
13954:       (row || node).remove();
13955:     });
13956: 
13957:     const leafSelectors = '.item-name,.species-name,.plant-name,.decoration-name,.inventory-name,.collection-name,.catalog-name,[data-item-name],[data-species-name]';
13958:     documentRef.querySelectorAll(leafSelectors).forEach((nameNode) => {
13959:       if (!containsHiddenName(nameNode.textContent || nameNode.getAttribute('data-item-name') || nameNode.getAttribute('data-species-name'))) return;
13960:       const row = nameNode.closest('.item-card,.inventory-item,.collection-item,.catalog-item,.option-card,.shop-item,.list-item,tr,li');
13961:       (row || nameNode).remove();
13962:     });
13963: 
13964:     const candidateSelectors = '.item-card,.inventory-item,.collection-item,.catalog-item,.option-card,.shop-item,.list-item,tr,li,[data-item-id],[data-species]';
13965:     documentRef.querySelectorAll(candidateSelectors).forEach((node) => {
13966:       if (containsHiddenName(node.textContent)) node.remove();
13967:     });
13968: 
13969:     // カード構造に含まれない説明文・ボタン・ラベルに将来品名が出た場合も伏せる。
13970:     documentRef.querySelectorAll('button,label,span,strong,p,small,td,th').forEach((node) => {
13971:       if (!containsHiddenName(node.textContent)) return;
13972:       const row = node.closest('.item-card,.inventory-item,.collection-item,.catalog-item,.option-card,.shop-item,.list-item,tr,li');
13973:       (row || node).remove();
13974:     });
13975:     return true;
13976:   } catch (_) {
13977:     return false;
13978:   }
13979: }

13981: function filterAquariumObservationDocument(frame) {

13989:     });

14003: function installAquariumObservationGuard(frame) {
14004:   try {
14005:     const documentRef = frame?.contentDocument;
14006:     if (!documentRef?.documentElement) return false;
14007:     if (frame.__jxjObservationObserver) return true;
14008:     const Observer = frame.contentWindow?.MutationObserver || MutationObserver;
14009:     const observer = new Observer(() => {
14010:       filterAquariumObservationDocument(frame);
14011:       filterAquariumUndiscoveredDocument(frame);
14012:     });
14013:     observer.observe(documentRef.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
14014:     frame.__jxjObservationObserver = observer;
14015:     filterAquariumObservationDocument(frame);
14016:     filterAquariumUndiscoveredDocument(frame);
14017:     return true;
14018:   } catch (_) {
14019:     return false;

14046: function syncAquariumRuntime(frame = document.querySelector('.aquarium-game-frame'), options = {}) {
14047:   const force = Boolean(options.force);
14048:   if (!frame?.contentWindow) return false;
14049:   try {
14050:     const aquariumWindow = frame.contentWindow;
14051:     const engine = aquariumWindow.aquariumEngine;
14052:     if (!engine || typeof engine.getObservationEntries !== 'function') return false;
14053: 
14054:     if (!engine.__jxjObservationFilterInstalled) {
14055:       const originalGetObservationEntries = engine.getObservationEntries.bind(engine);
14056:       engine.getObservationEntries = () => {
14057:         const allowed = engine.__jxjAllowedObservationKeys;
14058:         return originalGetObservationEntries().filter((entry) => {
14059:           const category = entry?.category === 'plant' ? 'plants' : entry?.category;
14060:           if (!entry || !['fish', 'plants'].includes(category)) return false;
14061:           return !(allowed instanceof Set) || allowed.has(`${category}:${entry.id}`);
14062:         });
14063:       };
14064:       engine.__jxjObservationFilterInstalled = true;
14065:     }
14066: 
14067:     const snapshot = aquariumSnapshot();
14068:     const fingerprint = aquariumRuntimeFingerprint(snapshot);
14069:     if (force || engine.__jxjMainGameFingerprint !== fingerprint) {
14070:       const fishRegistry = engine.config?.speciesProfiles || {};
14071:       const decorationRegistry = engine.config?.decorationProfiles || {};
14072:       const allowedObservationKeys = new Set();
14073:       const wasRunning = Boolean(engine.running);
14074:       engine.stop?.();
14075:       engine.clear?.({ keepAcquisitionHistory: false, keepLossLedger: false });
14076: 
14077:       for (const definition of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.fish) {
14078:         const count = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.fish?.[definition.id]?.inTank) || 0));
14079:         if (count <= 0) continue;
14080:         const engineId = aquariumEngineCompatibleId(fishRegistry, definition.id, AQUARIUM_ENGINE_FISH_ALIASES);
14081:         if (!engineId) continue;
14082:         allowedObservationKeys.add(`fish:${engineId}`);
14083:         for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) engine.addFish?.({ species: engineId });
14084:       }
14085: 
14086:       for (const definition of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.plants) {
14087:         const count = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.plants?.[definition.id]?.inTank) || 0));
14088:         if (count <= 0) continue;
14089:         const engineId = aquariumEngineCompatibleId(decorationRegistry, definition.id, AQUARIUM_ENGINE_PLANT_ALIASES);
14090:         if (!engineId) continue;
14091:         allowedObservationKeys.add(`plants:${engineId}`);
14092:         for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) engine.addDecoration?.({ itemId: engineId, category: 'plants' });
14093:       }
14094: 
14095:       for (const definition of AQUARIUM_CONFIG.displayItems.filter((entry) => !entry.required)) {
14096:         const count = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.displayItems?.[definition.id]?.installed) || 0));
14097:         if (count <= 0) continue;
14098:         const engineId = aquariumEngineCompatibleId(decorationRegistry, definition.id, AQUARIUM_ENGINE_LAYOUT_ALIASES);
14099:         if (!engineId) continue;
14100:         for (let index = 0; index < count; index += 1) engine.addDecoration?.({ itemId: engineId, category: 'layout' });
14101:       }
14102: 
14103:       engine.__jxjAllowedObservationKeys = allowedObservationKeys;
14104:       engine.__jxjMainGameFingerprint = fingerprint;
14105:       if (wasRunning || engine.options?.autoStart !== false) engine.start?.();
14106:     }
14107: 
14108:     installAquariumObservationGuard(frame);
14109:     filterAquariumObservationDocument(frame);
14110:     filterAquariumUndiscoveredDocument(frame);
14111:     return true;
14112:   } catch (error) {
14113:     console.warn('水槽ミニゲームの現在配置同期に失敗しました。', error);
14114:     return false;
14115:   }
14116: }

14125: function bindAquariumFrameSync() {
14126:   const frame = document.querySelector('.aquarium-game-frame');
14127:   if (!(frame instanceof HTMLIFrameElement)) return;
14128:   const forceFreshSyncs = () => {
14129:     for (const delay of [120, 450, 1000, 1800]) {
14130:       window.setTimeout(() => {
14131:         if (!frame.isConnected) return;
14132:         postAquariumSnapshot(frame);
14133:       }, delay);
14134:     }
14135:   };
14136:   const sync = () => {
14137:     postAquariumSnapshot(frame);
14138:     installAquariumPortraitCentering(frame);
14139:     forceFreshSyncs();
14140:   };
14141:   if (frame.dataset.jxjSyncBound !== '1') {
14142:     frame.dataset.jxjSyncBound = '1';
14143:     frame.addEventListener('load', () => {
14144:       sync();
14145:       [80, 260, 700, 1400].forEach((delay) => window.setTimeout(sync, delay));
14146:     });
14147:   }
14148:   sync();
14149:   [80, 260, 700, 1400].forEach((delay) => window.setTimeout(sync, delay));
14150: }

14160: function validFinancePeriod(value) {
14161:   return ['today', 'month', 'year', 'cumulative'].includes(value) ? value : 'today';
14162: }

14164: function financePeriodRows(period = state?.game?.financePeriod) {
14165:   const resolved = validFinancePeriod(period);
14166:   const current = gameDate();
14167:   return (state?.finance || []).filter((row) => {
14168:     if (resolved === 'cumulative') return true;
14169:     const rowDate = gameDateForDay(row.day);
14170:     if (resolved === 'today') return Number(row.day) === Number(state.game.day);
14171:     if (resolved === 'month') {
14172:       return rowDate.getFullYear() === current.getFullYear() && rowDate.getMonth() === current.getMonth();
14173:     }
14174:     return rowDate.getFullYear() === current.getFullYear();
14175:   });
14176: }

14178: function financePeriodTotals(period = state?.game?.financePeriod, rows = financePeriodRows(period)) {
14179:   const resolved = validFinancePeriod(period);
14180:   const summary = state?.financeSummary && typeof state.financeSummary === 'object' ? state.financeSummary : {};
14181:   const currentKey = dateKey(gameDate());
14182:   let income = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + Number(row.income || 0), 0);
14183:   let expense = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + Number(row.expense || 0), 0);
14184:   if (resolved === 'cumulative') {
14185:     income += Math.max(0, Number(summary.archivedIncome) || 0);
14186:     expense += Math.max(0, Number(summary.archivedExpense) || 0);
14187:   } else if (resolved === 'today' && String(summary.dayKey || '') === currentKey) {
14188:     income += Math.max(0, Number(summary.dayIncome) || 0);
14189:     expense += Math.max(0, Number(summary.dayExpense) || 0);
14190:   } else if (resolved === 'month' && String(summary.monthKey || '') === currentKey.slice(0, 7)) {
14191:     income += Math.max(0, Number(summary.monthIncome) || 0);
14192:     expense += Math.max(0, Number(summary.monthExpense) || 0);
14193:   } else if (resolved === 'year' && String(summary.yearKey || '') === currentKey.slice(0, 4)) {
14194:     income += Math.max(0, Number(summary.yearIncome) || 0);
14195:     expense += Math.max(0, Number(summary.yearExpense) || 0);
14196:   }
14197:   return { income, expense };
14198: }

14217: function materialRequirementsFor({ item, gem, looseShape, metal, orderId = null, useLoose = true }) {
14218:   const order = orderId ? state.orders.find((entry) => entry.id === orderId) : null;
14219:   const itemData = ITEMS[item] || ITEMS.ring;
14220:   const usesLoose = order ? true : useLoose !== false;
14221:   const resolvedLooseShape = normalizeLooseShape(gem, order?.looseShape || looseShape);
14222:   const requiredMetalWeight = roundedMetalWeight(Math.max(0.1, Number(order?.requiredMetalWeight) || Number(itemData.metalWeight) || 1));
14223:   const requiredLooseQuantity = usesLoose ? Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(order?.requiredLooseQuantity) || Number(itemData.looseQuantity) || 1)) : 0;
14224:   const ownedMetalWeight = metalOwnedWeight(metal);
14225:   const reservedMetalWeight = metalReservedWeight(metal);
14226:   const availableMetalWeight = metalAvailableWeight(metal, order?.id || '');
14227:   const ownedLooseQuantity = usesLoose ? looseOwned(gem, resolvedLooseShape) : 0;
14228:   const reservedLooseQuantity = usesLoose ? looseReservedQuantity(gem, resolvedLooseShape) : 0;
14229:   const reservedLooseOtherOrders = usesLoose ? (order ? looseReservedQuantity(gem, resolvedLooseShape, order.id) : reservedLooseQuantity) : 0;
14230:   const availableLooseQuantity = usesLoose ? Math.max(0, ownedLooseQuantity - reservedLooseOtherOrders) : 0;
14231:   const missingMetalWeight = roundedMetalWeight(Math.max(0, requiredMetalWeight - availableMetalWeight));
14232:   const missingLooseQuantity = usesLoose ? Math.max(0, requiredLooseQuantity - availableLooseQuantity) : 0;
14233:   return {
14234:     usesLoose,
14235:     looseShape: resolvedLooseShape,
14236:     requiredMetalWeight, requiredLooseQuantity, ownedMetalWeight, reservedMetalWeight, availableMetalWeight,
14237:     ownedLooseQuantity, reservedLooseQuantity, reservedLooseOtherOrders, availableLooseQuantity,
14238:     missingMetalWeight, missingLooseQuantity,
14239:     enoughMetal: availableMetalWeight + 1e-9 >= requiredMetalWeight,
14240:     enoughLoose: !usesLoose || availableLooseQuantity >= requiredLooseQuantity,
14241:   };
14242: }
14243: 
14244: function orderRequirements(order) {
14245:   return materialRequirementsFor({ ...order, orderId: order.id });
14246: }

14543: function normalizeCinemaEventVideoName(value) {
14544:   const name = String(value || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').pop() || '';
14545:   if (!name || name === '.' || name === '..' || !/\.(mp4|webm|ogg|mov)$/i.test(name)) return '';
14546:   return name;
14547: }
14548: 
14549: async function loadCinemaEventVideos() {
14550:   if (!cinemaEventVideosPromise) {
14551:     cinemaEventVideosPromise = (async () => {
14552:       const controller = new AbortController();
14553:       const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 5000);
14554:       try {
14555:         const response = await fetch(CINEMA_EVENT_VIDEO_MANIFEST_URL, { cache: 'no-store', signal: controller.signal });
14556:         if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`cinema video manifest ${response.status}`);
14557:         const data = await response.json();
14558:         const raw = Array.isArray(data) ? data : Array.isArray(data?.videos) ? data.videos : [];
14559:         return [...new Set(raw.map(normalizeCinemaEventVideoName).filter(Boolean))];
14560:       } catch (error) {
14561:         console.warn('映画館イベントの動画一覧を読み込めませんでした。', error);
14562:         cinemaEventVideosPromise = null;
14563:         return [];
14564:       } finally {
14565:         window.clearTimeout(timeout);
14566:       }
14567:     })();
14568:   }
14569:   return cinemaEventVideosPromise;
14570: }
14571: 
14572: function cinemaVisitEventState() {
14573:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
14574:   const saved = state.events.cinemaVisitEvent && typeof state.events.cinemaVisitEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.cinemaVisitEvent)
14575:     ? state.events.cinemaVisitEvent
14576:     : {};
14577:   const validStages = new Set(['idle', 'invitation', 'playing', 'completed']);
14578:   state.events.cinemaVisitEvent = {
14579:     lastCheckedDate: /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(saved.lastCheckedDate || '')) ? String(saved.lastCheckedDate) : '',
14580:     lastTriggeredDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastTriggeredDay) || 0)),
14581:     totalTriggered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)),
14582:     active: Boolean(saved.active),
14583:     stage: validStages.has(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : 'idle',
14584:     selectedVideo: normalizeCinemaEventVideoName(saved.selectedVideo),
14585:     lastVideo: normalizeCinemaEventVideoName(saved.lastVideo),
14586:     settled: Boolean(saved.settled),
14587:   };
14588:   if (!state.events.cinemaVisitEvent.active && !['idle', 'completed'].includes(state.events.cinemaVisitEvent.stage)) {
14589:     state.events.cinemaVisitEvent.stage = 'completed';
14590:   }
14591:   return state.events.cinemaVisitEvent;
14592: }

14597:   setScreen('cinemaVisitEvent', {}, false);
14598:   return true;
14599: }
