14601: function chooseCinemaEventVideo(videos, previous = '') {
14602:   if (!videos.length) return '';
14603:   if (videos.length === 1) return videos[0];
14604:   const filtered = videos.filter((name) => name !== previous);
14605:   return filtered[Math.floor(Math.random() * filtered.length)] || videos[Math.floor(Math.random() * videos.length)];
14606: }
14607: 
14608: async function maybeStartCinemaVisitEvent() {
14609:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) return false;
14610:   const eventState = cinemaVisitEventState();
14611:   if (eventState.active) return resumeCinemaVisitEvent();
14612:   if (!cinemaEventDateEligible()) return false;
14613:   if (Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state?.game?.money) || 0)) < CINEMA_VISIT_EVENT_COST) return false;
14614:   if (!canSpendHours(CINEMA_VISIT_EVENT_HOURS)) return false;
14615:   const videos = await loadCinemaEventVideos();
14616:   if (!videos.length) return false;
14617:   if (!markVisitEventCheckOncePerDay(eventState)) return false;
14618:   if (Math.random() >= CINEMA_VISIT_EVENT_CHANCE) {
14619:     saveGame();
14620:     return false;
14621:   }
14622:   eventState.lastTriggeredDay = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(state?.game?.day) || 1));
14623:   eventState.totalTriggered += 1;
14624:   eventState.active = true;
14625:   eventState.stage = 'invitation';
14626:   eventState.selectedVideo = chooseCinemaEventVideo(videos, eventState.lastVideo);
14627:   eventState.settled = false;
14628:   saveGame();
14629:   setScreen('cinemaVisitEvent', {}, false);
14630:   playSfx('impact', { gain: 0.56, rate: 0.88 });
14631:   vibrate([18, 26, 40]);
14632:   return true;
14633: }
14634:

14638:   eventState.stage = 'playing';
14639:   saveGame();
14640:   playSfx('success', { gain: 0.62, rate: 0.9 });
14641:   render();
14642: }

14649: function startCinemaVisitPlayback() {
14650:   const video = root.querySelector('video[data-cinema-event-video]');
14651:   if (!(video instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return;
14652:   video.volume = 1;

14654:   if (playPromise && typeof playPromise.catch === 'function') {
14655:     playPromise
14656:       .then(() => video.closest('.cinema-video-stage')?.classList.add('is-playing'))
14657:       .catch(() => video.closest('.cinema-video-stage')?.classList.add('needs-start'));
14658:   }
14659: }

14667: async function completeCinemaVisitEvent() {
14668:   const eventState = cinemaVisitEventState();
14669:   if (!eventState.active || eventState.stage !== 'playing') return;
14670:   if (!eventState.settled) {
14671:     eventState.settled = true;
14672:     eventState.lastVideo = eventState.selectedVideo;
14673:     state.game.money = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.game.money) || 0) - CINEMA_VISIT_EVENT_COST);
14674:     spendHours(CINEMA_VISIT_EVENT_HOURS);
14675:     addFinance('映画館で映画鑑賞', 0, CINEMA_VISIT_EVENT_COST);
14676:     addNotification('映画を観ました', `${CINEMA_VISIT_EVENT_HOURS}時間が経過し、${yen(CINEMA_VISIT_EVENT_COST)}を支払いました。`, 'special');
14677:   }
14678:   eventState.active = false;
14679:   eventState.stage = 'completed';
14680:   eventState.selectedVideo = '';
14681:   saveGame();
14682:   await resumeAudio();
14683:   playSfx('success', { gain: 0.72 });
14684:   vibrate([18, 24, 42]);
14685:   setScreen('okachimachi', {}, false);
14686: }

14722: function apprenticeCinemaEventState() {
14723:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
14724:   const saved = state.events.apprenticeCinemaEvent && typeof state.events.apprenticeCinemaEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.apprenticeCinemaEvent)
14725:     ? state.events.apprenticeCinemaEvent
14726:     : {};
14727:   const validStages = new Set(['idle', 'intro1', 'intro2', 'intro3', 'playing', 'outro1', 'outro2', 'completed']);
14728:   state.events.apprenticeCinemaEvent = {

14730:     stage: validStages.has(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : 'idle',
14731:     selectedVideo: normalizeCinemaEventVideoName(saved.selectedVideo),
14732:     lastVideo: normalizeCinemaEventVideoName(saved.lastVideo),
14733:     settled: Boolean(saved.settled),
14734:     totalTriggered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)),
14735:     lastTriggeredDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastTriggeredDay) || 0)),
14736:   };
14737:   if (!state.events.apprenticeCinemaEvent.active && !['idle', 'completed'].includes(state.events.apprenticeCinemaEvent.stage)) {
14738:     state.events.apprenticeCinemaEvent.stage = 'completed';

14740:   return state.events.apprenticeCinemaEvent;

14750: async function maybeStartApprenticeCinemaEvent() {
14751:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) return false;
14752:   const eventState = apprenticeCinemaEventState();
14753:   if (eventState.active) return resumeApprenticeCinemaEvent();
14754:   const staff = workshopStaffState();
14755:   if (staff.everHired || staff.hired) return false;
14756:   if (!apprenticeCinemaEventWeekendEligible()) return false;
14757:   if (Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state?.game?.money) || 0)) < APPRENTICE_CINEMA_EVENT_COST) return false;
14758:   if (!canSpendHours(APPRENTICE_CINEMA_EVENT_HOURS)) return false;
14759:   const videos = await loadCinemaEventVideos();
14760:   if (!videos.length) return false;
14761:   // 「30回に1回くらい」なので、厳密な1/30ではなく3%抽選。御徒町へ入るたびに抽選する。
14762:   if (Math.random() >= APPRENTICE_CINEMA_EVENT_CHANCE) return false;
14763:   eventState.active = true;
14764:   eventState.stage = 'intro1';
14765:   eventState.selectedVideo = chooseCinemaEventVideo(videos, eventState.lastVideo);
14766:   eventState.settled = false;
14767:   eventState.totalTriggered += 1;

14769:   state.game.screen = 'apprenticeCinemaEvent';
14770:   saveGame();
14771:   setScreen('apprenticeCinemaEvent', {}, false);
14772:   playSfx('impact', { gain: 0.54, rate: 0.9 });
14773:   setTimeout(() => playSfx('success', { gain: 0.38, rate: 1.12 }), 90);
14774:   vibrate([18, 24, 42]);
14775:   return true;
14776: }

15028:   const name = String(value || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').pop() || '';
15029:   return MYSTERY_CHINESE_MEAL_EVENT_IMAGES.includes(name) ? name : '';

15032: function chooseMysteryChineseMealImage(previous = '') {
15033:   const images = [...MYSTERY_CHINESE_MEAL_EVENT_IMAGES];
15034:   if (!images.length) return '';
15035:   if (images.length === 1) return images[0];
15036:   const filtered = images.filter((name) => name !== previous);
15037:   return filtered[Math.floor(Math.random() * filtered.length)] || images[Math.floor(Math.random() * images.length)] || images[0];
15038: }

15153: function mysteryChineseMealEventState() {
15154:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
15155:   const saved = state.events.mysteryChineseMealEvent && typeof state.events.mysteryChineseMealEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.mysteryChineseMealEvent)
15156:     ? state.events.mysteryChineseMealEvent
15157:     : {};
15158:   const dialogueStages = new Set(['intro1', 'intro2', 'intro3', 'reward', 'eating', 'postMeal']);
15159:   const validStages = new Set(['idle', 'video', ...dialogueStages, 'completed']);
15160:   state.events.mysteryChineseMealEvent = {
15161:     lastCheckedDate: /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(saved.lastCheckedDate || '')) ? String(saved.lastCheckedDate) : '',
15162:     lastTriggeredDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.lastTriggeredDay) || 0)),
15163:     totalTriggered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)),
15164:     active: Boolean(saved.active),
15165:     stage: validStages.has(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : 'idle',
15166:     selectedDish: normalizeMysteryChineseMealImageName(saved.selectedDish),
15167:     lastDish: normalizeMysteryChineseMealImageName(saved.lastDish),
15168:     mealApplied: Boolean(saved.mealApplied),
15169:     hungerBefore: Math.max(0, Math.min(7, Math.floor(Number(saved.hungerBefore) || 0))),
15170:     hungerAfter: Math.max(0, Math.min(7, Math.floor(Number(saved.hungerAfter) || 0))),
15171:     introVideoCompleted: Boolean(saved.introVideoCompleted),
15172:     stageAfterVideo: dialogueStages.has(saved.stageAfterVideo) ? saved.stageAfterVideo : '',
15173:   };
15174:   const eventState = state.events.mysteryChineseMealEvent;
15175:   if (!eventState.active) {
15176:     if (!['idle', 'completed'].includes(eventState.stage)) eventState.stage = 'completed';
15177:     eventState.stageAfterVideo = '';
15178:     if (eventState.stage === 'completed') eventState.introVideoCompleted = true;
15179:     return eventState;
15180:   }
15181:   if (!eventState.introVideoCompleted) {
15182:     if (eventState.stage !== 'video') eventState.stageAfterVideo = dialogueStages.has(eventState.stage) ? eventState.stage : (eventState.stageAfterVideo || 'intro1');
15183:     if (!eventState.stageAfterVideo) eventState.stageAfterVideo = 'intro1';
15184:     eventState.stage = 'video';
15185:   }
15186:   return eventState;
15187: }
15188: function resumeMysteryChineseMealEvent() {
15189:   const eventState = mysteryChineseMealEventState();
15190:   if (!eventState.active) return false;
15191:   setScreen('mysteryChineseMealEvent', { mealId: 'chinese' }, false);
15192:   return true;
15193: }

15195: function maybeStartMysteryChineseMealEvent() {
15196:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) return false;
15197:   const eventState = mysteryChineseMealEventState();
15198:   if (eventState.active) return resumeMysteryChineseMealEvent();
15199:   if (Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state?.game?.money) || 0)) < MYSTERY_CHINESE_MEAL_EVENT_COST) return false;
15200:   if (!markVisitEventCheckOncePerDay(eventState)) return false;
15201:   if (Math.random() >= MYSTERY_CHINESE_MEAL_EVENT_CHANCE) {
15202:     saveGame();
15203:     return false;
15204:   }
15205:   eventState.lastTriggeredDay = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(state?.game?.day) || 1));
15206:   eventState.totalTriggered += 1;
15207:   eventState.active = true;
15208:   eventState.stage = 'video';
15209:   eventState.stageAfterVideo = 'intro1';
15210:   eventState.introVideoCompleted = false;
15211:   eventState.selectedDish = chooseMysteryChineseMealImage(eventState.lastDish);
15212:   eventState.mealApplied = false;
15213:   eventState.hungerBefore = hungerLevel();
15214:   eventState.hungerAfter = hungerLevel();
15215:   saveGame();
15216:   setScreen('mysteryChineseMealEvent', { mealId: 'chinese' }, false);
15217:   vibrate([22, 28, 48]);
15218:   return true;
15219: }

15221: function applyMysteryChineseMeal() {
15222:   const eventState = mysteryChineseMealEventState();
15223:   const meal = MEALS.chinese;
15224:   if (!eventState.active || !meal) return false;
15225:   if (eventState.mealApplied) return true;
15226:   if (Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state?.game?.money) || 0)) < MYSTERY_CHINESE_MEAL_EVENT_COST) {
15227:     showToast('所持金が足りません。', 'warning');
15228:     return false;
15229:   }
15230:   const before = hungerLevel();
15231:   eventState.mealApplied = true;
15232:   eventState.hungerBefore = before;
15233:   eventState.lastDish = eventState.selectedDish;
15234:   state.game.money = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.game.money) || 0) - MYSTERY_CHINESE_MEAL_EVENT_COST);
15235:   addFinance('謎の中華料理', 0, MYSTERY_CHINESE_MEAL_EVENT_COST);
15236:   startMoneyFeedback(-MYSTERY_CHINESE_MEAL_EVENT_COST, 1200);
15237:   spendMealTime();
15238:   state.wellbeing.hunger = Math.min(7, hungerLevel() + meal.recovery);
15239:   state.wellbeing.lastMeal = meal.id;
15240:   state.wellbeing.mealsEaten = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.wellbeing.mealsEaten) || 0)) + 1;
15241:   eventState.hungerAfter = state.wellbeing.hunger;
15242:   state.daily.meals = Array.isArray(state.daily.meals) ? state.daily.meals : [];
15243:   state.daily.meals.push({ id: meal.id, name: '謎の中華料理', price: MYSTERY_CHINESE_MEAL_EVENT_COST, recovery: state.wellbeing.hunger - before });
15244:   addNotification('謎の中華料理を食べた', `${yen(MYSTERY_CHINESE_MEAL_EVENT_COST)}を支払い、空腹度が回復しました。`, 'special');
15245:   saveGame();
15246:   return true;
15247: }

15249: async function startMysteryChineseMealEating() {
15250:   const eventState = mysteryChineseMealEventState();
15251:   if (!eventState.active || !['reward', 'eating'].includes(eventState.stage) || mealTransitioning) return;
15252:   mealTransitioning = true;
15253:   try {
15254:     if (!applyMysteryChineseMeal()) {
15255:       mealTransitioning = false;
15256:       return;
15257:     }
15258:     eventState.stage = 'eating';
15259:     state.game.screen = 'mysteryChineseMealEvent';
15260:     saveGame();
15261:     render();
15262:     await waitForNextPaintWithTimeout();
15263:     await wait(180);
15264:     if (!eventState.active || mysteryChineseMealEventState().stage !== 'eating') return;
15265:     playSfx('eat');
15266:     vibrate([18, 24, 42]);
15267:     // sfx-eat.ogg は約1.15秒。食事SEが終わってから食後の会話へ移る。
15268:     await wait(1220);
15269:     const latest = mysteryChineseMealEventState();
15270:     if (!latest.active || latest.stage !== 'eating') return;
15271:     latest.stage = 'postMeal';
15272:     saveGame();
15273:     render();
15274:   } catch (error) {
15275:     console.error('謎の中華料理イベント食事処理エラー', error);
15276:     const latest = mysteryChineseMealEventState();
15277:     if (latest.active && latest.mealApplied) {
15278:       latest.stage = 'postMeal';
15279:       saveGame();
15280:       render();
15281:     }
15282:   } finally {
15283:     mealTransitioning = false;
15284:   }
15285: }

15287: function finishMysteryChineseMealEvent() {
15288:   const eventState = mysteryChineseMealEventState();
15289:   if (!eventState.active) {
15290:     goMain();
15291:     return;
15292:   }
15293:   // 復旧経路などで食事適用前にここへ来ても、料金・食事効果を一度だけ確定する。
15294:   if (!eventState.mealApplied) settleMysteryChineseMealEmergency(eventState);
15295:   const before = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, Math.floor(Number(eventState.hungerBefore) || 0)));
15296:   const after = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, Math.floor(Number(eventState.hungerAfter) || hungerLevel())));
15297:   eventState.active = false;
15298:   eventState.stage = 'completed';
15299:   eventState.introVideoCompleted = true;
15300:   eventState.stageAfterVideo = '';
15301:   eventState.selectedDish = '';
15302:   saveGame();
15303:   hungerFeedback = { before, after, mealName: '謎の中華料理' };
15304:   clearTimeout(hungerFeedbackTimer);
15305:   setScreen('main', {}, false);
15306:   hungerFeedbackTimer = setTimeout(() => {
15307:     hungerFeedback = null;
15308:     if (screen === 'main') render();
15309:   }, 1550);
15310:   showToast('ごちそうさまでした', 'meal-complete', false);
15311: }

15313: async function advanceMysteryChineseMealEvent() {
15314:   const eventState = mysteryChineseMealEventState();
15315:   if (!eventState.active) {
15316:     goMain();
15317:     return;
15318:   }
15319:   if (eventState.stage === 'intro1') {
15320:     eventState.stage = 'intro2';
15321:     saveGame();
15322:     playSfx('select', { gain: 0.82 });
15323:     render();
15324:     return;
15325:   }
15326:   if (eventState.stage === 'intro2') {
15327:     eventState.stage = 'intro3';
15328:     saveGame();
15329:     playSfx('select', { gain: 0.82 });
15330:     render();
15331:     return;
15332:   }
15333:   if (eventState.stage === 'intro3') {
15334:     eventState.stage = 'reward';
15335:     saveGame();
15336:     playSfx('success', { gain: 0.92 });
15337:     vibrate([26, 30, 56]);
15338:     render();
15339:     return;
15340:   }
15341:   if (eventState.stage === 'reward' || eventState.stage === 'eating') {
15342:     await startMysteryChineseMealEating();
15343:     return;
15344:   }
15345:   if (eventState.stage === 'postMeal') {
15346:     finishMysteryChineseMealEvent();
15347:     return;
15348:   }
15349:   finishMysteryChineseMealEvent();
15350: }

15619: function grayHoodAquariumEventState() {
15620:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
15621:   const saved = state.events.grayHoodAquariumEvent && typeof state.events.grayHoodAquariumEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.grayHoodAquariumEvent)
15622:     ? state.events.grayHoodAquariumEvent : {};
15623:   const dialogueStages = new Set(['intro1', 'intro2', 'intro2b', 'intro3', 'intro3b', 'reward', 'farewell', 'unlockMessage']);
15624:   const validStages = new Set(['idle', 'video', ...dialogueStages, 'completed']);
15625:   const rawStage = validStages.has(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : 'idle';
15626:   const rawResumeStage = dialogueStages.has(saved.stageAfterVideo) ? saved.stageAfterVideo : '';
15627:   Object.assign(saved, {
15628:     active: Boolean(saved.active),
15629:     completed: Boolean(saved.completed),
15630:     stage: rawStage,
15631:     triggeredDay: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.triggeredDay) || 0)),
15632:     introVideoCompleted: Boolean(saved.introVideoCompleted),
15633:     stageAfterVideo: rawResumeStage,
15634:   });
15635:   if (saved.completed) {
15636:     saved.active = false;
15637:     saved.stage = 'completed';
15638:     saved.introVideoCompleted = true;
15639:     saved.stageAfterVideo = '';
15640:   } else if (saved.active && !saved.introVideoCompleted) {
15641:     // v0.10.579より前にイベント途中だったセーブでも、重要な導入動画を飛ばさず
15642:     // 視聴後に元の進行段階へ正確に戻す。
15643:     if (saved.stage !== 'video') saved.stageAfterVideo = dialogueStages.has(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : (saved.stageAfterVideo || 'intro1');
15644:     if (!saved.stageAfterVideo) saved.stageAfterVideo = 'intro1';
15645:     saved.stage = 'video';
15646:   }
15647:   state.events.grayHoodAquariumEvent = saved;
15648:   return saved;
15649: }

15655: function startGrayHoodAquariumIntroPlayback() {
15656:   const e = grayHoodAquariumEventState();
15657:   if (!e.active || e.stage !== 'video') return;
15658:   const video = root.querySelector('video[data-gray-hood-aquarium-intro-video]');
15659:   if (!(video instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return;
15660:   const stage = video.closest('.gray-hood-aquarium-video-stage');
15661:   stage?.classList.remove('needs-start', 'has-error');
15662:   video.muted = false;
15663:   video.volume = 1;
15664:   suspendAudio();
15665:   const playPromise = video.play();
15666:   if (playPromise && typeof playPromise.catch === 'function') {
15667:     playPromise
15668:       .then(() => {
15669:         stage?.classList.add('is-playing');
15670:         stage?.classList.remove('needs-start', 'has-error');
15671:       })
15672:       .catch(() => stage?.classList.add('needs-start'));
15673:   }
15674: }

15697: function maybeStartGrayHoodAquariumEvent() {
15698:   const eventState = grayHoodAquariumEventState();
15699:   if (eventState.active) { setScreen('grayHoodAquariumEvent', { mealId: 'korean' }, false); return true; }

16022: function emeraldCaptainKebabEventTotalCost() {
16023:   return EMERALD_CAPTAIN_KEBAB_EVENT_SHAPE_IDS.reduce((sum, shapeId) => sum + Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(loosePurchasePrice(EMERALD_CAPTAIN_KEBAB_EVENT_GEM_ID, shapeId)) || 0)), 0);
16024: }

16026: function emeraldCaptainKebabEventState() {
16027:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
16028:   const saved = state.events.emeraldCaptainKebabEvent && typeof state.events.emeraldCaptainKebabEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.emeraldCaptainKebabEvent)
16029:     ? state.events.emeraldCaptainKebabEvent
16030:     : {};
16031:   const validStages = new Set(['idle', 'intro1', 'intro2', 'showcase', 'purchaseResult', 'purchase', 'eating', 'farewell', 'completed']);
16032:   state.events.emeraldCaptainKebabEvent = {
16033:     active: Boolean(saved.active),
16034:     stage: validStages.has(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : 'idle',
16035:     pendingMealId: typeof saved.pendingMealId === 'string' ? saved.pendingMealId : '',
16036:     mealPaid: Boolean(saved.mealPaid),
16037:     mealCompleted: Boolean(saved.mealCompleted),
16038:     purchased: Boolean(saved.purchased),
16039:     hungerBefore: Math.max(0, Math.min(7, Number(saved.hungerBefore) || 0)),
16040:     hungerAfter: Math.max(0, Math.min(7, Number(saved.hungerAfter) || 0)),
16041:     gemTotalPrice: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.gemTotalPrice) || emeraldCaptainKebabEventTotalCost())),
16042:   };
16043:   if (!state.events.emeraldCaptainKebabEvent.active && !['idle', 'completed'].includes(state.events.emeraldCaptainKebabEvent.stage)) {
16044:     state.events.emeraldCaptainKebabEvent.stage = 'completed';
16045:   }
16046:   return state.events.emeraldCaptainKebabEvent;
16047: }

16049: function maybeStartEmeraldCaptainKebabEvent() {
16050:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) return false;
16051:   const mealId = EMERALD_CAPTAIN_KEBAB_EVENT_MEAL_ID;
16052:   const eventState = emeraldCaptainKebabEventState();
16053:   if (eventState.active) {
16054:     setScreen('emeraldCaptainKebabEvent', { mealId }, false);
16055:     return true;
16056:   }
16057:   const meal = MEALS[mealId];
16058:   const gemCost = emeraldCaptainKebabEventTotalCost();
16059:   const totalRequired = gemCost + Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(meal?.price) || 0));
16060:   if (!meal || gemCost <= 0 || Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state?.game?.money) || 0)) < totalRequired) return false;
16061:   if (Math.random() >= EMERALD_CAPTAIN_KEBAB_EVENT_CHANCE) return false;
16062:   eventState.active = true;
16063:   eventState.stage = 'intro1';
16064:   eventState.pendingMealId = mealId;
16065:   eventState.mealPaid = false;
16066:   eventState.mealCompleted = false;
16067:   eventState.purchased = false;
16068:   eventState.hungerBefore = hungerLevel();
16069:   eventState.hungerAfter = hungerLevel();
16070:   eventState.gemTotalPrice = gemCost;
16071:   state.game.screen = 'emeraldCaptainKebabEvent';
16072:   saveGame();
16073:   playSfx('emerald-captain-appear', { gain: 0.5, rate: 0.92 });
16074:   setTimeout(() => playSfx('emerald-captain-reward', { gain: 0.48, rate: 0.96 }), 120);
16075:   vibrate([18, 18, 38]);
16076:   setScreen('emeraldCaptainKebabEvent', { mealId }, false);
16077:   return true;
16078: }

16080: function applyEmeraldCaptainKebabPurchase() {
16081:   const eventState = emeraldCaptainKebabEventState();
16082:   if (eventState.purchased) return true;
16083:   const totalPrice = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(eventState.gemTotalPrice) || emeraldCaptainKebabEventTotalCost()));
16084:   if (state.game.money < totalPrice) return false;
16085:   state.game.money -= totalPrice;
16086:   EMERALD_CAPTAIN_KEBAB_EVENT_SHAPE_IDS.forEach((shapeId) => adjustLooseInventory(EMERALD_CAPTAIN_KEBAB_EVENT_GEM_ID, shapeId, 1));
16087:   addFinance('エメラルドをルース屋で購入', 0, totalPrice);
16088:   startMoneyFeedback(-totalPrice, 1300);
16089:   eventState.purchased = true;
16090:   saveGame();
16091:   return true;
16092: }

16133: function finishEmeraldCaptainKebabMeal({ manual = false } = {}) {
16134:   const eventState = emeraldCaptainKebabEventState();
16135:   if (!eventState.active || !['eating', 'farewell'].includes(eventState.stage)) return false;
16136:   clearEmeraldCaptainMealWatchdog();
16137:   const meal = MEALS[EMERALD_CAPTAIN_KEBAB_EVENT_MEAL_ID];
16138:   if (!eventState.mealCompleted) {
16139:     const before = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, Number(eventState.hungerBefore) || hungerLevel()));
16140:     spendMealTime();
16141:     state.wellbeing.hunger = Math.min(7, hungerLevel() + meal.recovery);
16142:     state.wellbeing.lastMeal = EMERALD_CAPTAIN_KEBAB_EVENT_MEAL_ID;
16143:     state.wellbeing.mealsEaten = Math.max(0, Number(state.wellbeing.mealsEaten) || 0) + 1;
16144:     eventState.hungerAfter = state.wellbeing.hunger;
16145:     state.daily.meals.push({ id: EMERALD_CAPTAIN_KEBAB_EVENT_MEAL_ID, name: meal.name, price: meal.price, recovery: state.wellbeing.hunger - before });
16146:     eventState.mealCompleted = true;
16147:   }
16148:   eventState.stage = 'farewell';
16149:   mealTransitioning = false;
16150:   saveGame();
16151:   if (manual) playSfx('emerald-captain-farewell', { gain: 0.48 });
16152:   else playSfx('emerald-captain-farewell', { gain: 0.54 });
16153:   render();
16154:   return true;
16155: }

16157: async function startEmeraldCaptainKebabMeal() {
16158:   const eventState = emeraldCaptainKebabEventState();
16159:   if (!eventState.active || !['purchase', 'eating'].includes(eventState.stage) || mealTransitioning) return;
16160:   const meal = MEALS[EMERALD_CAPTAIN_KEBAB_EVENT_MEAL_ID];
16161:   mealTransitioning = true;
16162:   let stateBeforeMeal = null;
16163:   try {
16164:     stateBeforeMeal = structuredClone(state);
16165:     await preloadEmeraldCaptainMealAssets();
16166:     if (!eventState.mealPaid) {
16167:       const before = hungerLevel();
16168:       if (before >= 7) throw new Error('空腹度は満タンです。');
16169:       if (state.wellbeing.mealsEaten > 0 && state.wellbeing.lastMeal === EMERALD_CAPTAIN_KEBAB_EVENT_MEAL_ID) throw new Error('同じ食事は連続で選べません。');
16170:       if (state.game.money < meal.price) throw new Error('所持金が足りません。');
16171:       if (!eventState.hungerBefore) eventState.hungerBefore = before;
16172:       state.game.money -= meal.price;
16173:       addFinance(`${meal.name}で食事`, 0, meal.price);
16174:       startMoneyFeedback(-meal.price, 1200);
16175:       eventState.mealPaid = true;
16176:     }
16177:     eventState.stage = 'eating';
16178:     state.game.screen = 'emeraldCaptainKebabEvent';
16179:     saveGame();
16180:     render();
16181:     scheduleEmeraldCaptainMealWatchdog();
16182:     await waitForNextPaintWithTimeout();
16183:     await wait(420);
16184:     if (emeraldCaptainKebabEventState().stage !== 'eating') return;
16185:     playSfx('emerald-captain-eat');
16186:     await wait(2080);
16187:     finishEmeraldCaptainKebabMeal();
16188:   } catch (error) {
16189:     console.error('エメラルド班班長ケバブイベント食事処理エラー', error);
16190:     clearEmeraldCaptainMealWatchdog();
16191:     if (stateBeforeMeal) state = stateBeforeMeal;
16192:     const e = emeraldCaptainKebabEventState();

16204: async function advanceEmeraldCaptainKebabEvent() {
16205:   const eventState = emeraldCaptainKebabEventState();
16206:   if (!eventState.active) {
16207:     setScreen('meal', {}, false);
16208:     return;
16209:   }
16210:   if (eventState.stage === 'intro1') {
16211:     eventState.stage = 'intro2';
16212:     saveGame();
16213:     playSfx('select', { gain: 0.52 });
16214:     render();
16215:     return;
16216:   }
16217:   if (eventState.stage === 'intro2') {
16218:     eventState.stage = 'showcase';
16219:     saveGame();
16220:     playSfx('emerald-captain-reward', { gain: 0.84, rate: 1.05 });
16221:     render();
16222:     return;
16223:   }
16224:   if (eventState.stage === 'showcase') {
16225:     if (!applyEmeraldCaptainKebabPurchase()) {
16226:       showToast('所持金が足りません。', 'error');
16227:       return;
16228:     }
16229:     eventState.stage = 'purchaseResult';
16230:     saveGame();
16231:     playSfx('emerald-captain-purchase', { gain: 0.92, rate: 1.0 });
16232:     render();
16233:     // v0.10.847: エメラルド画像のタップ成功後は、購入結果表示で止まらず
16234:     // 必ず次の会話シーン（purchase）へ進むタイマーをここでも開始する。
16235:     // render側にも同じ復旧経路があり、schedule関数が既存タイマーを置換するため二重進行しない。
16236:     scheduleEmeraldCaptainPurchaseDialogue(1200);
16237:     return;
16238:   }
16239:   if (eventState.stage === 'purchaseResult') {
16240:     scheduleEmeraldCaptainPurchaseDialogue();
16241:     return;
16242:   }
16243:   if (eventState.stage === 'purchase') {
16244:     saveGame();
16245:     await startEmeraldCaptainKebabMeal();
16246:     return;
16247:   }
16248:   if (eventState.stage === 'farewell') {
16249:     const before = eventState.hungerBefore;
16250:     const after = eventState.hungerAfter;
16251:     eventState.active = false;
16252:     eventState.stage = 'completed';
16253:     eventState.pendingMealId = '';
16254:     saveGame();
16255:     hungerFeedback = { before, after, mealName: 'ケバブ' };
16256:     clearTimeout(hungerFeedbackTimer);
16257:     goMain();
16258:     playSfx('emerald-captain-farewell', { gain: 0.68, rate: 0.94 });
16259:     hungerFeedbackTimer = setTimeout(() => {
16260:       hungerFeedback = null;
16261:       if (screen === 'main') render();
16262:     }, 1550);
16263:     return;
16264:   }
16265:   if (eventState.stage === 'eating') {
16266:     await startEmeraldCaptainKebabMeal();
16267:   }
16268: }

16271: // v0.10.846: エメラルド班班長 — Android/WebViewで報酬画像のタップがclickへ変換されない場合の直通経路。
16272: // v0.10.753の互換clickは残しつつ、showcase段階だけ pointerup / touchend から購入処理へ直接進める。
16273: // 段階判定を先に行うため、両経路が同じ操作で発火しても二重購入にはならない。
16274: let emeraldCaptainRewardDirectTapAt = 0;
16275: let emeraldCaptainRewardDirectTapBusy = false;
16276: 
16277: function emeraldCaptainRewardButtonFromInputEvent(event) {
16278:   const selector = 'body[data-screen="emeraldCaptainKebabEvent"] .emerald-captain-kebab-reward-button';
16279:   const path = typeof event?.composedPath === 'function' ? event.composedPath() : [];
16280:   for (const node of path) {
16281:     if (node instanceof Element && node.matches?.(selector)) return node;
16282:     if (node instanceof Element) {
16283:       const closest = node.closest?.(selector);
16284:       if (closest) return closest;
16285:     }
16286:   }
16287:   const direct = event?.target instanceof Element ? event.target.closest(selector) : null;
16288:   if (direct) return direct;
16289: 
16290:   const button = document.querySelector(selector);
16291:   if (!(button instanceof HTMLButtonElement)) return null;
16292:   const point = event?.changedTouches?.[0] || event?.touches?.[0] || event;
16293:   const x = Number(point?.clientX);
16294:   const y = Number(point?.clientY);
16295:   if (!Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(y)) return null;
16296: 
16297:   // 一部WebViewでは画像上のtouch targetが親buttonから外れることがあるため、
16298:   // 実ボタンと画像の見た目の両方を小さな余裕付きで当たり判定する。
16299:   const rects = [button.getBoundingClientRect()];
16300:   const image = button.querySelector('img');
16301:   if (image instanceof HTMLImageElement) rects.push(image.getBoundingClientRect());
16302:   const hitPadding = 18;
16303:   const hit = rects.some((rect) => x >= rect.left - hitPadding && x <= rect.right + hitPadding
16304:     && y >= rect.top - hitPadding && y <= rect.bottom + hitPadding);
16305:   return hit ? button : null;
16306: }

16308: function activateEmeraldCaptainRewardFromDirectTouch(event) {
16309:   if (!state || screen !== 'emeraldCaptainKebabEvent') return;
16310:   const pointerType = String(event?.pointerType || '');
16311:   if (event?.type === 'pointerup' && pointerType === 'mouse') return;
16312:   const eventState = emeraldCaptainKebabEventState();
16313:   if (!eventState.active || eventState.stage !== 'showcase') return;
16314:   const button = emeraldCaptainRewardButtonFromInputEvent(event);
16315:   if (!button || button.disabled) return;
16316: 
16317:   const now = typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : Date.now();
16318:   if (emeraldCaptainRewardDirectTapBusy || now - emeraldCaptainRewardDirectTapAt < 450) return;
16319:   emeraldCaptainRewardDirectTapAt = now;
16320:   emeraldCaptainRewardDirectTapBusy = true;
16321:   if (event.cancelable) event.preventDefault();
16322:   event.stopPropagation?.();
16323: 
16324:   Promise.resolve(advanceEmeraldCaptainKebabEvent())
16325:     .catch((error) => {
16326:       console.error('エメラルド班班長イベント報酬タップ処理エラー', error);
16327:       showToast('エメラルドの購入処理を再試行してください。', 'warning');
16328:     })
16329:     .finally(() => {
16330:       emeraldCaptainRewardDirectTapBusy = false;
16331:     });
16332: }
16333:

16335: document.addEventListener('touchend', activateEmeraldCaptainRewardFromDirectTouch, { capture: true, passive: false });

16499:   const autopilotEnabled = Boolean(state?.settings?.autopilotEnabled);
16500:   const locked = hungerLocked();
16501:   const autopilotDisabled = 'disabled aria-disabled="true" title="自動操縦中はスマートフォンと今日の宝石のみ操作できます"';
16502:   const hungerDisabled = locked ? 'disabled aria-disabled="true"' : '';
16503:   const manualActionDisabled = autopilotEnabled ? autopilotDisabled : hungerDisabled;
16504:   const phoneDisabled = !autopilotEnabled && locked ? hungerDisabled : '';
16505:   const mealDisabled = autopilotEnabled ? autopilotDisabled : '';
16506:   const coldActive = winterColdTextActive();
16507:   const sleepDisabled = coldActive ? '' : (autopilotEnabled ? autopilotDisabled : (canSleepNow() ? '' : 'disabled aria-disabled="true" title="19時になるまで寝られません"'));
16508:   const storeButton = `<button data-action="nav" data-screen="store" ${manualActionDisabled}>${mainMenuIcon('store')}<strong>店舗</strong>${visiting.length ? '<i></i>' : ''}</button>`;

16511:       <section class="main-spacer" aria-hidden="true"></section>
16512:       ${coldActive ? '<div class="winter-cold-main-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" data-illness-readable="true"><strong>体調不良</strong></div>' : ''}
16513:       ${autopilotEnabled ? '<div class="autopilot-main-notice" role="status" aria-live="polite"><strong>自動操縦中</strong></div>' : ''}
16514:       ${locked && !autopilotEnabled ? `<button type="button" class="hunger-lock-notice hunger-lock-meal-shortcut" data-action="nav" data-screen="meal" aria-label="空腹のため食事画面へ移動する"><strong>空腹で動けません</strong><span>食事をするか、今日は休んでください。</span></button>` : ''}
16515:       ${hungerFeedback && !autopilotEnabled ? `<div class="hunger-recovery-overlay" role="status"><strong>空腹度</strong><div><b>${hungerFeedback.before}</b><span>→</span><b>${hungerFeedback.after}</b></div>${hungerPips(hungerFeedback.after)}</div>` : ''}
16516:       ${visiting.length && !locked && !autopilotEnabled ? `<div class="floating-notice"><strong>お客様が来店しています。</strong><span>${esc(visiting.join('、'))}</span></div>` : ''}
16517:       ${outstandingCosts > 0 && activeOrders > 0 && !autopilotEnabled
16518:         ? `<div class="main-shortcut-stack" aria-label="未払いと受注品の案内">

16520:             <button class="active-order-shortcut" data-action="open-active-orders" aria-label="現在の受注品を工房の注文書で確認する">現在受注品あり</button>
16521:           </div>`
16522:         : outstandingCosts > 0
16523:           ? `<button type="button" class="main-unpaid-shortcut" data-action="open-finance" aria-label="未払いがあります。スマートフォンの収支画面を開く">未払いがあります</button>`
16524:           : activeOrders > 0 && !autopilotEnabled
16525:             ? `<button class="active-order-shortcut" data-action="open-active-orders" aria-label="現在の受注品を工房の注文書で確認する">現在受注品あり</button>`

16540: function miningLocationById(id) {
16541:   return id === SPACE_MINING_LOCATION.id ? SPACE_MINING_LOCATION : MINING_LOCATIONS[id];

16544: function availableMiningLocations() {
16545:   if (isAlienAbducted()) return [SPACE_MINING_LOCATION];
16546:   const unlocked = new Set(state.miningProgress?.unlockedLocations || ['river', 'mountain', 'cave']);
16547:   return Object.values(MINING_LOCATIONS).filter((location) => unlocked.has(location.id));
16548: }

16550: function unlockMiningLocationsIfNeeded() {
16551:   const progress = state.miningProgress;
16552:   const newlyUnlocked = [];
16553:   for (const location of Object.values(MINING_LOCATIONS)) {
16554:     if (progress.successfulFinds >= Number(location.unlockAtFinds || 0)
16555:       && !progress.unlockedLocations.includes(location.id)) {
16556:       progress.unlockedLocations.push(location.id);
16557:       newlyUnlocked.push(location);
16558:       addNotification('新しい採掘場所を発見しました', `${location.name}で採掘できるようになりました。`);
16559:     }
16560:   }
16561:   return newlyUnlocked;
16562: }

16564: function renderMining() {
16565:   const locations = availableMiningLocations();
16566:   if (isAlienAbducted()) selectedMining = SPACE_MINING_LOCATION.id;
16567:   if (selectedMining && !locations.some((place) => place.id === selectedMining)) selectedMining = null;
16568:   const location = selectedMining ? miningLocationById(selectedMining) : null;
16569:   const hasSelection = Boolean(location);
16570:   const hungerBlocked = hungerLocked();
16571:   const hasTime = hasSelection && !hungerBlocked && canSpendHours(location.hours);
16572:   const spaceEmergency = alienHungerEmergency();
16573:   const singleSpaceLocation = isAlienAbducted() && locations.length === 1;
16574:   return shell('採掘', `
16575:     <div class="split-layout">
16576:       <section class="scene-space"></section>
16577:       <section class="action-panel glass-panel ${singleSpaceLocation ? 'space-mining-single-panel' : ''}">
16578:         <div class="choice-grid three ${singleSpaceLocation ? 'space-mining-single-grid' : ''}">
16579:           ${locations.map((place) => `
16580:             <button class="choice-card ${place.id === selectedMining ? 'selected' : ''}" data-action="select-mining" data-id="${place.id}" ${hungerBlocked ? 'disabled aria-disabled="true"' : ''}>
16581:               <strong>${esc(place.name)}</strong><small>${place.hours}時間</small>
16582:             </button>`).join('')}
16583:         </div>
16584:         <button class="primary-button full-button ${singleSpaceLocation ? 'space-mining-start-button' : ''}" data-action="mine" ${hasTime ? '' : 'disabled'}>採掘を始める</button>
16585:         ${spaceEmergency ? '<p class="error-text">空腹度が0になりました。宇宙では食事ができないため、すぐに休んで翌日へ進めます。</p><button class="primary-button full-button" data-action="alien-emergency-sleep">空腹のため休む</button>' : ''}
16586:         ${!spaceEmergency && hungerBlocked ? '<p class="error-text">空腹で採掘できません。</p>' : ''}
16587:         ${!hungerBlocked && hasSelection && !hasTime ? '<p class="error-text">今日は採掘する時間がありません。</p>' : ''}
16588:       </section>
16589:     </div>`);
16590: }

16699: function renderGlab() {
16700:   const catalogTools = Object.values(WORKSHOP_TOOLS)
16701:     .filter(workshopToolCatalogVisible)
16702:     .filter((tool) => !workshopToolRecord(tool.id))
16703:     .sort((a, b) => workshopToolUnlockLevel(a) - workshopToolUnlockLevel(b));
16704:   const catalogGroups = [...new Set(catalogTools.map(workshopToolUnlockLevel))].map((level) => ({
16705:     level,
16706:     tools: catalogTools.filter((tool) => workshopToolUnlockLevel(tool) === level),
16707:   }));
16708:   const repairTools = Object.values(WORKSHOP_TOOLS).filter((tool) => {
16709:     const record = workshopToolRecord(tool.id);
16710:     return Boolean(tool.repairable && record && ['unusable', 'repairing'].includes(record.status));
16711:   });
16712:   const catalogRow = (tool) => {
16713:     const locked = !workshopToolUnlocked(tool);
16714:     const visual = tool.image
16715:       ? workshopToolImageMarkup(tool, { className: 'glab-row-tool-image' })
16716:       : '';
16717:     return `<button type="button" class="glab-simple-row glab-tool-row ${locked ? 'locked' : ''}" data-action="glab-tool-detail" data-id="${esc(tool.id)}">
16718:       ${visual}
16719:       <span class="glab-row-name">${esc(tool.name)}</span>
16720:       <span class="glab-row-status"><strong>${yen(tool.price)}</strong></span>
16721:     </button>`;
16722:   };
16723:   const repairRow = (tool) => {
16724:     const record = workshopToolRecord(tool.id);
16725:     const status = record?.status === 'repairing'
16726:       ? workshopToolStatusText(tool.id, record)
16727:       : `修理費 ${yen(workshopToolRepairPrice(tool.id))}`;
16728:     return `<button type="button" class="glab-simple-row repair" data-action="glab-tool-detail" data-id="${esc(tool.id)}">
16729:       <span class="glab-row-name">${esc(tool.name)}</span>
16730:       <strong>${esc(status)}</strong>
16731:     </button>`;
16732:   };
16733:   const catalogMarkup = catalogTools.length
16734:     ? `<section class="glab-catalog-group">
16735:         <h2>購入できる工具・設備（${catalogTools.length}種類）</h2>
16736:         ${catalogGroups.map((group) => `<section class="glab-level-group"><h3>工房レベル${group.level}で購入可能な工具・設備</h3><div class="glab-simple-list">${group.tools.map(catalogRow).join('')}</div></section>`).join('')}
16737:       </section>`
16738:     : `<section class="glab-catalog-group"><div class="empty-state"><strong>現在購入する工具・設備はありません。</strong><p>購入済みで使用可能な工具は、この一覧には表示されません。</p></div></section>`;
16739:   return shell('g-Lab.', `
16740:     <div class="split-layout">
16741:       <section class="scene-space"></section>
16742:       <section class="action-panel glass-panel glab-catalog-panel">
16743:         ${repairTools.length ? `<section class="glab-catalog-group glab-repair-group"><h2>修理・故障</h2><div class="glab-simple-list">${repairTools.map(repairRow).join('')}</div></section>` : ''}
16744:         ${catalogMarkup}
16745:         <div class="button-stack">
16746:           <button class="primary-button full-button" data-action="nav" data-screen="workshop">工房へ</button>
16747:           <button class="secondary-button full-button" data-action="glab-info">g-Lab.について</button>
16748:           <button class="secondary-button full-button" data-action="nav" data-screen="glabSns">SNS</button>
16749:         </div>
16750:       </section>
16751:     </div>`);
16752: }

16773: function renderToolLearningGuide(tool) {
16774:   const guide = tool?.guide;
16775:   if (!guide) return `<p>${esc(tool?.detail || tool?.description || '')}</p>`;
16776:   const sections = Array.isArray(guide.sections) ? guide.sections : [];
16777:   const references = Array.isArray(guide.references) ? guide.references : [];
16778:   const chapterWordCount = sections.reduce((total, section) => total
16779:     + (section.paragraphs || []).join('').length
16780:     + (section.points || []).join('').length, 0);
16781:   return `<article class="tool-learning-guide">
16782:     <div class="tool-guide-stats" aria-label="解説の収録範囲">
16783:       <strong>専門解説 全${sections.length}章</strong>
16784:       <span>本文約${chapterWordCount.toLocaleString('ja-JP')}字</span>
16785:       <span>専門資料${references.length}件</span>
16786:       ${guide.revision ? `<span>改訂 ${esc(guide.revision)}</span>` : ''}
16787:     </div>
16788:     <p class="tool-guide-lead">${esc(guide.overview || tool.detail || tool.description || '')}</p>
16789:     ${guide.scope ? `<p class="tool-guide-scope">収録範囲：${esc(guide.scope)}</p>` : ''}
16790:     <details class="tool-guide-toc"><summary>目次を開く</summary><ol>${sections.map((section, index) => `<li><a href="#tool-guide-section-${index + 1}">${esc(section.title || '')}</a></li>`).join('')}</ol></details>
16791:     ${sections.map((section, index) => `<section class="tool-guide-section" id="tool-guide-section-${index + 1}">
16792:       <div class="tool-guide-chapter-number">${String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</div>
16793:       <h3>${esc(section.title || '')}</h3>
16794:       ${(section.paragraphs || []).map((paragraph) => `<p>${esc(paragraph)}</p>`).join('')}
16795:       ${(section.points || []).length ? `<ul>${section.points.map((point) => `<li>${esc(point)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>` : ''}
16796:     </section>`).join('')}
16797:     ${references.length ? `<section class="tool-guide-section tool-guide-references"><h3>参考にした専門資料</h3><ul>${references.map((reference) => `<li>${esc(reference)}</li>`).join('')}</ul><p>実際の使用条件、法令、安全基準、適合材料は、使用する機器・薬剤・地域の最新の取扱説明書、SDS、法令を優先してください。</p></section>` : ''}
16798:   </article>`;
16799: }

16801: function renderWorkshopToolDetail() {
16802:   const tool = WORKSHOP_TOOLS[screenData.toolId];

16843: function renderGlabToolDetail() {
16844:   const tool = WORKSHOP_TOOLS[screenData.toolId];
16845:   if (!tool) return shell('工具・設備', '<section class="center-card glass-panel"><p>商品情報を確認できません。</p></section>');
16846:   const record = workshopToolRecord(tool.id);
16847:   const affordable = state.game.money >= tool.price;
16848:   const hasTime = canSpendHours(1);
16849:   let actionArea = '';
16850: 
16851:   if (!record) {
16852:     const unlocked = workshopToolUnlocked(tool);
16853:     const shortage = Math.max(0, tool.price - state.game.money);
16854:     actionArea = `
16855:       <div class="glab-detail-price"><span>価格</span><strong>${yen(tool.price)}</strong></div>
16856:       ${unlocked && shortage > 0 ? `<div class="glab-funds-shortage"><span>購入するには、所持金が</span><strong>${yen(shortage)}不足しています</strong></div>` : ''}
16857:       ${unlocked ? '' : '<div class="glab-unlock-message"><strong>未解放</strong></div>'}
16858:       <button class="primary-button full-button" data-action="buy-workshop-tool" data-id="${esc(tool.id)}" ${unlocked && affordable && hasTime ? '' : 'disabled'}>${unlocked ? '購入する' : '未解放'}</button>
16859:       ${unlocked && !hasTime ? '<p class="error-text">今日は購入手続きをする時間がありません。</p>' : ''}`;
16860:   } else if (record.status === 'unusable' && tool.repairable) {
16861:     const repairPrice = workshopToolRepairPrice(tool.id);
16862:     const repairAffordable = state.game.money >= repairPrice;
16863:     const repairShortage = Math.max(0, repairPrice - state.game.money);
16864:     actionArea = `
16865:       <div class="glab-detail-price"><span>修理費</span><strong>${yen(repairPrice)}</strong></div>
16866:       ${repairShortage > 0 ? `<div class="glab-funds-shortage"><span>修理を依頼するには、所持金が</span><strong>${yen(repairShortage)}不足しています</strong></div>` : ''}
16867:       <p class="small-note">修理には7日かかり、受付に1時間使います。</p>
16868:       <button class="primary-button full-button" data-action="repair-workshop-tool" data-id="${esc(tool.id)}" ${repairAffordable && hasTime ? '' : 'disabled'}>修理を依頼する</button>
16869:       ${hasTime ? '' : '<p class="error-text">今日は修理を依頼する時間がありません。</p>'}`;
16870:   } else if (record.status === 'repairing') {
16871:     actionArea = `<div class="glab-owned-message"><strong>修理中</strong><span>${esc(workshopToolStatusText(tool.id, record))}</span></div>`;
16872:   } else {
16873:     actionArea = '<div class="glab-owned-message"><strong>購入済み</strong><span>工房の工具・設備へ追加されています。</span></div>';
16874:   }
16875: 
16876:   return shell(tool.name, `
16877:     <div class="split-layout">
16878:       <section class="scene-space"></section>
16879:       <section class="action-panel glass-panel glab-tool-detail-page">
16880:         ${workshopToolImageMarkup(tool, { className: 'tool-detail-image-shell', alt: `${tool.name}の工具・設備画像`, decorative: false })}
16881:         ${renderToolBrief(tool)}
16882:         <div class="tool-detail-meta">
16883:           <span>${esc(tool.type)}</span>
16884:           <span>工房評価 ＋${tool.qualityPoints}</span>
16885:           <span>手続き 1時間</span>
16886:         </div>
16887:         ${actionArea}
16888:       </section>
16889:     </div>`, { help: 'この画面で工具・設備の詳細を確認し、購入または修理の手続きを行えます。' });
16890: }

17259: function renderLooseShop(forcedTab = '') {

17299:       if (isSelling) {
17300:         const disabled = tradeLocked || available < 1 || !canSpendHours(1);
17301:         return `<article class="product-row loose-shop-product-row">

17305:           </div>
17306:           <strong>${yen(salePrice)}／個</strong>
17307:           <div class="loose-shop-actions">${detailButton}<button class="primary-button" data-action="sell-loose" data-id="${selectedGem.id}" data-shape="${shapeId}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>1個売る</button><button class="secondary-button" data-action="sell-all-loose" data-id="${selectedGem.id}" data-shape="${shapeId}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>全部売る</button></div>

17357: function jewelryShopRandomQuality() {
17358:   const roll = Math.random();
17359:   if (roll < 0.55) return 'standard';
17360:   if (roll < 0.88) return 'good';
17361:   return 'premium';
17362: }
17363: 
17364: function jewelryShopPurchaseRecommendedPrice(purchasePrice) {
17365:   const price = Math.max(1000, Math.round(Number(purchasePrice) || 0));
17366:   return Math.max(price + 1000, roundThousand(price * 1.08));
17367: }
17368: 
17369: function createJewelryShopStockItem() {
17370:   const item = randomFrom(Object.keys(ITEMS), 'ring');
17371:   const metal = randomFrom(Object.keys(METALS), 'silver');
17372:   const gem = randomFrom(Object.values(GEMS).filter((entry) => !entry.eventOnly).map((entry) => entry.id), 'amethyst');
17373:   const useLoose = Math.random() >= 0.12;
17374:   const looseShape = randomFrom(looseShapeIdsForGem(gem), defaultLooseShapeForGem(gem));
17375:   const design = randomFrom(Object.keys(DESIGNS), 'simple');
17376:   const finish = randomFrom(Object.keys(FINISHES), 'mirror');
17377:   const quality = jewelryShopRandomQuality();
17378:   const draft = { item, metal, gem, useLoose, looseShape, design, finish, quality };
17379:   const marketValue = recommendedPrice(draft);
17380:   const purchasePrice = Math.max(1000, roundThousand(marketValue * (0.90 + Math.random() * 0.06)));
17381:   return {
17382:     id: `jewelry-shop-${uid()}`,
17383:     ...draft,
17384:     name: itemName(draft),
17385:     marketValue,
17386:     purchasePrice,
17387:     recommendedPrice: jewelryShopPurchaseRecommendedPrice(purchasePrice),
17388:   };
17389: }
17390: 
17391: function createJewelryShopStock() {
17392:   return Array.from({ length: JEWELRY_SHOP_STOCK_SIZE }, () => createJewelryShopStockItem());
17393: }
17394: 
17395: function jewelryShopSellOffer(item) {
17396:   const cost = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(item?.cost) || 0));
17397:   if (!cost) return 0;
17398:   if (item?.acquisition === 'jewelryShop') return Math.max(1000, roundThousand(cost * 0.78));
17399:   // 御徒町のジュエリーショップへの売却は卸販売。利益はごく小さくする。
17400:   const multiplier = item?.quality === 'premium' ? 1.04 : item?.quality === 'good' ? 1.03 : 1.02;
17401:   return Math.max(cost + 1000, roundThousand(cost * multiplier));
17402: }

17406: }

17498: function beginJewelryShopTrade(type, itemId) {
17499:   if (type === 'buy') {
17500:     const stockItem = Array.isArray(screenData.stock) ? screenData.stock.find((item) => item.id === itemId) : null;
17501:     if (!stockItem) return showToast('この商品は現在購入できません。', 'error');
17502:     jewelryShopPendingTrade = { type, itemId };
17503:     showModal({
17504:       title: 'ジュエリーを購入',
17505:       body: `<p><strong>${esc(stockItem.name)}</strong>を${yen(stockItem.purchasePrice)}で購入します。</p><p class="small-note">手続きに1時間かかり、工房の完成品へ追加されます。</p>`,
17506:       confirm: '購入する', cancel: 'やめる', action: 'jewelry-shop-confirm-trade', cancelAction: 'jewelry-shop-cancel-trade',
17507:     });
17508:     return;
17509:   }
17510:   const item = state.inventory.jewelry.find((entry) => entry.id === itemId && entry.status === 'stored');
17511:   if (!item) return showToast('この商品は現在売却できません。', 'error');
17512:   const offer = jewelryShopSellOffer(item);
17513:   jewelryShopPendingTrade = { type: 'sell', itemId };
17514:   showModal({
17515:     title: 'ジュエリーを卸販売',
17516:     body: `<p><strong>${esc(item.name)}</strong>を${yen(offer)}で売却します。</p><p class="small-note">自分の店舗で販売するより安い卸価格です。利益はごく少額で、手続きには1時間かかります。</p>`,
17517:     confirm: '売却する', cancel: 'やめる', action: 'jewelry-shop-confirm-trade', cancelAction: 'jewelry-shop-cancel-trade',
17518:   });
17519: }
17520: 
17521: function confirmJewelryShopTrade() {
17522:   const pending = jewelryShopPendingTrade;
17523:   jewelryShopPendingTrade = null;
17524:   closeModal();
17525:   if (!pending) return;
17526:   if (!canSpendHours(JEWELRY_SHOP_TRANSACTION_HOURS)) return showToast('今日は売買手続きをする時間がありません。', 'error');
17527: 
17528:   if (pending.type === 'buy') {
17529:     const stockItem = Array.isArray(screenData.stock) ? screenData.stock.find((item) => item.id === pending.itemId) : null;
17530:     if (!stockItem) return showToast('この商品は売り切れました。', 'error');
17531:     const usedCapacity = state.inventory.jewelry.filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length;
17532:     if (usedCapacity >= state.inventory.capacity) return showToast('完成品の保管場所に空きがありません。', 'error');
17533:     if (state.game.money < stockItem.purchasePrice) return showToast('所持金が足りません。', 'error');
17534:     const purchased = {
17535:       id: uid(), item: stockItem.item, metal: stockItem.metal, gem: stockItem.gem, useLoose: stockItem.useLoose,
17536:       looseShape: stockItem.looseShape, design: stockItem.design, finish: stockItem.finish, quality: stockItem.quality,
17537:       name: stockItem.name, cost: stockItem.purchasePrice, recommendedPrice: stockItem.recommendedPrice, xp: 0,
17538:       status: 'stored', createdDay: state.game.day, purchasedDay: state.game.day,
17539:       acquisition: 'jewelryShop', shopPurchasePrice: stockItem.purchasePrice,
17540:     };
17541:     state.game.money -= stockItem.purchasePrice;
17542:     state.inventory.jewelry.push(purchased);
17543:     screenData.stock = screenData.stock.filter((item) => item.id !== pending.itemId);
17544:     spendHours(JEWELRY_SHOP_TRANSACTION_HOURS);
17545:     addFinance(`ジュエリーショップで${purchased.name}を購入`, 0, stockItem.purchasePrice);
17546:     saveGame();
17547:     startMoneyFeedback(-stockItem.purchasePrice);
17548:     showToast(`${purchased.name}を購入しました。`, 'info', false);
17549:     render();
17550:     return;
17551:   }
17552: 
17553:   const item = state.inventory.jewelry.find((entry) => entry.id === pending.itemId && entry.status === 'stored');
17554:   if (!item) return showToast('この商品は現在売却できません。', 'error');
17555:   const offer = jewelryShopSellOffer(item);
17556:   const profit = offer - Math.max(0, Number(item.cost) || 0);
17557:   removeJewelry(item.id, { price: offer, channel: 'jewelryShop' });
17558:   state.game.money += offer;
17559:   spendHours(JEWELRY_SHOP_TRANSACTION_HOURS);
17560:   state.daily.sold.push({ itemId: item.id, name: item.name, price: offer, profit, channel: 'jewelryShop' });
17561:   addFinance(`${item.name}をジュエリーショップへ卸販売`, offer, 0);
17562:   saveGame();
17563:   startMoneyFeedback(offer);
17564:   showToast(`${item.name}を${yen(offer)}で卸販売しました。`, 'info', false);
17565:   render();
17566: }

17682: function ownedEquipmentCount() {

17686: function processingKnowledgeEntries() {
17687:   const records = Array.isArray(state?.workshop?.processingKnowledge) ? state.workshop.processingKnowledge : [];
17688:   return records.map((record) => ({ record, document: PROCESSING_KNOWLEDGE[String(record?.id || '')] }))
17689:     .filter((entry) => entry.document)
17690:     .sort((a, b) => (Number(b.record?.acquiredDay) || 0) - (Number(a.record?.acquiredDay) || 0));
17691: }
17692: 
17693: function processingKnowledgeCount() {
17694:   return processingKnowledgeEntries().length;
17695: }
17696: 
17697: // 今後のイベント実装では「加工知識へ追加」の共通入口としてこの関数を使う。
17698: // 文書本体は PROCESSING_KNOWLEDGE に置き、セーブにはID・入手日・入手元だけを記録する。
17699: function grantProcessingKnowledge(knowledgeId, source = 'イベント') {
17700:   const id = String(knowledgeId || '').trim();
17701:   const document = PROCESSING_KNOWLEDGE[id];
17702:   if (!id || !document) {
17703:     console.warn('加工知識の文書定義が見つかりません。', knowledgeId);
17704:     return false;
17705:   }
17706:   state.workshop = state.workshop && typeof state.workshop === 'object' ? state.workshop : {};
17707:   state.workshop.processingKnowledge = Array.isArray(state.workshop.processingKnowledge) ? state.workshop.processingKnowledge : [];
17708:   if (state.workshop.processingKnowledge.some((entry) => String(entry?.id || entry) === id)) return false;
17709:   state.workshop.processingKnowledge.push({ id, acquiredDay: Math.max(1, Number(state.game?.day) || 1), source: String(source || 'イベント').slice(0, 120) });
17710:   addNotification('加工知識へ追加', `「${document.title || id}」が工房の加工知識へ追加されました。`, 'special');
17711:   return true;
17712: }

17714: function renderWorkshop() {
17715:   const workshopStatus = workshopUpgradeStatus();
17716:   const roughTotal = Object.values(state.inventory.rough).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
17717:   const looseTotal = looseInventoryTotal();
17718:   const metalTotal = roundedMetalWeight(Object.values(state.inventory.metals).reduce((a, b) => a + Number(b || 0), 0));
17719:   const stored = state.inventory.jewelry.filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length;
17720:   const equipmentTotal = ownedEquipmentCount();
17721:   const knowledgeTotal = processingKnowledgeCount();
17722:   const activeOrders = activeOrderCount();
17723:   return shell('工房', `
17724:     <div class="split-layout">
17725:       <section class="scene-space"></section>
17726:       <section class="action-panel glass-panel">
17727:         <div class="stat-grid workshop-inventory-grid">

17764: const WORKSHOP_STAFF_REQUIRED_TOOLS = Object.freeze(['jewelryBench', 'polishingMachine', 'rotaryTool', 'rollingMill', 'buffer', 'ultrasonicCleaner', 'electronicScale', 'magnifier', 'engravingBlock']);

17766: function workshopStaffUnlockStatus() {
17767:   const branches = contractedStoreBranches();
17768:   const branch1 = branches.find((branch) => Number(branch.number) === 1);
17769:   const branch2 = branches.find((branch) => Number(branch.number) === 2);
17770:   const totalStoreSales = branches.reduce((total, branch) => total + Math.max(0, Number(branch.salesCount) || 0), 0);
17771:   const unpaid = totalOutstandingBusinessCost();
17772:   const missingTools = WORKSHOP_STAFF_REQUIRED_TOOLS.filter((id) => !toolUsable(id));
17773:   const conditions = [
17774:     { label: '職人レベル10以上', current: Math.max(1, Number(state.artisan.level) || 1), target: 10 },
17775:     { label: 'プレイヤー自身の累計制作', current: Math.max(0, Number(state.store.playerCraftedCount) || 0), target: 100 },
17776:     { label: '工房レベル15以上', current: workshopLevel(), target: 15 },
17777:     { label: '主要工具・設備', current: missingTools.length ? `不足${missingTools.length}点` : '使用可能', target: 'すべて', met: missingTools.length === 0 },
17778:     { label: '店舗1を拡大済み', current: state.store.expanded ? '完了' : '未完了', target: '完了', met: Boolean(state.store.expanded) },
17779:     { label: '店舗2を契約済み', current: branch2 ? '完了' : '未完了', target: '完了', met: Boolean(branch2) },
17780:     { label: '店舗1・2がともにLv.5以上', current: `${branch1 ? storeLevel(branch1) : 0}・${branch2 ? storeLevel(branch2) : 0}`, target: '5・5', met: Boolean(branch1 && branch2 && storeLevel(branch1) >= 5 && storeLevel(branch2) >= 5) },
17781:     { label: '店舗での累計販売', current: totalStoreSales, target: 300 },
17782:     { label: 'オーダー納品', current: Math.max(0, Number(state.store.deliveredOrderCount) || 0), target: 50 },
17783:     { label: '家賃・工房費・給与の未払い', current: unpaid === 0 ? 'なし' : yen(unpaid), target: 'なし', met: unpaid === 0 },
17784:   ].map((condition) => ({ ...condition, met: typeof condition.met === 'boolean' ? condition.met : Number(condition.current) >= Number(condition.target) }));
17785:   return { conditions, missingTools, unlocked: conditions.every((condition) => condition.met) };
17786: }

17912: function defaultDraft(orderId = null) {
17913:   const order = orderId ? state.orders.find((entry) => entry.id === orderId) : null;
17914:   const ownedSelection = firstOwnedLooseSelection('amethyst');
17915:   const gem = order?.gem || ownedSelection.gem;
17916:   const looseShape = order?.looseShape || (order ? defaultLooseShapeForGem(gem) : firstOwnedLooseShapeForGem(gem));
17917:   return {
17918:     orderId,
17919:     item: order?.item || 'ring',
17920:     useLoose: order ? true : false,
17921:     gem,
17922:     looseShape: normalizeLooseShape(gem, looseShape),
17923:     metal: order?.metal || firstOwned(state.inventory.metals, 'silver'),
17924:     design: order?.design || 'simple',
17925:     finish: 'mirror',
17926:   };
17927: }

17929: function firstOwned(collection, fallback) {
17930:   return Object.keys(collection).find((key) => Number(collection[key]) > 0) || fallback;
17931: }

17936:       <strong>${esc(entry.name)}</strong>
17937:       ${group === 'design' ? `<small>${entry.hours > 0 ? `制作時間 ＋${entry.hours}時間` : '追加時間なし'}</small>` : ''}

17962:     </div>

17966: function craftAvailableLooseGems(orderId = null) {
17967:   const order = orderId ? state.orders.find((entry) => entry.id === orderId) : null;
17968:   return Object.values(GEMS).filter((gem) => {
17969:     if (order) {
17970:       if (gem.id !== order.gem) return false;
17971:       const shapeId = normalizeLooseShape(order.gem, order.looseShape);
17972:       return looseAvailableQuantity(gem.id, shapeId, orderId) > 0;
17973:     }
17974:     return looseAvailableTotalForGem(gem.id) > 0;
17975:   });
17976: }

17978: function craftLooseGemChoice(orderId = null) {
17979:   const order = orderId ? state.orders.find((entry) => entry.id === orderId) : null;
17980:   const gems = craftAvailableLooseGems(orderId);
17981:   if (!gems.length) {

17993:         ? looseAvailableQuantity(gem.id, selectedShape, orderId)
17994:         : looseAvailableTotalForGem(gem.id);

18000:       </button>`;

18097:   const canCraft = looseModeSelected && enoughGem && enoughMetal && capacityOk && canSpendHours(hours);

18100:

18107:         ${craftMetalChoice(craftDraft.metal, locked)}
18108:         ${craftChoice('デザイン', 'design', DESIGNS, craftDraft.design, locked)}
18109:         ${craftSurfaceChoice(craftDraft.finish)}
18110: 
18111:         ${looseModeSelected && (craftDraft.useLoose === false || selectableLooseExists) ? `<section class="craft-final-summary" aria-label="完成予定の詳細">
18112:           <p class="craft-summary-loose">${craftDraft.useLoose === true ? `◇${esc(looseSummaryName)}` : esc(looseSummaryName)}</p>

18118:             <div><dt>品質予想</dt><dd>${esc(QUALITIES[quality].name)}</dd></div>
18119:             <div><dt>加工品質</dt><dd>${craftsmanship.craftsmanshipScore} / 100（${esc(craftsmanship.tier)}）</dd></div>

18140:         ${craftDraft.useLoose === true && !enoughGem ? '<button class="secondary-button full-button" data-action="nav" data-screen="looseShop">ルース屋へ</button>' : ''}

18142:     </div>`, { help: 'アイテム、ルースを使用するか、地金、デザイン、表面の順に選びます。ルースを使用する場合だけ、所持している石種とカットを選びます。各項目を選んでも完成予定の詳細へ自動移動しません。ルースは石種を選んだ後、別画面で使用するカットを決定します。最後に画面下部で完成予定を確認してください。' });

18221: function renderProcessingKnowledgeDocument(document) {
18222:   const sections = Array.isArray(document?.sections) ? document.sections : [];
18223:   const references = Array.isArray(document?.references) ? document.references : [];
18224:   const opening = [document?.overview, document?.body].filter(Boolean).map((value) => String(value));
18225:   const wordCount = opening.join('').length + sections.reduce((total, section) => total
18226:     + (Array.isArray(section?.paragraphs) ? section.paragraphs.join('').length : String(section?.body || '').length)
18227:     + (Array.isArray(section?.points) ? section.points.join('').length : 0), 0);
18228:   return `<article class="tool-learning-guide processing-knowledge-document">
18229:     <div class="tool-guide-stats" aria-label="加工知識の収録範囲">
18230:       <strong>加工資料 全${Math.max(1, sections.length)}章</strong>
18231:       <span>本文約${wordCount.toLocaleString('ja-JP')}字</span>
18232:       ${references.length ? `<span>参考資料${references.length}件</span>` : ''}
18233:       ${document?.revision ? `<span>改訂 ${esc(document.revision)}</span>` : ''}
18234:     </div>
18235:     ${opening.map((paragraph, index) => `<p class="${index === 0 ? 'tool-guide-lead' : ''}">${esc(paragraph)}</p>`).join('')}

18631: function storeTheftEventState() {
18632:   state.events = state.events && typeof state.events === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events) ? state.events : {};
18633:   const saved = state.events.storeTheftEvent && typeof state.events.storeTheftEvent === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.events.storeTheftEvent)
18634:     ? state.events.storeTheftEvent
18635:     : {};
18636:   const validStages = new Set(['idle', 'intro1', 'choice', 'declined', 'intro2', 'intro3', 'farewell', 'pause', 'theftNotice', 'completed']);
18637:   state.events.storeTheftEvent = {
18638:     lastCheckedDate: /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(saved.lastCheckedDate || '')) ? String(saved.lastCheckedDate) : '',
18639:     totalTriggered: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalTriggered) || 0)),
18640:     active: Boolean(saved.active),
18641:     stage: validStages.has(saved.stage) ? saved.stage : 'idle',
18642:     branchId: String(saved.branchId || ''),
18643:     branchNumber: Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(saved.branchNumber) || 1)),
18644:     targetItemId: String(saved.targetItemId || ''),
18645:     targetItemName: String(saved.targetItemName || ''),
18646:     theftApplied: Boolean(saved.theftApplied),
18647:   };
18648:   if (!state.events.storeTheftEvent.active && !['idle', 'completed'].includes(state.events.storeTheftEvent.stage)) {
18649:     state.events.storeTheftEvent.stage = 'completed';
18650:   }
18651:   return state.events.storeTheftEvent;
18652: }

18654: function maybeStartStoreTheftEvent(branch = currentStoreBranch()) {
18655:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) return false;
18656:   const eventState = storeTheftEventState();
18657:   if (eventState.active) {
18658:     const activeBranchId = eventState.branchId || branch?.id || '';
18659:     setScreen('storeTheftEvent', activeBranchId ? { branchId: activeBranchId } : {}, false);
18660:     return true;
18661:   }
18662:   if (!branch) return false;
18663:   const candidates = robberyItemsInBranch(branch);
18664:   if (!candidates.length) return false;
18665:   if (!markVisitEventCheckOncePerDay(eventState)) return false;
18666:   if (Math.random() >= STORE_THEFT_EVENT_CHANCE) {
18667:     saveGame();
18668:     return false;
18669:   }
18670:   const target = randomFrom(candidates, candidates[0]);
18671:   if (!target?.item) return false;
18672:   eventState.totalTriggered += 1;
18673:   eventState.active = true;
18674:   eventState.stage = 'intro1';
18675:   eventState.branchId = String(branch.id || `branch-${Math.max(1, Number(branch.number) || 1)}`);
18676:   eventState.branchNumber = Math.max(1, Number(branch.number) || 1);
18677:   eventState.targetItemId = String(target.item.id || '');
18678:   eventState.targetItemName = String(target.item.name || '完成品');
18679:   eventState.theftApplied = false;
18680:   state.game.screen = 'storeTheftEvent';
18681:   saveGame();
18682:   setScreen('storeTheftEvent', { branchId: eventState.branchId }, false);
18683:   requestAnimationFrame(() => playSfx('old-lady-appear', { gain: .92 }));
18684:   vibrate([24, 28, 64]);
18685:   return true;
18686: }
18687: 
18688: function applyStoreTheftEventLoss() {
18689:   const eventState = storeTheftEventState();
18690:   if (eventState.theftApplied) return;
18691:   const itemId = String(eventState.targetItemId || '');
18692:   const itemName = String(eventState.targetItemName || '完成品');
18693:   const item = state.inventory?.jewelry?.find((entry) => entry.id === itemId && entry.status === 'displayed');
18694:   if (item) removeJewelry(item.id, { reason: 'stolen' });
18695:   eventState.theftApplied = true;
18696:   addNotification('店舗で盗難が発生しました', `${itemName}が盗まれていました。`, 'warning');
18697: }

18699: function chooseStoreTheftEvent(answer) {

18722: function recoverStoreTheftDisappearanceSequence() {
18723:   const eventState = storeTheftEventState();
18724:   if (!eventState.active || !['farewell', 'pause'].includes(eventState.stage)) return;
18725:   applyStoreTheftEventLoss();
18726:   eventState.stage = 'theftNotice';
18727:   saveGame();
18728:   playSfx('shoplift-steal', { gain: .76, rate: .88 });
18729:   vibrate([18, 32, 54]);
18730:   render();
18731: }
18732: 
18733: async function continueStoreTheftDisappearanceSequence() {
18734:   if (storeTheftSequenceRunning) return;
18735:   let eventState = storeTheftEventState();
18736:   if (!eventState.active || !['farewell', 'pause'].includes(eventState.stage)) return;
18737:   storeTheftSequenceRunning = true;
18738:   try {
18739:     if (eventState.stage === 'farewell') {
18740:       duckCurrentAmbient({ factor: 0.03, duration: 4600 });
18741:       playSfx('old-lady-appear', { gain: .24, rate: .66 });
18742:       await wait(1900);
18743:       eventState = storeTheftEventState();
18744:       if (!eventState.active || eventState.stage !== 'farewell') return;
18745:       eventState.stage = 'pause';
18746:       saveGame();
18747:       render();
18748:     }
18749:     eventState = storeTheftEventState();
18750:     if (eventState.stage === 'pause') {
18751:       duckCurrentAmbient({ factor: 0, duration: 2500 });
18752:       await wait(1650);
18753:       eventState = storeTheftEventState();
18754:       if (!eventState.active || eventState.stage !== 'pause') return;
18755:       applyStoreTheftEventLoss();
18756:       eventState = storeTheftEventState();
18757:       eventState.stage = 'theftNotice';
18758:       saveGame();
18759:       playSfx('shoplift-steal', { gain: .76, rate: .88 });
18760:       setTimeout(() => playSfx('impact', { gain: .20, rate: .72 }), 130);
18761:       vibrate([18, 32, 54]);
18762:       render();
18763:     }
18764:   } finally {
18765:     storeTheftSequenceRunning = false;
18766:   }
18767: }
18768: 
18769: async function advanceStoreTheftEvent() {
18770:   const eventState = storeTheftEventState();
18771:   if (!eventState.active) return;
18772:   if (eventState.stage === 'intro1') {
18773:     eventState.stage = 'choice';
18774:     saveGame();
18775:     playSfx('select', { gain: .82 });
18776:     render();
18777:     return;
18778:   }
18779:   if (eventState.stage === 'declined') {
18780:     finishStoreTheftEvent();
18781:     return;
18782:   }
18783:   if (eventState.stage === 'intro2') {
18784:     eventState.stage = 'intro3';
18785:     saveGame();
18786:     playSfx('select', { gain: .82 });
18787:     render();
18788:     return;
18789:   }
18790:   if (eventState.stage === 'intro3') {
18791:     eventState.stage = 'farewell';
18792:     saveGame();
18793:     playSfx('select', { gain: .72 });
18794:     duckCurrentAmbient({ factor: 0.03, duration: 4600 });
18795:     render();
18796:     queueMicrotask(continueStoreTheftDisappearanceSequence);
18797:     return;
18798:   }
18799:   if (eventState.stage === 'theftNotice') {
18800:     finishStoreTheftEvent();
18801:   }
18802: }
18803: 
18804: function renderStoreTheftEvent() {
18805:   const eventState = storeTheftEventState();
18806:   if (!eventState.active) {
18807:     const branchId = eventState.branchId;
18808:     queueMicrotask(() => setScreen('store', branchId ? { branchId } : {}, false));
18809:     return renderStore();
18810:   }
18811:   const stage = eventState.stage;
18812:   if (stage === 'farewell' || stage === 'pause') queueMicrotask(continueStoreTheftDisappearanceSequence);

18826:       ? 'あら、素敵なお店、素敵なジュエリーねぇ'

18828:         ? 'あら残念、でもまた来るわね'
18829:         : stage === 'intro2'

18837:   }
18838:   return `

18840:       <section class="visit-character-event store-theft-event ${characterHidden ? 'is-after' : ''} ${vanishing ? 'is-vanishing' : ''}" aria-live="polite">

18844:         ${bodyMarkup}

18979: function renderShowcaseSlot(slot, showcaseIndex, slotIndex, branch = currentStoreBranch()) {

18994: function renderShowcaseSelection() {

19020: function renderShowcaseItemDetail() {
19021:   const branch = state.store.branches?.find((entry) => entry.id === screenData.branchId) || currentStoreBranch();
19022:   const showcaseIndex = Math.max(0, Number(screenData.showcaseIndex) || 0);
19023:   const slotIndex = Math.max(0, Number(screenData.slotIndex) || 0);
19024:   const slot = branchShowcases(branch)?.[showcaseIndex]?.slots?.[slotIndex];
19025:   const item = slot ? state.inventory.jewelry.find((entry) => entry.id === slot.jewelryId) : null;
19026:   if (!branch || !slot || !item) {
19027:     return shell('商品詳細', `<section class="center-card glass-panel"><div class="empty-state"><strong>商品が見つかりません。</strong><p>ショーケースへ戻って確認してください。</p></div><button class="primary-button full-button" data-action="back">店舗へ戻る</button></section>`);
19028:   }
19029:   const savedPrice = showcaseSellingPrice(slot, item);
19030:   const price = normalizeSellingPrice(
19031:     Number.isFinite(Number(screenData.pendingSellingPrice)) ? screenData.pendingSellingPrice : savedPrice,
19032:     item.recommendedPrice || savedPrice
19033:   );
19034:   const priceChanged = price !== savedPrice;
19035:   const priceStatus = sellingPriceStatus(item, price);
19036:   const expectedProfit = price - Math.max(0, Number(item.cost) || 0);
19037:   const looseLabel = item.useLoose === false ? 'ルースなし' : looseDisplayLabel(item.gem, item.looseShape);
19038:   return shell('商品詳細', `
19039:     <section class="showcase-detail-panel glass-panel">
19040:       <div class="showcase-detail-visual jewelry-preview large completion-jewelry-preview metal-${item.metal} item-${item.item}" style="--gem:${GEMS[item.gem]?.hue || '#ffffff'}">
19041:         <span class="completion-jewelry-artwork item-${item.item}">
19042:           ${jewelryItemVisual(item.item, 'jewelry-item-shape large', item.useLoose !== false)}

19075: 
19076: function updateShowcaseDetailPricePreview(price, savedPrice, item) {
19077:   if (screen !== 'showcaseDetail' || !item) return false;
19078:   const panel = root.querySelector('.showcase-detail-panel');
19079:   if (!panel) return false;
19080:   const normalizedPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(price, item.recommendedPrice || savedPrice || 1000);
19081:   const normalizedSavedPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(savedPrice, item.recommendedPrice || normalizedPrice);
19082:   const priceStatus = sellingPriceStatus(item, normalizedPrice);
19083:   const expectedProfit = normalizedPrice - Math.max(0, Number(item.cost) || 0);
19084:   const priceValue = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-value]');
19085:   const expectedProfitValue = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-expected-profit]');
19086:   const priceStatusValue = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-status]');
19087:   const confirmButton = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-confirm]');
19088:   const downButton = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-down]');
19089:   if (priceValue) priceValue.textContent = yen(normalizedPrice);
19090:   if (expectedProfitValue) expectedProfitValue.textContent = yen(expectedProfit);
19091:   if (priceStatusValue) {
19092:     priceStatusValue.textContent = priceStatus.name;
19093:     priceStatusValue.className = `price-status ${priceStatus.id}`;
19094:   }
19095:   if (confirmButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) confirmButton.disabled = normalizedPrice === normalizedSavedPrice;
19096:   if (downButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) downButton.disabled = normalizedPrice <= 1000;
19097:   return Boolean(priceValue && expectedProfitValue && priceStatusValue && confirmButton && downButton);
19098: }
19099: 
19100: function adjustShowcaseSellingPrice(button) {
19101:   if (!button || button.disabled || screen !== 'showcaseDetail') return false;
19102:   const branch = button.dataset.branch
19103:     ? state.store.branches?.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.branch)
19104:     : currentStoreBranch();
19105:   const showcaseIndex = Number(button.dataset.showcase);
19106:   const slotIndex = Number(button.dataset.slot);
19107:   const slot = branchShowcases(branch)?.[showcaseIndex]?.slots?.[slotIndex];
19108:   if (!slot) return false;
19109:   const item = state.inventory.jewelry.find((entry) => entry.id === slot.jewelryId);
19110:   if (!item) return false;
19111:   const savedPrice = showcaseSellingPrice(slot, item);
19112:   const currentPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(
19113:     Number.isFinite(Number(screenData.pendingSellingPrice)) ? screenData.pendingSellingPrice : savedPrice,
19114:     item.recommendedPrice || savedPrice
19115:   );
19116:   const delta = Number(button.dataset.delta) < 0 ? -1000 : 1000;
19117:   const nextPrice = Math.max(1000, currentPrice + delta);
19118:   if (nextPrice === currentPrice) return false;
19119:   screenData.pendingSellingPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(nextPrice, item.recommendedPrice || 1000);
19120:   if (!updateShowcaseDetailPricePreview(screenData.pendingSellingPrice, savedPrice, item)) render();
19121:   return true;
19122: }

19127: function customerPreferenceLabel(request) {
19128:   const preference = request?.preference || { type: 'gem', value: request?.gem };
19129:   if (preference.label) return formatCustomerPreferenceLabel(preference);
19130:   let resolvedName = '';
19131:   if (preference.type === 'metal') resolvedName = METALS[preference.value]?.name || '';
19132:   else if (preference.type === 'design') resolvedName = DESIGNS[preference.value]?.name || '';
19133:   else if (preference.type !== 'color') resolvedName = GEMS[preference.value]?.name || '';
19134:   return formatCustomerPreferenceLabel(preference, resolvedName);
19135: }
19136: 
19137: function customerPreferenceMatches(item, request) {
19138:   const preference = request?.preference || { type: 'gem', value: request?.gem };
19139:   if (preference.type === 'metal') return item.metal === preference.value;
19140:   if (preference.type === 'design') return item.design === preference.value;
19141:   if (item.useLoose === false) return false;
19142:   if (preference.type === 'color') {
19143:     const acceptedGems = Array.isArray(preference.gems) ? preference.gems : [];
19144:     return acceptedGems.includes(item.gem);
19145:   }
19146:   return item.gem === preference.value;
19147: }
19148: 
19149: function customerMatchResult(item, request, branchNumber = state?.store?.branchNumber || 1) {
19150:   const price = sellingPriceForJewelry(item);
19151:   const budget = Math.max(1000, Number(request?.budget) || 1000);
19152:   const matches = Number(item.item === request?.item)
19153:     + Number(price <= budget)
19154:     + Number(customerPreferenceMatches(item, request));
19155:   const farOverBudget = price > budget * 1.25;
19156:   const labels = ['ほとんど売れない', '売れにくい', '購入の可能性あり', 'かなり売れやすい'];
19157:   const chances = [0.05, 0.20, 0.55, 0.90];
19158:   const salesStaff = activeStoreStaff(branchNumber);
19159:   // v0.10.628: 店舗スタッフの有無を接客購入率へ大きく反映する。
19160:   // 無人時は接客力不足で-10pt、配置中は基礎+10ptにスタッフLvの購入率ボーナスを加える。
19161:   const staffingPurchaseModifier = salesStaff
19162:     ? 0.10 + storeStaffPurchaseBonus(branchNumber)
19163:     : -0.10;
19164:   const baseChance = chances[matches] + storeProductSaleBonus(item, branchNumber) + staffingPurchaseModifier;
19165:   return {
19166:     matches,
19167:     price,
19168:     farOverBudget,
19169:     label: farOverBudget ? '予算を大きく超えている' : labels[matches],
19170:     chance: farOverBudget ? 0 : clamp(baseChance, 0.02, 0.95),
19171:   };
19172: }

19176:   if (!storeBusinessOpen()) return shell('お客様', '<div class="empty-state"><strong>店舗の営業時間外です。</strong><p>接客と注文受付は9:00～19:00です。</p><button class="primary-button" data-action="nav" data-screen="store">店舗へ戻る</button></div>');

19182:   if (Number(customerState.visitingBranchNumber || state.store.branchNumber) !== Number(state.store.branchNumber)) return shell('お客様', '<div class="empty-state"><strong>このお客様は別の店舗へ来店しています。</strong><p>来店中の店舗を開いて接客してください。</p><button class="primary-button" data-action="nav" data-screen="store">店舗一覧へ</button></div>');

19197:   const canProposeProduct = customerState.wishesHeard && proposedIds.length < 2 && candidates.some(({ item }) => !proposedIds.includes(item.id)) && canSpendStoreMinutes(proposalMinutes);

19204:   const customerProfile = customerProfileData(customerId, request);
