19257: function renderOrders() {
19258:   const active = state.orders.filter((order) => !orderClosed(order));
19259:   const completedSource = [
19260:     ...(state.orders || []).filter((order) => orderClosed(order)),
19261:     ...(state.history?.closedOrders || []),
19262:   ];
19263:   const completed = completedSource
19264:     .map((order, index) => ({ order, index }))
19265:     .sort((a, b) => orderClosedSortValue(b.order, b.index) - orderClosedSortValue(a.order, a.index))
19266:     .map(({ order }) => order);
19267:   const rows = active.map((order) => {
19268:     const customer = CUSTOMERS[order.customerId];
19269:     const customerProfile = orderCustomerProfile(order.customerId, order);
19270:     const requirements = orderRequirements(order);
19271:     const feasibility = orderFeasibility(order);
19272:     const difficulty = orderDifficulty(order);
19273:     const remaining = order.deadlineDay - state.game.day;
19274:     const deadlineText = `${gameDateLabel(order.deadlineDay)}（${remaining === 0 ? '本日' : `あと${Math.max(0, remaining)}日`}）`;
19275:     const isCrafted = order.status === '完成';
19276:     const deliveryBranch = storeBranchByNumber(order.branchNumber);
19277:     const deliveryOpen = storeDeliveryOpen();
19278:     const deliveryBranchOperating = storeBranchOperating(deliveryBranch);
19279:     const deadlinePassed = state.game.day > Number(order.deadlineDay);
19280:     const canDeliverNow = isCrafted && deliveryOpen && deliveryBranchOperating && !deadlinePassed;
19281:     const unpaidStoreRent = Math.max(0, Number(deliveryBranch?.unpaidRent) || 0);
19282:     let deliveryBlockedReason = '';
19283:     let deliveryButtonLabel = '納品する';
19284:     if (isCrafted && !canDeliverNow) {
19285:       if (!deliveryBranch) {
19286:         deliveryBlockedReason = '注文を受けた店舗が見つからないため納品できません。';
19287:         deliveryButtonLabel = '店舗を確認できません';
19288:       } else if (!deliveryBranchOperating) {
19289:         deliveryBlockedReason = unpaidStoreRent > 0
19290:           ? `注文を受けた${storeBranchDisplayName(deliveryBranch)}は、未払い家賃${yen(unpaidStoreRent)}のため休業中です。スマートフォンの収支画面から未払いを支払うと納品できます。`
19291:           : `注文を受けた${storeBranchDisplayName(deliveryBranch)}が休業中のため納品できません。`;
19292:         deliveryButtonLabel = '店舗休業中';
19293:       } else if (!deliveryOpen) {
19294:         deliveryBlockedReason = '注文品を納品できる時間は9:00～19:00です。';
19295:         deliveryButtonLabel = '店舗営業時間外';
19296:       } else if (deadlinePassed) {
19297:         deliveryBlockedReason = '納期を過ぎているため、この注文は納品できません。';
19298:         deliveryButtonLabel = '納期超過';
19299:       }
19300:     }
19301:     const materialsReady = requirements.enoughMetal && requirements.enoughLoose;
19302:     const craftReady = order.status === '受注' && materialsReady && feasibility.artisanReady && feasibility.equipmentReady;
19303:     const missingRows = [];
19304:     if (!requirements.enoughMetal) missingRows.push(`${METALS[order.metal].name} ${requirements.missingMetalWeight}g`);
19305:     if (!requirements.enoughLoose) missingRows.push(`${looseDisplayLabel(order.gem, order.looseShape, { suffix: true })} ${requirements.missingLooseQuantity}個`);
19306:     if (!feasibility.artisanReady) missingRows.push(`職人Lv.${feasibility.requiredArtisanLevel}`);
19307:     if (!feasibility.equipmentReady) missingRows.push(...feasibility.requiredTools.filter((toolId) => !toolUsable(toolId)).map((toolId) => WORKSHOP_TOOLS[toolId]?.name || toolId));

19310:     const estimatedCost = Math.max(0, Number(order.estimatedCost) || 0);
19311:     const estimatedProfit = Number.isFinite(Number(order.estimatedProfit)) ? Number(order.estimatedProfit) : Number(order.price) - estimatedCost;
19312:     return `<article class="order-sheet">
19313:       <header class="order-sheet-header">
19314:         <div class="order-customer-image"><img src="${esc(image)}?v=${VERSION}" alt="${esc(order.customerName)}さん"></div>
19315:         <div class="order-customer-summary">
19316:           <small>注文者</small>
19317:           <div class="order-customer-name-profile">
19318:             <div class="order-customer-name-line"><h2>${esc(order.customerName)}</h2><span class="order-customer-relation">${esc(customerProfile.relation)}</span></div>
19319:             <div class="order-customer-profile-inline">
19320:               <span class="wide"><b>概要</b>${esc(customerProfile.profile)}</span>
19321:               <span><b>年代・職業</b>${esc(`${customerProfile.ageGroup}・${customerProfile.occupation}`)}</span>
19322:               <span><b>使用者</b>${esc(customerProfile.wearer)}</span>
19323:               <span class="wide"><b>来店目的</b>${esc(customerProfile.purpose)}</span>
19324:               <span><b>着用場面</b>${esc(customerProfile.wearingScene)}</span>
19325:               <span class="wide"><b>好み</b>${esc(customerProfile.preference)}</span>
19326:               <span class="wide"><b>予算の考え方</b>${esc(customerProfile.budgetStyle)}</span>

19464: function kaitenzushiAudioParameters() {
19465:   const settings = state?.settings || {};
19466:   return new URLSearchParams({
19467:     embedded: '1',
19468:     budget: String(Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(kaitenzushiSession?.budget ?? state?.game?.money) || 0))),
19469:     free: kaitenzushiSession?.free ? '1' : '0',
19470:     // BGMと環境音は親ゲーム側で管理し、iframe側は効果音だけを担当する。
19471:     bgmVolume: '0',
19472:     sfxVolume: String(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(settings.sfxVolume) || 0))),
19473:     ambientVolume: '0',
19474:     bgmMuted: '1',
19475:     sfxMuted: settings.sfxMuted ? '1' : '0',
19476:     ambientMuted: '1',
19477:     externalAudioPriority: '0',
19478:   });
19479: }

19486: function kaitenzushiFrameSource() {

19489:   return `./assets/minigames/kaitenzushi/game/index.html?${query}#${hash}`;
19490: }

19492: function kaitenzushiEmbeddedDocument() {
19493:   const config = kaitenzushiAudioParameters().toString()
19494:     .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
19495:     .replaceAll('"', '&quot;')
19496:     .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
19497:     .replaceAll('>', '&gt;');
19498:   return getKaitenzushiEmbeddedHtml()
19499:     .replace('__JXJ_CONFIG__', config)
19500:     .replace('__JXJ_ATTEMPT__', String(kaitenzushiLoadNonce));
19501: }

19512:   }

19538: function showKaitenzushiLoadError(reason = '') {
19539:   if (screen !== 'kaitenzushi') return;
19540:   clearKaitenzushiLoadWatch();
19541:   if (kaitenzushiSession) kaitenzushiSession.loadError = true;
19542:   const stage = root.querySelector('.kaitenzushi-game-screen');
19543:   const frame = root.querySelector('[data-kaitenzushi-frame]');
19544:   if (!(stage instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
19545:   if (frame instanceof HTMLIFrameElement) frame.hidden = true;
19546:   stage.querySelector('.kaitenzushi-load-error')?.remove();
19547:   stage.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<section class="kaitenzushi-load-error" role="alert">
19548:     <strong>回転寿司を読み込めませんでした</strong>
19549:     <p>ゲーム本体の画面へ誤って戻らないよう停止しました。通信またはキャッシュを更新して、もう一度読み込んでください。</p>
19550:     ${reason ? `<small>${esc(reason)}</small>` : ''}
19551:     <div class="kaitenzushi-load-error-actions">
19552:       <button type="button" class="primary-button" data-action="retry-kaitenzushi">もう一度読み込む</button>
19553:       <button type="button" class="secondary-button" data-action="cancel-kaitenzushi">食事選択へ戻る</button>
19554:     </div>
19555:   </section>`);
19556: }

19558: function retryKaitenzushi() {
19559:   if (screen !== 'kaitenzushi') return;
19560:   clearKaitenzushiLoadWatch();
19561:   kaitenzushiLoadNonce += 1;
19562:   if (kaitenzushiSession) {
19563:     kaitenzushiSession.ready = false;
19564:     kaitenzushiSession.loadError = false;
19565:   }
19566:   render();
19567: }

19575: function postKaitenzushiSettings(frame) {
19576:   if (!(frame instanceof HTMLIFrameElement)) return;
19577:   const settings = state?.settings || {};
19578:   frame.contentWindow?.postMessage({
19579:     source: 'jxj-kaitenzushi-parent',
19580:     type: 'settings',
19581:     // 回転寿司のBGM・環境音は親ゲーム側で再生する。iframeでは食事効果音だけを有効にする。
19582:     bgmVolume: 0,
19583:     sfxVolume: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(settings.sfxVolume) || 0)),
19584:     ambientVolume: 0,
19585:     bgmMuted: true,
19586:     sfxMuted: Boolean(settings.sfxMuted),
19587:     ambientMuted: true,
19588:     externalAudioPriority: false,
19589:   }, '*');
19590: }
19591: 
19592: function bindKaitenzushiFrame() {
19593:   const frame = root.querySelector('[data-kaitenzushi-frame]');
19594:   if (!(frame instanceof HTMLIFrameElement)) return;
19595:   clearKaitenzushiLoadWatch();
19596: 
19597:   let launchAssigned = false;
19598:   let correctDocumentSeen = false;
19599:   const handleLoad = () => {
19600:     if (screen !== 'kaitenzushi' || !launchAssigned) return;
19601:     let marker = '';
19602:     let href = '';
19603:     try {
19604:       marker = frame.contentDocument?.documentElement?.dataset?.jxjKaitenzushi || '';
19605:       href = frame.contentWindow?.location?.href || '';
19606:     } catch (_) {}
19607:     // iframe creation can emit an initial about:blank load before srcdoc is committed.
19608:     if (!marker && (href === 'about:blank' || href === '')) return;
19609:     if (marker !== '1') {
19610:       showKaitenzushiLoadError('回転寿司ではない画面が読み込まれました。');
19611:       return;
19612:     }
19613:     correctDocumentSeen = true;
19614:     postKaitenzushiSettings(frame);
19615:     if (kaitenzushiSession?.ready) return;
19616:     clearKaitenzushiLoadWatch();
19617:     kaitenzushiReadyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
19618:       if (screen === 'kaitenzushi' && !kaitenzushiSession?.ready) {
19619:         showKaitenzushiLoadError('回転寿司から起動完了の応答がありません。');
19620:       }
19621:     }, 12000);
19622:   };
19623: 
19624:   frame.addEventListener('load', handleLoad);
19625:   frame.addEventListener('error', () => showKaitenzushiLoadError('回転寿司の画面を準備できませんでした。'), { once: true });
19626:   launchAssigned = true;
19627: 
19628:   try {
19629:     if ('srcdoc' in frame) {
19630:       // content://・PWA・GitHub Pagesのどの起動方法でも、別ページ遷移を行わず同じ文書を直接起動する。
19631:       frame.srcdoc = kaitenzushiEmbeddedDocument();
19632:     } else {
19633:       // 古いブラウザだけ従来の同一オリジンURLへフォールバックする。
19634:       frame.src = kaitenzushiFrameSource();
19635:     }
19636:   } catch (_) {
19637:     frame.src = kaitenzushiFrameSource();
19638:   }
19639: 
19640:   clearKaitenzushiLoadWatch();
19641:   kaitenzushiReadyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
19642:     if (screen !== 'kaitenzushi' || kaitenzushiSession?.ready) return;
19643:     showKaitenzushiLoadError(correctDocumentSeen
19644:       ? '回転寿司から起動完了の応答がありません。'
19645:       : '回転寿司の画面を準備できませんでした。');
19646:   }, 15000);
19647: }
19648: 
19649: function startKaitenzushi({ skipEventCheck = false, free = false } = {}) {
19650:   // v0.10.654: 大将イベントの途中復帰は、満腹・同一食事・所持金・時間制限より先に扱う。
19651:   // PWA再読込後でも、既に発生済みの無料イベントを新規食事条件で失わない。
19652:   const savedSushiEvent = sushiChefEventState();
19653:   if (!skipEventCheck && savedSushiEvent.active && !['idle', 'completed'].includes(savedSushiEvent.stage)) {
19654:     if (savedSushiEvent.stage === 'playing') {
19655:       kaitenzushiSession = {
19656:         budget: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
19657:         total: 0,
19658:         plates: 0,
19659:         settled: false,
19660:         free: true,

19700: function completeKaitenzushi(totalValue, plateValue) {
19701:   clearKaitenzushiLoadWatch();
19702:   const session = kaitenzushiSession;
19703:   if (!session || session.settled || screen !== 'kaitenzushi') return;
19704:   session.settled = true;
19705: 
19706:   const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(totalValue) || 0));
19707:   const plates = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(plateValue) || 0));
19708:   const totalsMatchProgress = total === session.total && plates === session.plates;
19709:   const plateTotalsArePlausible = session.free
19710:     ? total === 0
19711:     : (plates === 0 ? total === 0 : total >= plates * 190 && total <= plates * 850);
19712:   if (!totalsMatchProgress || !plateTotalsArePlausible || (!session.free && (total > session.budget || total > state.game.money))) {
19713:     session.settled = false;
19714:     showToast('お会計金額を確認できませんでした。もう一度お試しください。', 'error');
19715:     return;
19716:   }
19717: 
19718:   const before = hungerLevel();
19719:   if (total > 0) {
19720:     state.game.money -= total;
19721:     addFinance('回転寿司で食事', 0, total);
19722:     startMoneyFeedback(-total, 1200);
19723:   }
19724: 
19725:   const maxHunger = Math.max(1, Number(state.wellbeing.maxHunger) || 7);
19726:   if (plates > 0) spendMealTime();
19727:   state.wellbeing.hunger = Math.min(maxHunger, hungerLevel() + plates);
19728:   const recovery = state.wellbeing.hunger - before;
19729:   if (plates > 0) {
19730:     state.wellbeing.lastMeal = 'kaitenzushi';
19731:     state.wellbeing.mealsEaten = Math.max(0, Number(state.wellbeing.mealsEaten) || 0) + 1;
19732:     state.daily.meals.push({
19733:       id: 'kaitenzushi',
19734:       name: '回転寿司',
19735:       price: total,
19736:       recovery,
19737:       plates,
19738:     });
19739:   }
19740:   if (session.free) {
19741:     const eventState = sushiChefEventState();
19742:     eventState.active = true;
19743:     eventState.stage = 'farewell';
19744:     eventState.lastPlates = plates;
19745:     eventState.lastHungerBefore = before;
19746:     eventState.lastHungerAfter = state.wellbeing.hunger;
19747:     state.game.screen = 'sushiChefEvent';
19748:     saveGame();
19749:     kaitenzushiSession = null;
19750:     // 会計ボタン側で無料会計の成功音を鳴らすため、ここでは振動だけにして二重再生を防ぐ。
19751:     vibrate([32, 28, 55]);
19752:     setScreen('sushiChefEvent', {}, false);
19753:     return;
19754:   }
19755: 
19756:   state.game.screen = 'main';
19757:   saveGame();
19758: 
19759:   kaitenzushiSession = null;
19760:   if (plates > 0) {
19761:     hungerFeedback = { before, after: state.wellbeing.hunger, mealName: `回転寿司（${plates}皿）` };
19762:     clearTimeout(hungerFeedbackTimer);
19763:     goMain();
19764:     showToast(`ごちそうさまでした　${plates}皿・${yen(total)}`, 'meal-complete', false);
19765:     playSfx('levelup');
19766:     hungerFeedbackTimer = setTimeout(() => {
19767:       hungerFeedback = null;
19768:       if (screen === 'main') render();
19769:     }, 1550);
19770:   } else {
19771:     goMain();
19772:     showToast('何も食べずにお店を出ました。', 'info', false);
19773:   }
19774: }

19776: function handleKaitenzushiMessage(event) {
19777:   if (screen !== 'kaitenzushi' || !kaitenzushiSession) return;
19778:   const frame = root.querySelector('[data-kaitenzushi-frame]');
19779:   if (!(frame instanceof HTMLIFrameElement) || event.source !== frame.contentWindow) return;
19780:   const message = event.data;
19781:   if (!message || message.source !== 'jxj-kaitenzushi') return;
19782:   if (message.type === 'ready') {
19783:     kaitenzushiSession.ready = true;
19784:     kaitenzushiSession.loadError = false;
19785:     clearKaitenzushiLoadWatch();
19786:     postKaitenzushiSettings(frame);
19787:     return;
19788:   }
19789:   if (message.type === 'chew') {
19790:     duckCurrentAmbient({ factor: .2, duration: 1000 });
19791:     return;
19792:   }
19793:   const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(message.total) || 0));
19794:   const plates = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(message.plates) || 0));
19795:   if (total <= kaitenzushiSession.budget) {
19796:     kaitenzushiSession.total = total;
19797:     kaitenzushiSession.plates = plates;
19798:   }
19799:   if (message.type === 'checkout') {
19800:     playSfx(kaitenzushiSession.free ? 'success' : 'coin', { gain: kaitenzushiSession.free ? .82 : .72 });
19801:     completeKaitenzushi(total, plates);
19802:   }
19803: }

19831: function waitForMealEatingCompletion({ autoDelay = 2500, eatSoundDelay = 420 } = {}) {
19832:   return new Promise((resolve) => {
19833:     let settled = false;
19834:     let autoTimer = null;
19835:     let soundTimer = null;
19836:     const finish = (reason = 'auto') => {
19837:       if (settled) return false;
19838:       settled = true;
19839:       if (autoTimer) clearTimeout(autoTimer);
19840:       if (soundTimer) clearTimeout(soundTimer);
19841:       if (mealEatingCompletionController?.finish === finish) mealEatingCompletionController = null;
19842:       resolve(reason);
19843:       return true;
19844:     };
19845:     mealEatingCompletionController = { finish };
19846:     soundTimer = setTimeout(() => {
19847:       if (!settled) playSfx('eat');
19848:     }, Math.max(0, Number(eatSoundDelay) || 420));
19849:     autoTimer = setTimeout(() => finish('auto'), Math.max(300, Number(autoDelay) || 2500));
19850:   });
19851: }

19882: async function eatMeal(mealId, { skipEventCheck = false, priceOverride = null } = {}) {
19883:   const meal = MEALS[mealId];
19884:   if (!meal || mealTransitioning) return;
19885: 
19886:   // v0.10.654: 途中イベントの復帰は、満腹・同一食事・所持金・時間制限より先に判定する。
19887:   if (!skipEventCheck && resumeActiveMealEvent(mealId)) return;
19888: 
19889:   const before = hungerLevel();
19890:   if (before >= 7) return showToast('空腹度は満タンです。', 'error');
19891:   if (mealId !== 'ice' && state.wellbeing.mealsEaten > 0 && state.wellbeing.lastMeal === mealId) return showToast('栄養が片寄るので違うものを食べましょう', 'error');
19892:   const actualPrice = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(priceOverride ?? meal.price) || 0));
19893:   if (state.game.money < actualPrice) return showToast('所持金が足りません。', 'error');
19894:   if (!canSpendMealTime()) return showToast(mealTimeUnavailableMessage(), 'error');
19895:   if (mealId === 'convenience' && !skipEventCheck && maybeStartCyclopsEvent()) return;
19896:   if (mealId === 'ice' && !skipEventCheck && maybeStartWhiteBunnyIceEvent()) return;
19897:   if (mealId === 'kebab' && !skipEventCheck && maybeStartEmeraldCaptainKebabEvent()) return;
19898:   if (mealId === 'hamburger' && !skipEventCheck && tryRandomEventStarters([
19899:     () => maybeStartTouristWoodSwordEvent(),
19900:     () => maybeStartTerryCaliforniaEvent(),
19901:   ])) return;
19902:   if (mealId === 'indian' && !skipEventCheck && tryRandomEventStarters([
19903:     () => maybeStartDiamondPolishingLapEvent(),
19904:     () => maybeStartGaneshaTuskEvent(),
19905:   ])) return;
19906:   if (mealId === 'ramen' && !skipEventCheck && maybeStartChildhoodFriendEvent()) return;
19907:   if (mealId === 'soba' && !skipEventCheck && maybeStartRidleyOkazakiSobaEvent()) return;
19908:   if (mealId === 'chinese' && !skipEventCheck && maybeStartMysteryChineseMealEvent()) return;
19909:   if (mealId === 'korean' && !skipEventCheck && maybeStartGrayHoodAquariumEvent()) return;
19910: 
19911:   mealTransitioning = true;
19912:   const stateBeforeMeal = structuredClone(state);
19913:   let mealCommitted = false;
19914:   try {
19915:     selectedMeal = mealId;

19919: 
19920:     // v0.10.654: 支払い・時間・空腹回復・履歴を一括確定してから食事演出へ入る。
19921:     // 演出中にPWAを閉じても「代金だけ支払い済み」の中間セーブを作らない。
19922:     state.game.money -= actualPrice;
19923:     addFinance(`${meal.name}で食事`, 0, actualPrice);
19924:     spendMealTime();
19925:     state.wellbeing.hunger = Math.min(7, hungerLevel() + meal.recovery);
19926:     state.wellbeing.lastMeal = mealId;
19927:     state.wellbeing.mealsEaten += 1;
19928:     state.daily.meals.push({ id: mealId, name: meal.name, price: actualPrice, recovery: state.wellbeing.hunger - before });
19929:     saveGame();
19930:     mealCommitted = true;
19931:     startMoneyFeedback(-actualPrice, 1200);
19932: 
19933:     setScreen('meal', { mealId, eating: true }, false);
19934:     const eatingCompletion = waitForMealEatingCompletion();

19939:     clearTimeout(hungerFeedbackTimer);
19940:     if (mealId === 'ice' && startOyatsuIceReturnAfterMeal()) {
19941:       showToast('ごちそうさまでした', 'meal-complete', false);

19945:     }

19951:       if (screen === 'main') render();

19956:     if (!mealCommitted) {
19957:       state = stateBeforeMeal;
19958:       screen = 'main';
19959:       screenData = {};
19960:       navigation = [];

20009: function giftSendableRows(category) {
20010:   if (!state?.inventory) return [];
20011:   if (category === 'rough') {
20012:     return Object.values(GEMS).map((gem) => {
20013:       const max = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.inventory.rough?.[gem.id]) || 0));
20014:       return { key: gem.id, name: roughDisplayName(gem.id), max, payload: { type: 'rough', id: gem.id, name: roughDisplayName(gem.id) } };
20015:     }).filter((row) => row.max > 0);
20016:   }
20017:   if (category === 'loose') {
20018:     const rows = [];
20019:     for (const gem of Object.values(GEMS)) {
20020:       for (const shapeId of looseShapeIdsForGem(gem.id)) {
20021:         const max = looseAvailableQuantity(gem.id, shapeId);
20022:         if (max <= 0) continue;
20023:         rows.push({
20024:           key: `${gem.id}|${shapeId}`,
20025:           name: looseDisplayLabel(gem.id, shapeId),
20026:           max,
20027:           payload: { type: 'loose', id: gem.id, shapeId, name: looseDisplayLabel(gem.id, shapeId, { suffix: true }) },
20028:         });
20029:       }
20030:     }
20031:     return rows;
20032:   }
20033:   if (category === 'item') {
20034:     return Object.values(GENERAL_ITEMS).map((item) => {
20035:       const max = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.inventory.items?.[item.id]) || 0));
20036:       return { key: item.id, name: item.name, max, payload: { type: 'item', id: item.id, name: item.name } };
20037:     }).filter((row) => row.max > 0);
20038:   }
20039:   if (category === 'metal') {
20040:     return Object.values(METALS).map((metal) => {
20041:       const max = Math.max(0, Math.floor(metalAvailableWeight(metal.id)));
20042:       return { key: metal.id, name: metal.shortName || metal.name, max, payload: { type: 'metal', id: metal.id, name: `${metal.shortName || metal.name}地金` } };
20043:     }).filter((row) => row.max >= 1);
20044:   }
20045:   if (category === 'jewelry') {
20046:     return (state.inventory.jewelry || []).filter((item) => item.status === 'stored').map((item) => ({
20047:       key: item.id,
20048:       name: item.name || '完成品',
20049:       max: 1,
20050:       payload: { type: 'jewelry', id: item.id, name: item.name || '完成品', itemData: structuredClone(item) },
20051:     }));
20052:   }
20053:   return [];
20054: }

20056: function normalizeGiftDraft() {
20057:   const categories = ['rough', 'loose', 'item', 'metal', 'jewelry'];
20058:   if (!categories.includes(giftDraft.category)) giftDraft.category = 'rough';
20059:   const rows = giftSendableRows(giftDraft.category);
20060:   if (!rows.some((row) => row.key === giftDraft.itemKey)) giftDraft.itemKey = rows[0]?.key || '';
20061:   const row = rows.find((entry) => entry.key === giftDraft.itemKey) || rows[0] || null;
20062:   if (!row) giftDraft.quantity = 1;
20063:   else giftDraft.quantity = Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.floor(row.max), Math.floor(Number(giftDraft.quantity) || 1)));
20064:   return { rows, row };
20065: }

20090: function adjustGiftQuantity(delta) {

20107:     return item?.image
20108:       ? `<img class="${className}" src="${esc(item.image)}?v=${VERSION}" alt="${esc(payload.name || item.name)}" draggable="false">`
20109:       : `<span class="${className}" role="img" aria-label="${esc(payload.name || item?.name || 'アイテム')}">${esc(item?.symbol || '◆')}</span>`;
20110:   }
20111:   if (payload.type === 'jewelry') {
20112:     const item = payload.itemData || {};
20113:     return `<span class="gift-jewelry-visual ${className}">${jewelryItemVisual(item.item, 'jewelry-item-shape', item.useLoose !== false)}${item.useLoose === false ? '' : jewelryLooseSetVisual(item.item, item.gem, item.looseShape, 'small')}</span>`;
20114:   }
20115:   return `<span class="${className}" aria-hidden="true">◆</span>`;
20116: }

20118: function giftOutboxEntry(code, payload, status = 'pending') {
20119:   const summary = giftPayloadSummary(payload);
20120:   return {
20121:     code,
20122:     status,
20123:     category: summary.category,
20124:     name: summary.name,
20125:     quantity: summary.quantity,
20126:     createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
20127:   };

20130: function removeGiftFromGameState(gameState, payload, code) {
20131:   const inventory = gameState?.inventory;
20132:   if (!inventory) throw new Error('在庫データを確認できません。');
20133:   const quantity = payload.type === 'metal' ? giftRoundedWeight(payload.quantity) : Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(payload.quantity) || 1));
20134:   if (payload.type === 'rough') {
20135:     if (!GEMS[payload.id]) throw new Error('原石データを確認できません。');
20136:     const current = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.rough?.[payload.id]) || 0));
20137:     if (current < quantity) throw new Error('原石の所持数が足りません。');
20138:     inventory.rough[payload.id] = current - quantity;
20139:   } else if (payload.type === 'loose') {
20140:     if (!GEMS[payload.id] || !looseShapeIdsForGem(payload.id).includes(payload.shapeId)) throw new Error('ルースデータを確認できません。');
20141:     const current = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.loose?.[payload.id]?.[payload.shapeId]) || 0));
20142:     if (current < quantity) throw new Error('ルースの所持数が足りません。');
20143:     inventory.loose[payload.id][payload.shapeId] = current - quantity;
20144:   } else if (payload.type === 'item') {
20145:     if (!GENERAL_ITEMS[payload.id]) throw new Error('アイテムデータを確認できません。');
20146:     const current = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.items?.[payload.id]) || 0));
20147:     if (current < quantity) throw new Error('アイテムの所持数が足りません。');
20148:     inventory.items[payload.id] = current - quantity;
20149:   } else if (payload.type === 'metal') {
20150:     if (!METALS[payload.id]) throw new Error('地金データを確認できません。');
20151:     const current = giftRoundedWeight(inventory.metals?.[payload.id]);
20152:     if (quantity < 0.1 || current + 0.0001 < quantity) throw new Error('地金の所持重量が足りません。');
20153:     inventory.metals[payload.id] = giftRoundedWeight(current - quantity);
20154:   } else if (payload.type === 'jewelry') {
20155:     const index = (inventory.jewelry || []).findIndex((item) => item.id === payload.id && item.status === 'stored');
20156:     if (index < 0) throw new Error('この完成品は現在プレゼントにできません。');
20157:     inventory.jewelry.splice(index, 1);
20158:   } else throw new Error('プレゼントの種類を確認できません。');
20159:   const gifts = ensureGiftState(gameState);
20160:   gifts.outbox.unshift(giftOutboxEntry(code, payload, 'pending'));
20161:   gifts.outbox = gifts.outbox.slice(0, 50);
20162:   return gameState;
20163: }

20165: function addGiftToGameState(gameState, payload, code) {
20166:   const inventory = gameState?.inventory;
20167:   if (!inventory) throw new Error('在庫データを確認できません。');
20168:   const quantity = payload.type === 'metal' ? giftRoundedWeight(payload.quantity) : Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(payload.quantity) || 1));
20169:   if (payload.type === 'rough') {
20170:     if (!GEMS[payload.id]) throw new Error('原石データを確認できません。');
20171:     inventory.rough[payload.id] = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.rough?.[payload.id]) || 0)) + quantity;
20172:   } else if (payload.type === 'loose') {
20173:     if (!GEMS[payload.id] || !looseShapeIdsForGem(payload.id).includes(payload.shapeId)) throw new Error('ルースデータを確認できません。');
20174:     inventory.loose[payload.id] = inventory.loose[payload.id] || {};
20175:     inventory.loose[payload.id][payload.shapeId] = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.loose[payload.id][payload.shapeId]) || 0)) + quantity;
20176:   } else if (payload.type === 'item') {
20177:     if (!GENERAL_ITEMS[payload.id]) throw new Error('アイテムデータを確認できません。');
20178:     inventory.items[payload.id] = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.items?.[payload.id]) || 0)) + quantity;
20179:   } else if (payload.type === 'metal') {
20180:     if (!METALS[payload.id]) throw new Error('地金データを確認できません。');
20181:     const current = giftRoundedWeight(inventory.metals?.[payload.id]);
20182:     const capacity = Math.max(0.1, Number(inventory.metalCapacity?.[payload.id]) || Number(METALS[payload.id].storageLimit) || 1);
20183:     if (current + quantity > capacity + 0.0001) throw new Error(`${METALS[payload.id].shortName || METALS[payload.id].name}の保管上限を超えるため受け取れません。`);
20184:     inventory.metals[payload.id] = giftRoundedWeight(current + quantity);
20185:   } else if (payload.type === 'jewelry') {
20186:     const used = (inventory.jewelry || []).filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length;
20187:     const capacity = finishedJewelryCapacity(gameState);
20188:     if (used >= capacity) throw new Error('完成品の保管場所に空きがありません。');
20189:     const item = structuredClone(payload.itemData || {});
20190:     if (!item.item || !ITEMS[item.item]) throw new Error('完成品データを確認できません。');
20191:     item.id = `gift-${String(code).replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/gi, '').toLowerCase()}`;
20192:     item.status = 'stored';
20193:     item.receivedGiftCode = code;
20194:     item.receivedDay = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(gameState.game?.day) || 1));
20195:     delete item.displayBranchNumber;
20196:     delete item.orderId;
20197:     if ((inventory.jewelry || []).some((entry) => entry.id === item.id)) throw new Error('このプレゼントはすでに在庫へ追加されています。');
20198:     inventory.jewelry.push(item);
20199:   } else throw new Error('プレゼントの種類を確認できません。');
20200:   const gifts = ensureGiftState(gameState);
20201:   const summary = giftPayloadSummary(payload);
20202:   gifts.inbox.unshift({ code, ...summary, receivedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
20203:   gifts.inbox = gifts.inbox.slice(0, 50);
20204:   gameState.notifications = Array.isArray(gameState.notifications) ? gameState.notifications : [];
20205:   gameState.notifications.unshift({
20206:     id: `gift-${String(code).replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/gi, '').toLowerCase()}-received`,
20207:     title: 'プレゼントを受け取りました',
20208:     body: `${summary.name} ${summary.quantity}を受け取りました。`,
20209:     type: 'special',
20210:     day: Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(gameState.game?.day) || 1)),
20211:     unread: true,
20212:   });
20213:   return gameState;
20214: }

20216: function restoreGiftToGameState(gameState, payload, code) {
20217:   const inventory = gameState?.inventory;
20218:   if (!inventory) throw new Error('在庫データを確認できません。');
20219:   const quantity = payload.type === 'metal' ? giftRoundedWeight(payload.quantity) : Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(payload.quantity) || 1));
20220:   if (payload.type === 'rough') inventory.rough[payload.id] = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.rough?.[payload.id]) || 0)) + quantity;
20221:   else if (payload.type === 'loose') {
20222:     inventory.loose[payload.id] = inventory.loose[payload.id] || {};
20223:     inventory.loose[payload.id][payload.shapeId] = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.loose[payload.id][payload.shapeId]) || 0)) + quantity;
20224:   } else if (payload.type === 'item') inventory.items[payload.id] = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(inventory.items?.[payload.id]) || 0)) + quantity;
20225:   else if (payload.type === 'metal') inventory.metals[payload.id] = giftRoundedWeight(Number(inventory.metals?.[payload.id]) + quantity);
20226:   else if (payload.type === 'jewelry') {
20227:     const item = structuredClone(payload.itemData || {});
20228:     item.status = 'stored';
20229:     delete item.displayBranchNumber;
20230:     delete item.orderId;
20231:     if (!(inventory.jewelry || []).some((entry) => entry.id === item.id)) inventory.jewelry.push(item);
20232:   }
20233:   const gifts = ensureGiftState(gameState);
20234:   const entry = gifts.outbox.find((item) => item.code === code);
20235:   if (entry) entry.status = 'cancelled';
20236:   gameState.notifications = Array.isArray(gameState.notifications) ? gameState.notifications : [];
20237:   const summary = giftPayloadSummary(payload);
20238:   gameState.notifications.unshift({
20239:     id: `gift-${String(code).replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/gi, '').toLowerCase()}-cancelled`,
20240:     title: 'プレゼントを取り消しました',
20241:     body: `${summary.name} ${summary.quantity}を在庫へ戻しました。`,
20242:     type: 'info',
20243:     day: Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(gameState.game?.day) || 1)),
20244:     unread: true,
20245:   });
20246:   return gameState;
20247: }

20256: }

20260:     const code = normalizeGiftCode(entry?.code);

20262:   }).slice(0, 10);

20265: function stopGiftStatusSyncTimer() {
20266:   if (!giftStatusSyncTimer) return;
20267:   clearTimeout(giftStatusSyncTimer);
20268:   giftStatusSyncTimer = null;
20269: }
20270: 
20271: function scheduleGiftOutboxStatusSync(delay = 0, force = false) {
20272:   if (screen !== 'phone' || phoneTab !== 'gift' || !state || !currentUser || sessionTakenOver) {
20273:     stopGiftStatusSyncTimer();
20274:     return;
20275:   }
20276:   if (!pendingGiftOutboxEntries().length || giftStatusSyncTimer) return;
20277:   giftStatusSyncTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
20278:     giftStatusSyncTimer = null;
20279:     try {
20280:       await refreshGiftOutboxStatuses({ force });
20281:     } catch (error) {
20282:       console.warn('プレゼント受取状況の同期に失敗しました。', error);
20283:     }
20284:     if (screen === 'phone' && phoneTab === 'gift' && pendingGiftOutboxEntries().length) {
20285:       scheduleGiftOutboxStatusSync(GIFT_STATUS_SYNC_INTERVAL_MS, true);
20286:     }
20287:   }, Math.max(0, Number(delay) || 0));
20288: }
20289: 
20290: async function refreshGiftOutboxStatuses({ force = false } = {}) {
20291:   if (giftStatusSyncBusy || !state || !currentUser || sessionTakenOver) return false;
20292:   const pendingEntries = pendingGiftOutboxEntries();
20293:   if (!pendingEntries.length) return false;
20294:   const now = Date.now();
20295:   if (!force && now - giftStatusLastCheckedAt < 2500) return false;
20296:   giftStatusSyncBusy = true;
20297:   giftStatusLastCheckedAt = now;
20298:   let changed = false;
20299:   try {
20300:     const userId = currentUser.uid;
20301:     const results = await Promise.allSettled(pendingEntries.map(async (entry) => {
20302:       const gift = await inspectGiftCode(entry.code);
20303:       if (!gift || gift.senderUid !== userId || normalizeGiftCode(gift.code) !== normalizeGiftCode(entry.code)) return null;
20304:       const status = ['pending', 'claimed', 'cancelled'].includes(gift.status) ? gift.status : 'pending';
20305:       return {
20306:         code: normalizeGiftCode(entry.code),
20307:         status,
20308:         recipientName: String(gift.recipientName || '').slice(0, 40),
20309:         claimedAtIso: String(gift.claimedAtIso || ''),
20310:         cancelledAtIso: String(gift.cancelledAtIso || ''),
20311:       };
20312:     }));
20313:     const gifts = ensureGiftState();
20314:     const outbox = gifts.outbox;
20315:     results.forEach((result) => {
20316:       if (result.status !== 'fulfilled' || !result.value) return;
20317:       const remote = result.value;
20318:       const entryIndex = outbox.findIndex((item) => normalizeGiftCode(item?.code) === remote.code);
20319:       if (entryIndex < 0) return;
20320:       const entry = outbox[entryIndex];
20321:       if (entry.status !== 'pending' || remote.status === 'pending') return;
20322:       if (remote.status === 'claimed') {
20323:         outbox.splice(entryIndex, 1);
20324:         changed = true;
20325:         return;
20326:       }
20327:       entry.status = remote.status;
20328:       if (remote.cancelledAtIso) entry.cancelledAtIso = remote.cancelledAtIso;
20329:       changed = true;
20330:     });
20331:     const withoutPreviouslyClaimed = outbox.filter((entry) => entry?.status !== 'claimed');
20332:     if (withoutPreviouslyClaimed.length !== outbox.length) {
20333:       gifts.outbox = withoutPreviouslyClaimed;
20334:       changed = true;
20335:     }
20336:     if (changed) {
20337:       await saveGame();
20338:       if (screen === 'phone' && phoneTab === 'gift') render();
20339:     }
20340:     return changed;
20341:   } finally {
20342:     giftStatusSyncBusy = false;
20343:   }
20344: }
20345: 
20346: function renderGiftOutbox() {
20347:   const outbox = ensureGiftState().outbox.filter((entry) => entry?.status !== 'claimed').slice(0, 10);
20348:   if (!outbox.length) return '';
20349:   return `<section class="gift-history-section"><h3>発行したプレゼント</h3><div class="gift-history-list">${outbox.map((entry) => `
20350:     <article class="gift-history-row">
20351:       <div><strong>${esc(entry.name || 'プレゼント')}</strong><span>${esc(entry.quantity || '')}・${esc(entry.code || '')}</span></div>
20352:       <div class="gift-history-actions"><small class="gift-status gift-status-${esc(entry.status || 'pending')}">${esc(giftStatusLabel(entry.status))}</small>${entry.status === 'pending' ? `<button type="button" class="text-button" data-action="gift-cancel" data-code="${esc(entry.code)}" ${giftBusy ? 'disabled' : ''}>取り消す</button>` : ''}</div>
20353:     </article>`).join('')}</div></section>`;
20354: }

20431: async function createGiftFromDraft() {
20432:   if (giftBusy || !currentUser) return;
20433:   const { row } = normalizeGiftDraft();
20434:   if (!row) return showToast('渡せるプレゼントがありません。', 'error');
20435:   const quantity = giftDraft.category === 'jewelry' ? 1 : (giftDraft.category === 'metal' ? giftRoundedWeight(giftDraft.quantity) : Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(giftDraft.quantity) || 1)));
20436:   if (quantity <= 0 || quantity > row.max + 0.0001) return showToast('数量を確認してください。', 'error');
20437:   const payload = { ...structuredClone(row.payload), quantity };
20438:   giftBusy = true;
20439:   render();
20440:   try {
20441:     await saveGame();
20442:     // プレゼント発行は在庫をクラウド側でも同時に確定するため、
20443:     // 通常セーブのPromise終了だけでなく、saveMeta/currentへ今回のsaveRevisionが
20444:     // 実際に反映されたことを確認してからコード発行へ進む。
20445:     await confirmGiftCloudSave(currentUser.uid, state.saveRevision);
20446:     const result = await createGiftCode(currentUser.uid, state.playerName, payload, removeGiftFromGameState);
20447:     persistTransactionalGiftState(result.gameState);
20448:     giftLastCreated = { code: result.code, payload };
20449:     giftView = 'created';
20450:     playSfx('western-union-handover', { gain: 0.94 });
20451:     setTimeout(() => playSfx('loose-sparkle', { gain: 1.02 }), 140);
20452:     vibrate([28, 28, 58]);
20453:     render();
20454:   } catch (error) {
20455:     console.error('プレゼントコード発行エラー', error);
20456:     // 発行直前にクラウド確認を行っているため、ここでno-saveになった場合も
20457:     // 「手動保存してください」ではなく、通信／クラウド同期の再試行案内に統一する。
20458:     const displayError = error?.code === 'gift/no-save'
20459:       ? Object.assign(new Error('プレゼント発行前のクラウド保存を確認できませんでした。'), { code: 'gift/cloud-save-unavailable' })
20460:       : error;
20461:     showToast(giftErrorMessage(displayError), 'error');
20462:   } finally {
20463:     giftBusy = false;
20464:     if (screen === 'phone' && phoneTab === 'gift') render();
20465:   }
20466: }

20468: async function inspectGiftInput() {
20469:   if (giftBusy) return;
20470:   const code = normalizeGiftCode(giftCodeInput);
20471:   if (!code) return showToast('プレゼントコードを入力してください。', 'error');
20472:   giftBusy = true;
20473:   render();
20474:   try {
20475:     const gift = await inspectGiftCode(code);
20476:     if (gift.status === 'claimed') throw Object.assign(new Error('受取済み'), { code: 'gift/already-claimed' });
20477:     if (gift.status === 'cancelled') throw Object.assign(new Error('取消済み'), { code: 'gift/cancelled' });
20478:     if (gift.senderUid === currentUser?.uid) throw Object.assign(new Error('自分のコード'), { code: 'gift/self-claim' });
20479:     giftPreview = gift;
20480:     giftCodeInput = gift.code;
20481:     playSfx('select', { gain: 0.84 });
20482:   } catch (error) {
20483:     console.error('プレゼントコード確認エラー', error);
20484:     giftPreview = null;
20485:     showToast(giftErrorMessage(error), 'error');
20486:   } finally {
20487:     giftBusy = false;
20488:     render();
20489:   }
20490: }

20517: async function cancelGift(code) {
20518:   if (giftBusy || !currentUser || !code) return;
20519:   giftBusy = true;
20520:   render();
20521:   try {
20522:     await saveGame();
20523:     const result = await cancelGiftCode(currentUser.uid, code, restoreGiftToGameState);
20524:     persistTransactionalGiftState(result.gameState);
20525:     playSfx('success', { gain: 0.9 });
20526:     vibrate([30, 25, 55]);
20527:     showToast('プレゼントを取り消し、在庫へ戻しました。', 'info', false);
20528:   } catch (error) {
20529:     console.error('プレゼント取消エラー', error);
20530:     if (error?.code === 'gift/already-claimed') {
20531:       const entry = ensureGiftState().outbox.find((item) => item.code === code);
20532:       if (entry) entry.status = 'claimed';
20533:       saveGame();
20534:     }
20535:     showToast(giftErrorMessage(error), 'error');
20536:   } finally {
20537:     giftBusy = false;
20538:     render();
20539:   }
20540: }

20542: async function copyGiftCode(code) {

20545:     await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);

20551:   playSfx('success', { gain: 0.82 });

20553:   showToast('プレゼントコードをコピーしました。', 'info', false);

20655: function usePhoneItem(itemId) {
20656:   const item = GENERAL_ITEMS[itemId];
20657:   const owned = Number(state.inventory.items?.[itemId] || 0);
20658:   if (!item || !item.usable || owned <= 0) {
20659:     showToast('使用できるアイテムがありません。', 'error');
20660:     return;
20661:   }
20662:   const beforeHunger = hungerLevel();
20663:   let changed = false;
20664:   if (Number(item.effect?.hunger) > 0) {
20665:     const after = Math.min(7, beforeHunger + Number(item.effect.hunger));
20666:     if (after > beforeHunger) {
20667:       state.wellbeing.hunger = after;
20668:       changed = true;
20669:     }
20670:   }
20671:   if (!changed) {
20672:     showToast('今はこのアイテムを使う必要がありません。', 'error');
20673:     return;
20674:   }
20675:   state.inventory.items[itemId] = owned - 1;
20676:   saveGame();
20677:   playSfx(item.sfx || 'success');
20678:   if (item.id === 'energyDrink') {
20679:     window.setTimeout(() => playSfx('success', { gain: .72 }), 260);
20680:     vibrate([25, 22, 48]);
20681:   }
20682:   setPhoneItemFeedback(`${item.name}を使いました`, phoneItemEffectText(item, beforeHunger, hungerLevel()), item.symbol || '◆');
20683:   render();
20684: }

20686: function togglePhoneEquipment(equipmentId) {
20687:   const item = EQUIPMENT_ITEMS[equipmentId];
20688:   const owned = Number(state.inventory.equipment?.[equipmentId] || 0);
20689:   if (!item || owned <= 0) {
20690:     showToast('その装備品を持っていません。', 'error');
20691:     return;
20692:   }
20693:   const currentlyEquipped = state.inventory.equipped?.[item.slot] === equipmentId;
20694:   state.inventory.equipped[item.slot] = currentlyEquipped ? '' : equipmentId;
20695:   saveGame();
20696:   playSfx('success');
20697:   setPhoneItemFeedback(item.name, currentlyEquipped ? '装備を外しました。' : '装備しました。', item.symbol || '◇');
20698:   render();
20699: }

20836: function aiCurrentCapabilities() {
20837:   const remainingHours = Math.max(0, Math.floor((DAY_END_MINUTES - state.game.minutes) / 60));
20838:   const roughCount = Object.values(state.inventory.rough || {}).reduce((sum, qty) => sum + Math.max(0, Number(qty) || 0), 0);
20839:   const looseCount = looseInventoryTotal();
20840:   const metalCount = Object.values(state.inventory.metals || {}).reduce((sum, qty) => sum + Math.max(0, Number(qty) || 0), 0);
20841:   const storedCount = state.inventory.jewelry.filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length;
20842:   const activeOrders = activeOrderCount();
20843:   return {
20844:     remainingActionHoursToday: remainingHours,
20845:     canMine: hungerLevel() > 0 && availableMiningLocations().some((place) => place.hours <= remainingHours),
20846:     canPolishRoughStone: hungerLevel() > 0 && toolUsable('polishingMachine') && roughCount > 0 && remainingHours >= POLISHING_HOURS,
20847:     canCraftJewelry: hungerLevel() > 0 && toolUsable('jewelryBench') && looseCount > 0 && metalCount > 0 && storedCount < state.inventory.capacity,
20848:     canUseStore: Boolean(state.store.rented),
20849:     storeBusinessOpenNow: storeBusinessOpen(),
20850:     storeDeliveryOpenNow: storeDeliveryOpen(),
20851:     canServeCustomers: canServeCustomers(),
20852:     canAcceptOrders: canAcceptOrders(),
20853:     canAcceptAnotherOrder: canServeCustomers() && canAcceptOrders() && activeOrders < orderLimit(),
20854:       simultaneousOrderLimit: orderLimit(),
20855:     canBuyOrSellMetals: hungerLevel() > 0 && okachimachiFacilityAvailability('materialShop').open && remainingHours >= 1,
20856:     canSellRoughStones: hungerLevel() > 0 && okachimachiFacilityAvailability('looseShop').open && roughCount > 0 && remainingHours >= 1,
20857:     canBuyOrSellLooseStones: hungerLevel() > 0 && okachimachiFacilityAvailability('looseShop').open && remainingHours >= 1,
20858:     canUseJewelryShop: hungerLevel() > 0 && okachimachiFacilityAvailability('jewelryShop').open && remainingHours >= 1,
20859:     canUseDisplayShop: hungerLevel() > 0 && okachimachiFacilityAvailability('displayShop').open && remainingHours >= 1,
20860:     hungerRestricted: hungerLocked(),
20861:   };
20862: }

21006: async function copyGameDataForAI() {
21007:   const text = buildAIConsultationText();
21008:   let copied = false;
21009:   try {
21010:     if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
21011:       await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
21012:       copied = true;
21013:     }
21014:   } catch (_) {
21015:     copied = false;
21016:   }
21017:   if (!copied) copied = fallbackCopyText(text);
21018:   if (!copied) {
21019:     showToast('ゲームデータをコピーできませんでした。ブラウザのクリップボード許可を確認してください。', 'error');
21020:     return;
21021:   }
21022:   playSfx('success');
21023:   showToast('AI相談用の簡易データをコピーしました。', 'info', false);
21024: }

21057: function renderPhoneContent() {
21058:   if (phoneTab === 'profile') return renderPhoneProfile();
21059:   if (phoneTab === 'calendar') {

21062:     const year = viewDate.getFullYear();
21063:     const month = viewDate.getMonth();
21064:     const monthStart = new Date(year, month, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0);
21065:     const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0, 12, 0, 0, 0).getDate();
21066:     const leading = monthStart.getDay();
21067: 
21068:     const cells = [];
21069:     for (let index = 0; index < 42; index += 1) {
21070:       const dayOfMonth = index - leading + 1;
21071:       if (dayOfMonth < 1 || dayOfMonth > daysInMonth) {
21072:         cells.push('<div class="calendar-day outside" aria-hidden="true"></div>');
21073:         continue;

21079:       const userEvent = calendarUserEventForDate(key);

21085:       const ariaHoliday = holidayName ? `、${holidayName}` : '';
21086:       cells.push(`<button type="button" class="calendar-day ${weekdayClass} ${holidayClass} ${isToday ? 'today' : ''} ${scheduledEvents.length || holidayName ? 'has-event' : ''}" data-action="calendar-date-open" data-date="${esc(key)}" aria-label="${dayOfMonth}日${esc(ariaHoliday)}の予定を入力・編集">

21089:         ${scheduledEvents.length ? `<span class="calendar-event-dot" aria-label="予定あり"></span><small class="calendar-event-summary">${esc(scheduledEvents[0])}</small>` : (holidayName ? '' : '<small class="calendar-add-hint">予定を入力</small>')}
21090:       </button>`);
21091:     }
21092:     const todayEvents = currentCalendarEvents();

21096:         <div><h2>${year}年${month + 1}月</h2>${calendarMonthOffset !== 0 ? '<button type="button" class="calendar-current-month-button" data-action="calendar-month-current">今月へ戻る</button>' : ''}</div>

21101:       <section class="calendar-today-events">

21110:       const opensFinance = notificationOpensFinance(note);
21111:       const content = `<strong>${esc(note.title)}</strong><span>${esc(note.body)}</span><small>${esc(notificationDateLabel(note.day))}${opensFinance ? '　タップして収支を開く' : ''}</small>`;
21112:       return opensFinance

21114:         : `<article class="phone-card">${content}</article>`;
21115:     }).join('') : '<div class="phone-empty">通知はありません。</div>'}</section>`;
21116:   }

21123:     const outstanding = totalOutstandingBusinessCost();

21134:       <div class="phone-finance-list">${rows.slice().reverse().map((row) => `<article class="finance-row"><span>${financeRowDateLabel(row.day)} ${esc(row.label)}</span><strong class="${row.income ? '今月' : period === 'year' ? '今年' : '累計'}の収支記録はありません。</div>`}</div></section>`;

21151: function buildSaveDiagnosticsSnapshot() {
21152:   const snapshot = structuredClone(state || {});
21153:   // v0.10.771: 内部診断も実セーブと同じ整理後サイズを測る。実stateは変更しない。
21154:   compactLongTermHistory(snapshot);
21155:   compactFinanceHistory(snapshot);
21156:   snapshot.saveRevision = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.saveRevision) || 0)) + 1;
21157:   snapshot.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
21158:   if (snapshot.inventory && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(snapshot.inventory, 'general')) delete snapshot.inventory.general;
21159:   if (snapshot.inventory && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(snapshot.inventory, 'gems')) delete snapshot.inventory.gems;
21160:   snapshot.migrations = snapshot.migrations && typeof snapshot.migrations === 'object' && !Array.isArray(snapshot.migrations) ? snapshot.migrations : {};
21161:   snapshot.migrations.looseInventoryCanonicalV231 = true;
21162:   snapshot.saveSchemaVersion = SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION;
21163:   const raw = JSON.stringify(snapshot);
21164:   return {
21165:     bytes: new TextEncoder().encode(raw).length,
21166:     nextSaveRevision: snapshot.saveRevision,
21167:     archivedClosedOrders: Array.isArray(snapshot.history?.closedOrders) ? snapshot.history.closedOrders.length : 0,
21168:     archivedSoldJewelry: Array.isArray(snapshot.history?.soldJewelry) ? snapshot.history.soldJewelry.length : 0,
21169:   };
21170: }

21173:   return formatSaveDiagnosticCapacityLabel(projectedCount, maxCount);
21174: }

21176: async function showSaveDiagnostics() {
21177:   if (!state) return;
21178:   const local = buildSaveDiagnosticsSnapshot();
21179:   let cloud = null;
21180:   let cloudError = null;
21181:   if (currentUser?.uid) {
21182:     try {
21183:       cloud = await getCloudSaveDiagnostics(currentUser.uid);
21184:     } catch (error) {
21185:       cloudError = error;
21186:       console.warn('セーブ容量診断のクラウド管理情報を取得できませんでした。', error);
21187:     }
21188:   }
21189:   const chunkRawBytes = Math.max(1, Number(cloud?.chunkRawBytes) || (384 * 1024));
21190:   const maxCount = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(cloud?.maxCount) || 64));
21191:   const projectedCount = local.bytes ? Math.ceil(local.bytes / chunkRawBytes) : 0;
21192:   const currentCloudChunkLabel = cloud?.mode === 'chunked'
21193:     ? `${Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(cloud.count) || 0))} / ${maxCount}`
21194:     : (cloud?.mode === 'preview' ? `${Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(cloud.count) || 0))}（プレビュー）` : '—');
21195:   const currentCloudBytes = Number(cloud?.bytes) > 0 ? formatSaveDiagnosticBytes(cloud.bytes) : '—';
21196:   const cloudSourceNote = cloud?.source === 'cache' ? '直近取得済み情報' : '';
21197:   showModal({
21198:     title: 'セーブ容量診断',
21199:     body: `<p>現在のセーブ容量を読み取り専用で確認します。<strong>ゲームデータやsaveRevisionは変更しません。</strong></p>
21200:       <div class="stat-grid">
21201:         <div><small>次回JSON予測</small><strong>${formatSaveDiagnosticBytes(local.bytes)}</strong></div>
21202:         <div><small>次回チャンク予測</small><strong>${projectedCount} / ${maxCount}</strong></div>
21203:         <div><small>完了注文アーカイブ</small><strong>${local.archivedClosedOrders.toLocaleString('ja-JP')}件</strong></div>
21204:         <div><small>売却済みアーカイブ</small><strong>${local.archivedSoldJewelry.toLocaleString('ja-JP')}件</strong></div>
21205:       </div>
21206:       <p><strong>容量判定：${esc(saveDiagnosticsCapacityLabel(projectedCount, maxCount))}</strong></p>
21207:       <div class="stat-grid">
21208:         <div><small>現在クラウド容量</small><strong>${esc(currentCloudBytes)}</strong></div>
21209:         <div><small>現在クラウドチャンク</small><strong>${esc(currentCloudChunkLabel)}</strong></div>
21210:         <div><small>クラウドsaveRevision</small><strong>${cloud ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(cloud.saveRevision) || 0)).toLocaleString('ja-JP') : '—'}</strong></div>
21211:         <div><small>クラウド更新</small><strong>${esc(formatSaveDiagnosticDate(cloud?.updatedAt))}</strong></div>
21212:       </div>
21213:       ${cloudError ? '<p class="small-note">クラウド管理情報は取得できなかったため、端末上の次回保存予測だけを表示しています。</p>' : ''}
21214:       ${cloudSourceNote ? `<p class="small-note">クラウド値は${esc(cloudSourceNote)}です。</p>` : ''}
21215:       <p class="small-note">クラウドは1チャンクあたり約${formatSaveDiagnosticBytes(chunkRawBytes)}、最大${maxCount}チャンクです。診断を開くだけでは保存処理を行いません。次回保存予測のsaveRevisionは ${local.nextSaveRevision.toLocaleString('ja-JP')} です。</p>`,
21216:     confirm: '閉じる',
21217:     action: 'modal-close',
21218:     hideCancel: true,
21219:   });
21220: }

21281: function renderDayResult() {
21282:   const result = state.store.lastResult;
21283:   if (!result) return shell('1日の結果', '<p>結果がありません。</p>', { main: false });

21286:   const polished = Array.isArray(result.polished) ? result.polished : [];
21287:   const crafted = Array.isArray(result.crafted) ? result.crafted : [];
21288:   const sold = Array.isArray(result.sold) ? result.sold : [];
21289:   const roughSoldCount = (Array.isArray(result.roughSold) ? result.roughSold : []).reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (Number(entry?.qty) || 1), 0);
21290:   const looseSoldCount = (Array.isArray(result.looseSold) ? result.looseSold : []).reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (Number(entry?.qty) || 1), 0);
21291:   const activityRows = [];
21292:   if (mined.length) activityRows.push(`<div><span>採掘した原石</span><strong>${mined.map((entry) => `${GEMS[entry.gem].name}${entry.qty}個`).join('、')}</strong></div>`);
21293:   if (polished.length) activityRows.push(`<div><span>研磨したルース</span><strong>${polished.map((entry) => `${looseDisplayLabel(entry.gem, normalizeLooseShape(entry.gem, entry.looseShape))}${entry.qty}個`).join('、')}</strong></div>`);
21294:   if (crafted.length) activityRows.push(`<div><span>制作</span><strong>${crafted.length}点</strong></div>`);

21301:   const expense = Math.max(0, Number(result.expense) || 0);
21302:   const balance = income - expense;
21303:   const balancePrefix = balance > 0 ? '＋' : balance < 0 ? '－' : '';
21304:   const balanceClass = balance > 0 ? 'positive' : balance < 0 ? 'negative' : 'neutral';
21305:   const meals = Array.isArray(result.meals) ? result.meals : [];

21349: function weightedPick(entries) {
21350:   const total = entries.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.weight, 0);
21351:   let roll = Math.random() * total;
21352:   for (const entry of entries) {
21353:     roll -= entry.weight;
21354:     if (roll <= 0) return entry.id;
21355:   }
21356:   return entries.at(-1).id;
21357: }

21359: function shuffleRockIndices() {
21360:   const values = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4];
21361:   for (let i = values.length - 1; i > 0; i -= 1) {
21362:     const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
21363:     [values[i], values[j]] = [values[j], values[i]];
21364:   }
21365:   return values;
21366: }

21368: function pickRandomMiningRockImages(count = 5) {
21369:   const pool = [...MINING_ROCK_IMAGE_POOL];
21370:   for (let i = pool.length - 1; i > 0; i -= 1) {
21371:     const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
21372:     [pool[i], pool[j]] = [pool[j], pool[i]];
21373:   }
21374:   return pool.slice(0, Math.max(0, count));
21375: }

21377: function pickRandomMiningBrokenRockImage() {
21378:   if (!MINING_BROKEN_ROCK_IMAGE_POOL.length) return MINING_ROCK_IMAGE_POOL[0] || './assets/images/mining-rock.png';
21379:   const index = Math.floor(Math.random() * MINING_BROKEN_ROCK_IMAGE_POOL.length);
21380:   return MINING_BROKEN_ROCK_IMAGE_POOL[index];
21381: }

21383: function mine() {
21384:   const location = selectedMining ? miningLocationById(selectedMining) : null;
21385:   if (!location) return showToast('採掘場所を選んでください。', 'error');
21386:   if (!canSpendHours(location.hours)) return showToast('今日は採掘する時間がありません。', 'error');
21387:   if (maybeStartKappaJadeEvent()) return;
21388:   const shuffled = shuffleRockIndices();
21389:   miningGame = {
21390:     locationId: selectedMining,
21391:     hits: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
21392:     rockImages: pickRandomMiningRockImages(5),
21393:     winningRocks: shuffled.slice(0, 2),
21394:     busy: false,
21395:     resolved: false,
21396:   };
21397:   playSfx('earth-dig', { gain: .92 });
21398:   setScreen('miningGame');
21399: }

21401: function updateRockVisual(button, hits) {
21402:   for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i += 1) button.classList.remove(`hit-${i}`);
21403:   button.classList.add(`hit-${hits}`);
21404:   const remainingHits = Math.max(0, 5 - hits);
21405:   button.setAttribute('aria-label', `岩${Number(button.dataset.index) + 1}、${remainingHits ? `あと${remainingHits}回` : '壊れた'}`);
21406: }

21408: function finishMiningRock(index, button) {
21409:   if (!miningGame || miningGame.resolved) return;
21410:   miningGame.resolved = true;
21411:   button.classList.add('breaking');
21412:   root.querySelectorAll('.mining-rock').forEach((rock) => { rock.disabled = true; });
21413:   const location = miningLocationById(miningGame.locationId);
21414:   const success = miningGame.winningRocks.includes(index);
21415:   spendHours(location.hours);
21416:   let result = { missRockImage: pickRandomMiningBrokenRockImage() };
21417:   if (success) {
21418:     const availableGemPool = location.gems.filter((entry) => entry.id !== 'diamond' || toolOwned('diamondPolishingLap'));
21419:     const gem = weightedPick(availableGemPool);
21420:     state.inventory.rough[gem] += 1;
21421:     state.daily.mined.push({ gem, qty: 1 });
21422:     state.miningProgress.successfulFinds += 1;
21423:     const newlyUnlocked = unlockMiningLocationsIfNeeded();
21424:     result = { gem, qty: 1, unlockedLocation: newlyUnlocked[0]?.name || '' };
21425:   }
21426:   saveGame();
21427:   setTimeout(() => {
21428:     if (success) {
21429:       playSfx('mining-win', { gain: 1.15 });
21430:       vibrate([55, 35, 85]);
21431:     } else {
21432:       playSfx('mining-miss', { gain: 1.12 });
21433:     }
21434:     miningGame = null;
21435:     setScreen('miningResult', { result }, false);
21436:   }, 560);
21437: }

21439: function hitMiningRock(index, button) {
21440:   if (!miningGame || miningGame.resolved || miningGame.busy) return;
21441:   if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0 || index >= miningGame.hits.length) return;
21442:   miningGame.busy = true;
21443:   miningGame.hits[index] = Math.min(5, miningGame.hits[index] + 1);
21444:   const hits = miningGame.hits[index];
21445:   button.classList.remove('swinging');
21446:   void button.offsetWidth;
21447:   button.classList.add('swinging');
21448:   updateRockVisual(button, hits);
21449:   playSfx('impact', { gain: 1.12, rate: 0.92 + Math.random() * 0.16 });
21450:   vibrate([24, 12, 28]);
21451:   if (hits >= 5) {
21452:     setTimeout(() => finishMiningRock(index, button), 300);
21453:     return;
21454:   }
21455:   setTimeout(() => {
21456:     button.classList.remove('swinging');
21457:     if (miningGame) miningGame.busy = false;
21458:   }, 330);
21459: }

21461: function buyMetal(id) {
21462:   if (!metalMarketTradeReady()) return showToast('地金相場を確認できないため、現在は購入できません。', 'error');
21463:   const product = METALS[id];
21464:   if (!product) return showToast('この地金は購入できません。', 'error');
21465:   if (!canSpendHours(1)) return showToast('今日は購入手続きをする時間がありません。', 'error');
21466:   const quantity = metalTradeQuantity('buy', id);
21467:   const maximum = metalTradeMaximum('buy', id);
21468:   if (quantity < 1 || quantity > maximum) return showToast('購入する重量を▲▼で選んでください。', 'error');
21469:   const unitPrice = metalTradePricePerGram('buy', id);
21470:   const totalPrice = unitPrice * quantity;
21471:   if (state.game.money < totalPrice) return showToast('所持金が足りません。', 'error');
21472:   if (metalOwnedWeight(id) + quantity > metalStorageLimit(id) + 1e-9) return showToast('地金の保管上限を超えています。', 'error');
21473:   state.game.money -= totalPrice;
21474:   state.inventory.metals[id] = roundedMetalWeight(metalOwnedWeight(id) + quantity);
21475:   startMoneyFeedback(-totalPrice);
21476:   spendHours(1);
21477:   addFinance(`${product.name}を${quantity}g購入`, 0, totalPrice);
21478:   metalTradeDraft.buy[id] = 1;
21479:   saveGame();
21480:   showToast(`${product.name}を${quantity}g購入しました`, 'info', false);
21481:   render();
21482: }

21505: function purchase(kind, id, shapeId = '') {
21506:   if (kind === 'metal') return buyMetal(id);
21507:   const product = kind === 'loose' ? GEMS[id] : null;
21508:   if (!product) return showToast('この商品は購入できません。', 'error');
21509:   if (product.noLooseShopTrade) return showToast('このオリジナルルースはルース屋では購入できません。イベントで入手してください。', 'error');
21510:   const resolvedShape = normalizeLooseShape(id, shapeId);
21511:   const quantity = loosePurchaseQuantity(id, resolvedShape);
21512:   const unitPrice = loosePurchasePrice(id, resolvedShape);
21513:   const totalPrice = unitPrice * quantity;
21514:   const scrollSnapshot = captureLooseShopScrollState();
21515:   if (!canSpendHours(1)) return showToast('今日は購入手続きをする時間がありません。', 'error');
21516:   if (quantity < 1) return showToast('購入する数を選択してください。', 'error');
21517:   if (state.game.money < totalPrice) return showToast('所持金が足りません。', 'error');
21518:   state.game.money -= totalPrice;
21519:   startMoneyFeedback(-totalPrice);
21520:   adjustLooseInventory(id, resolvedShape, quantity);
21521:   spendHours(1);
21522:   const itemLabel = looseDisplayLabel(id, resolvedShape, { suffix: true });
21523:   addFinance(`${itemLabel}を${quantity}個購入`, 0, totalPrice);
21524:   loosePurchaseDraft[loosePurchaseDraftKey(id, resolvedShape)] = 1;
21525:   saveGame();
21526:   showToast(`${itemLabel}を${quantity}個、${yen(totalPrice)}で購入しました。`, 'info', false);
21527:   render();
21528:   restoreLooseShopScrollState(scrollSnapshot);
21529: }

21565:   const unitPrice = looseSalePrice(id, resolvedShape);

21568:   state.game.money += totalPrice;

21574:   startMoneyFeedback(totalPrice);
21575:   showToast(
21576:     qty === 1
21577:       ? `${itemLabel}を${yen(totalPrice)}で売却しました。`
21578:       : `${itemLabel}を${qty}個、${yen(totalPrice)}で売却しました。`,
21579:     'info',

21585: function buyWorkshopTool(toolId) {
21586:   const tool = WORKSHOP_TOOLS[toolId];
21587:   if (!tool || !workshopToolUnlocked(tool)) return showToast('現在は購入できません。', 'error');
21588:   if (toolOwned(toolId)) return showToast(`${tool.name}はすでに所持しています。`);
21589:   if (state.game.money < tool.price) return showToast(`${tool.name}を購入する所持金が足りません。`, 'error');
21590:   if (!canSpendHours(1)) return showToast('今日は購入手続きをする時間がありません。', 'error');
21591:   state.game.money -= tool.price;
21592:   startMoneyFeedback(-tool.price);
21593:   spendHours(1);
21594:   state.tools.items[toolId] = createWorkshopToolRecord(toolId);
21595:   syncLegacyToolFlags();
21596:   addFinance(`g-Lab.で${tool.name}を購入`, 0, tool.price);
21597:   if (toolId === 'jewelryBench') addNotification('彫金机を購入しました', '工房でジュエリーを制作できるようになりました。');
21598:   if (toolId === 'polishingMachine') addNotification('宝石研磨用平面研磨機を購入しました', '工房で原石をルースへ研磨できるようになりました。');
21599:   saveGame();
21600:   showToast(`${tool.name}を購入しました。`, 'info', false);
21601:   render();
21602: }

21604: function repairWorkshopTool(toolId) {
21605:   const tool = WORKSHOP_TOOLS[toolId];
21606:   const record = workshopToolRecord(toolId);
21607:   if (!tool?.repairable || !record || record.status !== 'unusable') return showToast('修理を依頼できる状態ではありません。', 'error');
21608:   const price = workshopToolRepairPrice(toolId);
21609:   if (state.game.money < price) return showToast('修理費が足りません。', 'error');
21610:   if (!canSpendHours(1)) return showToast('今日は修理を依頼する時間がありません。', 'error');
21611:   state.game.money -= price;
21612:   startMoneyFeedback(-price);
21613:   spendHours(1);
21614:   record.status = 'repairing';
21615:   record.repairCompleteDay = state.game.day + 7;
21616:   record.failureDueDay = null;
21617:   addFinance(`g-Lab.へ${tool.name}の修理を依頼`, 0, price);
21618:   addNotification(`${tool.name}を修理へ出しました`, `${gameDateLabel(record.repairCompleteDay)}に修理が完了する予定です。`);
21619:   saveGame();
21620:   showToast(`${tool.name}を修理へ出しました。`, 'info', false);
21621:   render();
21622: }

21627: function polishRough() {
21628:   if (!workshopOperating()) return showToast('工房は作業停止中です。', 'error');
21629:   const gem = GEMS[selectedPolishing];
21630:   selectedPolishingShape = normalizeLooseShape(selectedPolishing, selectedPolishingShape);

21632:   const completedShapeId = selectedPolishingShape;
21633:   if (!toolUsable('polishingMachine')) return showToast(toolOwned('polishingMachine') ? `宝石研磨用平面研磨機は${workshopToolStatusText('polishingMachine')}です。` : '宝石研磨用平面研磨機が必要です。', 'error');
21634:   if (selectedPolishing === 'diamond' && !toolUsable('diamondPolishingLap')) return showToast('選択した原石は研磨できません。', 'error');
21635:   if (!gem || state.inventory.rough[selectedPolishing] < 1) return showToast('選択した原石を持っていません。', 'error');
21636:   if (!canSpendHours(POLISHING_HOURS)) return showToast('今日は研磨する時間がありません。', 'error');

21666: function artisanXpForCraft(draft = {}) {
21667:   if (draft.orderId) {
21668:     const order = state.orders.find((entry) => entry.id === draft.orderId);
21669:     return { basic: 4, general: 6, complex: 8, high: 12, special: 15 }[orderDifficultyId(order || draft)] || 6;
21670:   }
21671:   return draft.design === 'simple' ? 4 : 6;

21674: function qualityProbabilities() {
21675:   const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, Math.floor(Number(state.artisan.level) || 1)));
21676:   const qualityTable = [
21677:     [1.00, 0.00, 0.00], [0.97, 0.03, 0.00], [0.94, 0.06, 0.00], [0.90, 0.10, 0.00], [0.84, 0.15, 0.01],
21678:     [0.78, 0.20, 0.02], [0.72, 0.25, 0.03], [0.66, 0.30, 0.04], [0.61, 0.34, 0.05], [0.55, 0.38, 0.07],
21679:     [0.49, 0.42, 0.09], [0.44, 0.45, 0.11], [0.38, 0.48, 0.14], [0.33, 0.50, 0.17], [0.29, 0.51, 0.20],
21680:     [0.24, 0.52, 0.24], [0.19, 0.53, 0.28], [0.14, 0.54, 0.32], [0.10, 0.54, 0.36], [0.08, 0.50, 0.42],
21681:   ];
21682:   const [standard, good, premium] = qualityTable[level - 1];
21683:   return { standard, good, premium };
21684: }
21685: 
21686: function qualityRoll() {
21687:   const probabilities = qualityProbabilities();
21688:   const roll = Math.random();
21689:   if (roll < probabilities.standard) return 'standard';
21690:   if (roll < probabilities.standard + probabilities.good) return 'good';
21691:   return 'premium';
21692: }
21693: 
21694: function expectedQuality() {
21695:   const probabilities = qualityProbabilities();
21696:   return Object.entries(probabilities).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0][0];
21697: }

21717: function craft() {
21718:   closeModal();
21719:   if (!workshopOperating()) return showToast('工房は作業停止中です。', 'error');
21720:   if (!toolUsable('jewelryBench')) return showToast('ジュエリー作成には使用可能な彫金机が必要です。', 'error');
21721:   if (!craftDraft || typeof craftDraft.useLoose !== 'boolean') return showToast('ルースを使用するか選択してください。', 'error');
21722:   const hours = productionHours(craftDraft);
21723:   if (!canSpendHours(hours)) return showToast('今日は制作する時間がありません。', 'error');
21724:   const requirements = materialRequirementsFor(craftDraft);
21725:   if (!requirements.enoughLoose || !requirements.enoughMetal) return showToast('材料が足りません。', 'error');
21726:   if (state.inventory.jewelry.filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length >= state.inventory.capacity) return showToast('完成品の保管場所に空きがありません。', 'error');
21727:   if (craftDraft.useLoose === true) adjustLooseInventory(craftDraft.gem, craftDraft.looseShape, -requirements.requiredLooseQuantity);
21728:   state.inventory.metals[craftDraft.metal] = roundedMetalWeight(requirements.ownedMetalWeight - requirements.requiredMetalWeight);
21729:   spendHours(hours);
21730:   addWorkshopActiveHours(hours);
21731:   const quality = qualityRoll();
21732:   const craftsmanship = craftProductionProfile(craftDraft);
21733:   const xp = artisanXpForCraft(craftDraft);
21734:   const jewelry = {
21735:     id: uid(),
21736:     ...craftDraft,
21737:     name: itemName(craftDraft),
21738:     quality,
21739:     cost: productionCost(craftDraft),
21740:     recommendedPrice: craftsmanshipRecommendedPrice(craftDraft, quality, craftsmanship),
21741:     ...craftsmanshipSnapshot(craftsmanship),
21742:     xp,
21743:     status: craftDraft.orderId ? 'order' : 'stored',
21744:     createdDay: state.game.day,
21745:   };
21746:   state.inventory.jewelry.push(jewelry);
21747:   state.daily.crafted.push(jewelry.id);
21748:   state.store.playerCraftedCount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.store.playerCraftedCount) || 0)) + 1;
21749:   addArtisanXp(xp);
21750:   if (craftDraft.orderId) {
21751:     const order = state.orders.find((entry) => entry.id === craftDraft.orderId);
21752:     if (order) {
21753:       order.status = '完成';
21754:       order.jewelryId = jewelry.id;
21755:       addNotification('注文品が完成しました', `${order.customerName}さんの注文品を納品できます。`);
21756:     }
21757:   }
21758:   const brokenToolName = checkWorkshopToolFailure();
21759:   completionId = jewelry.id;
21760:   craftDraft = null;
21761:   saveGame();
21762:   playSfx('jewelry-complete', { gain: 1.2 });
21763:   vibrate([45, 25, 65, 25, 100]);
21764:   setScreen('completion', { toolFailure: brokenToolName });
21765: }

21808:   item.displayBranchNumber = branch.number;
21809:   mirrorCurrentStoreDisplay(branch);

21835: function moveShowcaseItem(itemId, targetBranchNumber) {
21836:   const source = showcaseLocationForJewelry(itemId);
21837:   const targetBranch = storeBranchByNumber(targetBranchNumber);
21838:   if (!source?.slot || !targetBranch) return showToast('移動する商品または店舗が見つかりません。', 'error');
21839:   if (Number(source.branch?.number) === Number(targetBranch.number)) return showToast('すでにこの店舗へ陳列されています。', 'error');
21840:   if (!installedShowcaseCount(targetBranch)) return showToast(`${storeBranchLabel(targetBranch.number)}にショーケースがありません。`, 'error');
21841:   const target = findEmptyShowcasePosition(targetBranch);
21842:   if (!target) return showToast(`${storeBranchLabel(targetBranch.number)}のショーケースに空きがありません。`, 'error');
21843:   const savedSlot = { ...source.slot };
21844:   source.branch.showcases[source.showcaseIndex].slots[source.slotIndex] = null;
21845:   branchShowcases(targetBranch)[target.showcaseIndex].slots[target.slotIndex] = savedSlot;
21846:   const item = state.inventory.jewelry.find((entry) => entry.id === itemId);
21847:   if (item) {
21848:     item.status = 'displayed';
21849:     item.displayBranchNumber = targetBranch.number;
21850:   }
21851:   mirrorCurrentStoreDisplay(currentStoreBranch());
21852:   saveGame();
21853:   closeModal();
21854:   showToast(`${storeBranchLabel(targetBranch.number)}へ商品を移動しました。`);
21855:   render();
21856: }

21878: function removeJewelry(itemId, saleMeta = {}) {
21879:   for (const branch of state.store.branches || []) {
21880:     branch.showcases = branchShowcases(branch).map((showcase) => ({ ...showcase, slots: (showcase.slots || []).map((slot) => slot?.jewelryId === itemId ? null : slot) }));
21881:   }
21882:   const item = state.inventory.jewelry.find((entry) => entry.id === itemId);
21883:   if (item) {
21884:     item.status = 'sold';
21885:     item.removedDay = Math.max(1, Number(state.game.day) || 1);
21886:     const price = Number(saleMeta.price);
21887:     if (Number.isFinite(price)) {
21888:       item.soldDay = item.removedDay;
21889:       item.soldPrice = Math.round(price);
21890:       item.soldProfit = Math.round(price - Math.max(0, Number(item.cost) || 0));
21891:     }
21892:     if (saleMeta.branchNumber != null) item.soldBranchNumber = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(saleMeta.branchNumber) || 1));
21893:     if (saleMeta.channel) item.soldChannel = String(saleMeta.channel);
21894:     if (saleMeta.reason) item.removalReason = String(saleMeta.reason);
21895:     else if (item.stolenDay) item.removalReason = 'stolen';
21896:     delete item.displayBranchNumber;
21897:   }
21898:   mirrorCurrentStoreDisplay(currentStoreBranch());
21899: }

21901: function customerBuy(customerId, itemId) {
21902:   if (!canServeCustomers()) return showToast('現在は接客できません。', 'error');
21903:   const customer = CUSTOMERS[customerId];
21904:   const customerState = state.customers[customerId];
21905:   const item = state.inventory.jewelry.find((entry) => entry.id === itemId);
21906:   const visitBranch = storeBranchByNumber(customerState?.visitingBranchNumber || state.store.branchNumber);
21907:   if (!customer || !customerState?.visiting || !item || item.status !== 'displayed' || !showcaseSlotForJewelry(item.id, visitBranch)) return showToast('この商品は現在の店舗では提案できません。', 'error');
21908:   if (!customerState.wishesHeard) return showToast('先にお客様の希望を聞いてください。', 'error');
21909:   customerState.proposedItemIds = Array.isArray(customerState.proposedItemIds) ? customerState.proposedItemIds : [];
21910:   if (customerState.proposedItemIds.includes(itemId)) return showToast('この商品はすでに提案しています。', 'error');
21911:   if (customerState.proposedItemIds.length >= 2) return showToast('店頭商品を提案できるのは2点までです。', 'error');
21912:   const proposalMinutes = customerProposalMinutes(customerState.visitingBranchNumber);
21913:   if (!canSpendStoreMinutes(proposalMinutes)) return showToast('店舗営業時間内に接客を完了できません。', 'error');
21914:   const request = activeCustomerRequest(customerId);
21915:   const result = customerMatchResult(item, request, customerState.visitingBranchNumber);
21916:   const price = result.price;
21917:   const willBuy = Math.random() < result.chance;
21918:   customerState.proposedItemIds.push(itemId);
21919:   spendMinutes(proposalMinutes);
21920:   customerState.met = true;
21921:   customerState.lastVisitDay = state.game.day;
21922:   if (willBuy) {
21923:     customerState.visiting = false;
21924:     customerState.visitingBranchNumber = null;
21925:     customerState.activeRequest = null;
21926:     customerState.wishesHeard = false;
21927:     customerState.proposedItemIds = [];
21928:     removeJewelry(itemId, { price, branchNumber: state.store.branchNumber, channel: 'customer' });
21929:     state.game.money += price;
21930:     startMoneyFeedback(price);
21931:     state.store.salesCount += 1;
21932:     state.store.totalRevenue += price;
21933:     state.store.totalProfit += price - item.cost;
21934:     addStoreProgress({ branchNumber: state.store.branchNumber, rating: 0, sale: true, revenue: price, serviceSuccess: true });
21935:     customerState.purchases += 1;
21936:     customerState.relation = customerState.purchases >= 3 ? '常連客' : 'リピーター';
21937:     addFinance(`${customer.name}さんへ販売`, price, 0);
21938:     const saleBranch = storeBranchByNumber(state.store.branchNumber);
21939:     addNotification('商品が売れました', `${storeBranchLabel(saleBranch?.number || state.store.branchNumber)}で${item.name}が${yen(price)}で売れました。`, 'sale');
21940:     const caseUsed = consumeStoreCase(saleBranch);
21941:     const proposalMessage = state.playerName ? `<p>${esc(state.playerName)}さんのご提案を気に入っていただけました。</p>` : '';
21942:     const caseMessage = caseUsed ? `<p>ケースを1個使用しました。残り${storeCaseRemaining(saleBranch)}個です。</p>` : '<p>ケースなしで販売しました。</p>';
21943:     showModal({ title: '商品を購入していただきました。', body: `${proposalMessage}<p>${esc(item.name)}</p><p>売上：${yen(price)}</p>${caseMessage}`, confirm: '閉じる', action: 'modal-close', hideCancel: true });
21944:     saveGame();
21945:     setTimeout(() => { if (screen === 'customer') setScreen('store', { branchId: `branch-${Math.max(1, Number(state.store.branchNumber) || 1)}` }, false); }, 50);
21946:     return;
21947:   }
21948: 
21949:   const storeStillOpen = storeBusinessOpen();
21950:   const canTryAgain = storeStillOpen && customerState.visiting && customerState.proposedItemIds.length < 2;
21951:   saveGame();
21952:   render();
21953:   showModal({
21954:     title: '今回は購入されませんでした。',
21955:     body: !storeStillOpen
21956:       ? `<p>${esc(result.label)}商品でした。</p><p>19:00になったため、本日の接客は終了しました。</p>`
21957:       : canTryAgain
21958:         ? `<p>${esc(result.label)}商品でした。</p><p>別の商品をあと1点提案するか、オーダー制作で受け付けることができます。</p>`
21959:         : '<p>店頭商品を2点提案しました。オーダー制作で受け付けるか、接客を終了できます。</p>',
21960:     confirm: '閉じる', action: 'modal-close', hideCancel: true,
21961:   });
21962:   if (!storeStillOpen) setTimeout(() => { if (screen === 'customer') setScreen('store', { branchId: `branch-${Math.max(1, Number(state.store.branchNumber) || 1)}` }, false); }, 50);
21963: }

21965: function acceptOrder(customerId) {
21966:   if (!state?.store?.rented || !anyStoreBranchOperating()) return showToast('注文を受けるには営業中の店舗が必要です。', 'error');
21967:   if (!workshopOperating()) return showToast('工房が停止しているため注文を受けられません。', 'error');
21968:   if (!canServeCustomers()) return showToast('現在は接客できません。', 'error');
21969:   const customer = CUSTOMERS[customerId];
21970:   const customerState = state.customers[customerId];
21971:   if (!customer || !customerState?.visiting) return showToast('現在このお客様へ提案できません。', 'error');
21972:   if (!customerState.wishesHeard) return showToast('先にお客様の希望を聞いてください。', 'error');
21973:   const limit = orderLimit();
21974:   if (activeOrderCount() >= limit) return showToast(`同時に受けられる注文は${limit}件までです。`, 'error');
21975:   if (!canSpendStoreMinutes(30)) return showToast('店舗営業時間内に注文相談を完了できません。', 'error');

21981:   showModal({

22002: function confirmOrder(customerId) {
22003:   const customer = CUSTOMERS[customerId];
