22147: function deliverOrder(orderId, { immediateFromCompletion = false } = {}) {
22148:   const order = state.orders.find((entry) => entry.id === orderId);
22149:   const item = state.inventory.jewelry.find((entry) => entry.id === order?.jewelryId);
22150:   if (!order || !item || order.status !== '完成') return showToast('納品できる商品がありません。', 'error');
22151:   const deliveryBranch = storeBranchByNumber(order.branchNumber);
22152:   if (!immediateFromCompletion && !storeBranchOperating(deliveryBranch)) return showToast('注文を受けた店舗が休業中のため納品できません。', 'error');
22153:   if (!immediateFromCompletion && !storeDeliveryOpen()) return showToast('注文品を納品できるのは9:00～19:00です。', 'error');
22154:   if (state.game.day > Number(order.deadlineDay)) {
22155:     expireOrder(order);
22156:     saveGame();
22157:     render();
22158:     return showToast('納期を過ぎたため納品できません。', 'error');
22159:   }
22160:   order.status = '完了';
22161:   order.closedDay = state.game.day;
22162:   order.deliveredDay = state.game.day;
22163:   item.status = 'sold';
22164:   item.removedDay = state.game.day;
22165:   item.soldDay = state.game.day;
22166:   item.soldPrice = Math.round(Number(order.price) || 0);
22167:   item.soldProfit = Math.round((Number(order.price) || 0) - Math.max(0, Number(item.cost) || 0));
22168:   item.soldBranchNumber = Math.max(1, Number(order.branchNumber) || 1);
22169:   item.soldChannel = 'order';
22170:   state.game.money += order.price;
22171:   startMoneyFeedback(order.price);
22172:   state.store.salesCount += 1;
22173:   state.store.totalRevenue += order.price;
22174:   state.store.totalProfit += order.price - item.cost;
22175:   state.store.deliveredOrderCount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.store.deliveredOrderCount) || 0)) + 1;
22176:   addStoreProgress({ branchNumber: order.branchNumber, rating: 1, orderDelivery: true });
22177:   const customerState = state.customers[order.customerId];
22178:   if (customerState) {
22179:     customerState.purchases += 1;
22180:     customerState.relation = customerState.purchases >= 3 ? '常連客' : 'リピーター';
22181:   }
22182:   addFinance(`${order.customerName}さんへ注文品を納品`, order.price, 0);
22183:   const caseUsed = consumeStoreCase(deliveryBranch);
22184:   saveGame();
22185:   if (immediateFromCompletion) {
22186:     completionId = null;
22187:     setScreen('orders', {}, false);
22188:   }
22189:   showModal({
22190:     title: 'ありがとうございました！',
22191:     body: `<p>${esc(item.name)}をお客様へ納品しました。</p><p><strong>売上：${yen(order.price)}</strong></p><p>所持金が${yen(order.price)}増えました。</p><p>現在の所持金：${yen(state.game.money)}</p>${caseUsed ? `<p>ケースを1個使用しました。残り${storeCaseRemaining(deliveryBranch)}個です。</p>` : '<p>ケースなしで納品しました。</p>'}`,
22192:     confirm: '閉じる',
22193:     action: 'modal-close',
22194:     hideCancel: true,
22195:   });
22196:   render();
22197: }

22304: function buyDisplayProduct(productId) {
22305:   const product = DISPLAY_SHOP_PRODUCTS[productId];
22306:   if (!product) return;
22307:   const availability = okachimachiFacilityAvailability('displayShop');
22308:   if (!availability.open) return showToast(availability.reason, 'error');
22309:   const quantity = productId === 'case' ? displayCasePurchaseQuantity() : 1;
22310:   if (quantity < 1) return showToast('購入する数量を選択してください。', 'error');
22311:   if (product.purchaseLimit) {
22312:     const owned = Math.max(0, Number(state.store.displayInventory?.[productId]) || 0);
22313:     const installed = productId === 'case' ? storeCaseRemaining(currentStoreBranch()) : 0;
22314:     if (owned + installed + quantity > Number(product.purchaseLimit)) return showToast(`${product.name}は現在、未設置分と設置中を合わせて${product.purchaseLimit}個まで保有できます。`, 'error');
22315:   }
22316:   const totalPrice = product.price * quantity;
22317:   if (state.game.money < totalPrice) return showToast('購入費が足りません。', 'error');
22318:   if (!canSpendHours(1)) return showToast('今日は購入手続きをする時間がありません。', 'error');
22319:   state.game.money -= totalPrice;
22320:   startMoneyFeedback(-totalPrice);
22321:   spendHours(1);
22322:   state.store.displayInventory[productId] = Math.max(0, Number(state.store.displayInventory[productId]) || 0) + quantity;
22323:   addFinance(`${product.name}を${quantity}個購入`, 0, totalPrice);
22324:   if (productId === 'case') displayCasePurchaseDraft = 1;
22325:   saveGame();
22326:   showToast(`${product.name}を${quantity}個購入しました。`);
22327:   render();
22328: }

22330: function captureStoreShowcaseReturnPosition(showcaseIndex) {
22331:   if (screen !== 'store') return null;
22332:   const scroller = root.querySelector('.screen-content');
22333:   if (!(scroller instanceof HTMLElement)) return null;
22334:   const normalizedIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(showcaseIndex) || 0));
22335:   const anchor = scroller.querySelector(`[data-showcase-index="${normalizedIndex}"]`);
22336:   const pageScroller = document.scrollingElement;
22337:   return {
22338:     branchId: currentStoreBranch()?.id || screenData.branchId || '',
22339:     showcaseIndex: normalizedIndex,
22340:     top: scroller.scrollTop,
22341:     left: scroller.scrollLeft,
22342:     pageTop: pageScroller?.scrollTop || 0,
22343:     pageLeft: pageScroller?.scrollLeft || 0,
22344:     anchorViewportTop: anchor instanceof HTMLElement ? anchor.getBoundingClientRect().top : null,
22345:   };
22346: }
22347: 
22348: function restoreStoreShowcaseReturnPosition(snapshot) {
22349:   if (!snapshot) return;
22350:   const token = ++storeScrollRestoreToken;
22351:   const restore = () => {
22352:     if (token !== storeScrollRestoreToken || screen !== 'store') return;
22353:     if (snapshot.branchId && screenData.branchId && snapshot.branchId !== screenData.branchId) return;
22354:     const scroller = root.querySelector('.screen-content');
22355:     if (!(scroller instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
22356:     const showcaseIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(snapshot.showcaseIndex) || 0));
22357:     const anchor = scroller.querySelector(`[data-showcase-index="${showcaseIndex}"]`);
22358:     if (anchor instanceof HTMLElement && Number.isFinite(Number(snapshot.anchorViewportTop))) {
22359:       const difference = anchor.getBoundingClientRect().top - Number(snapshot.anchorViewportTop);
22360:       scroller.scrollTop = Math.max(0, scroller.scrollTop + difference);
22361:     } else if (Number.isFinite(Number(snapshot.top))) {
22362:       scroller.scrollTop = Math.max(0, Number(snapshot.top) || 0);
22363:     } else if (anchor instanceof HTMLElement) {
22364:       const scrollerTop = scroller.getBoundingClientRect().top;
22365:       scroller.scrollTop = Math.max(0, scroller.scrollTop + anchor.getBoundingClientRect().top - scrollerTop - 12);
22366:     }
22367:     scroller.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, Number(snapshot.left) || 0);
22368:     const pageScroller = document.scrollingElement;
22369:     if (pageScroller && Number.isFinite(Number(snapshot.pageTop))) {
22370:       pageScroller.scrollTop = Math.max(0, Number(snapshot.pageTop) || 0);
22371:       pageScroller.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, Number(snapshot.pageLeft) || 0);
22372:     }
22373:   };
22374:   restore();
22375:   queueMicrotask(restore);
22376:   requestAnimationFrame(() => {
22377:     restore();
22378:     requestAnimationFrame(restore);
22379:   });
22380:   [45, 120, 260].forEach((delay) => setTimeout(restore, delay));
22381: }
22382: 
22383: function captureStoreScrollSnapshot() {
22384:   if (screen !== 'store') return null;
22385:   const scroller = root.querySelector('.screen-content');
22386:   if (!(scroller instanceof HTMLElement)) return null;
22387:   const anchor = scroller.querySelector('.storefront-equipment-section');
22388:   return {
22389:     top: scroller.scrollTop,
22390:     left: scroller.scrollLeft,
22391:     anchorViewportTop: anchor instanceof HTMLElement ? anchor.getBoundingClientRect().top : null,
22392:   };
22393: }
22394: 
22395: function restoreStoreScrollSnapshot(snapshot) {
22396:   if (!snapshot) return;
22397:   const token = ++storeScrollRestoreToken;
22398:   const restore = () => {
22399:     if (token !== storeScrollRestoreToken || screen !== 'store') return;
22400:     const scroller = root.querySelector('.screen-content');
22401:     if (!(scroller instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
22402:     const anchor = scroller.querySelector('.storefront-equipment-section');
22403:     if (anchor instanceof HTMLElement && Number.isFinite(Number(snapshot.anchorViewportTop))) {
22404:       const difference = anchor.getBoundingClientRect().top - Number(snapshot.anchorViewportTop);
22405:       scroller.scrollTop = Math.max(0, scroller.scrollTop + difference);
22406:     } else {
22407:       scroller.scrollTop = Math.max(0, Number(snapshot.top) || 0);
22408:     }
22409:     scroller.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, Number(snapshot.left) || 0);
22410:   };
22411:   queueMicrotask(restore);
22412:   requestAnimationFrame(() => {
22413:     restore();
22414:     requestAnimationFrame(restore);
22415:   });
22416:   [45, 120, 260].forEach((delay) => setTimeout(restore, delay));
22417: }

22419: function installDisplayProduct(productId) {
22420:   const storeScrollSnapshot = captureStoreScrollSnapshot();
22421:   if (!state.store.rented) return showToast('店舗を契約してから設置できます。', 'error');
22422:   const product = DISPLAY_SHOP_PRODUCTS[productId];
22423:   const owned = Math.max(0, Number(state.store.displayInventory?.[productId]) || 0);
22424:   const branch = currentStoreBranch();
22425:   const installQuantity = productId === 'case' ? displayCaseInstallQuantity(branch) : 1;
22426:   if (!product || owned <= 0) return showToast('設置できる商品を所持していません。', 'error');
22427:   if (productId === 'case' && installQuantity < 1) return showToast('設置するケース数を選択してください。', 'error');
22428:   if (productId === 'showcase') {
22429:     if (installedShowcaseCount(branch) >= storeMaximumShowcases(branch)) return showToast(`この店舗にはショーケースを${storeMaximumShowcases(branch)}台まで設置できます。`, 'error');
22430:     branchShowcases(branch).push({ id: `showcase-${Date.now()}-${installedShowcaseCount(branch) + 1}`, slots: [null, null, null, null, null] });
22431:     branch.showcaseCount = installedShowcaseCount(branch);
22432:     mirrorCurrentStoreDisplay(branch);
22433:     syncFinishedJewelryCapacity();
22434:   } else if (productId === 'displaySupplies') {
22435:     const maximum = storeMaximumDisplaySupplies(branch);
22436:     if (maximum < 1) return showToast('先にショーケースを設置してください。', 'error');
22437:     if (storeDisplaySuppliesInstalled(branch) >= maximum) return showToast(`ディスプレイ用品はショーケースの台数と同じ${maximum}点まで設置できます。`, 'error');
22438:     if (branch) branch.displaySuppliesInstalled = storeDisplaySuppliesInstalled(branch) + 1;
22439:     state.store.displaySuppliesInstalled = storeDisplaySuppliesInstalled(branch);
22440:   } else if (productId === 'case') {
22441:     const maximum = displayCaseInstallMaximum(branch);
22442:     if (maximum < 1) return showToast(`この店舗にはケースを${storeMaximumCases()}個まで設置できます。`, 'error');
22443:     if (installQuantity > maximum) return showToast(`設置できるケースは最大${maximum}個です。`, 'error');
22444:     if (branch) branch.casesInstalled = storeCaseRemaining(branch) + installQuantity;
22445:     state.store.casesInstalled = storeCaseRemaining(branch);
22446:   }
22447:   state.store.displayInventory[productId] = owned - installQuantity;
22448:   mirrorCurrentStoreDisplay(branch);
22449:   syncStoreLevel(branch);
22450:   saveGame();
22451:   if (productId === 'case') displayCaseInstallDraft = 1;
22452:   showToast(productId === 'case'
22453:     ? `${product.name}を${installQuantity}個、店舗へ設置しました。`
22454:     : productId === 'showcase'
22455:       ? `${product.name}を店舗へ設置しました。完成品の保管上限は${state.inventory.capacity}個です。`
22456:       : `${product.name}を店舗へ設置しました。`);
22457:   render();
22458:   restoreStoreScrollSnapshot(storeScrollSnapshot);
22459: }

22497: function monthIndex(date) {

22502:   const previous = new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth() - 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0);
22503:   return `${previous.getFullYear()}-${String(previous.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

22506: function automaticPaymentCapacity() {
22507:   const money = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.game.money) || 0));
22508:   return Math.max(0, money - MIN_LIVING_CASH_RESERVE);
22509: }

22511: function payFixedCost(label, amount, onUnpaid) {
22512:   const due = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(amount) || 0));
22513:   if (!due) return { paid: 0, unpaid: 0 };
22514:   const paid = Math.min(automaticPaymentCapacity(), due);
22515:   state.game.money -= paid;
22516:   if (paid) addFinance(label, 0, paid);
22517:   const unpaid = due - paid;
22518:   if (unpaid) onUnpaid(unpaid);
22519:   return { paid, unpaid };
22520: }
22521: 
22522: function processMonthlyFixedCosts() {
22523:   const today = gameDate();
22524:   if (today.getDate() !== 1) return null;
22525:   const targetKey = previousMonthKey(today);
22526:   if (state.business.lastProcessedMonth === targetKey) return null;
22527: 
22528:   const start = parseGameStartDate();
22529:   const targetDate = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth() - 1, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0);
22530:   const report = { month: targetKey, workshop: 0, rents: [], paid: 0, unpaid: 0 };
22531: 
22532:   if (monthIndex(targetDate) - monthIndex(start) >= 2) {
22533:     report.workshop = WORKSHOP_MONTHLY_COST;
22534:     const result = payFixedCost(`${targetKey} 工房維持費`, WORKSHOP_MONTHLY_COST, (unpaid) => {
22535:       state.business.workshopUnpaid += unpaid;
22536:       state.business.workshopSuspended = true;
22537:     });
22538:     report.paid += result.paid;
22539:     report.unpaid += result.unpaid;
22540:   }
22541: 
22542:   for (const branch of [...(state.store.branches || [])].sort((a, b) => Number(a.number) - Number(b.number))) {
22543:     const contractDate = gameDateForDay(branch.rentedDay || 1);
22544:     if (monthIndex(targetDate) - monthIndex(contractDate) < 1) continue;
22545:     const rent = storeMonthlyRent(Number(branch.number));
22546:     const result = payFixedCost(`${targetKey} ${storeBranchLabel(branch.number)}家賃`, rent, (unpaid) => {
22547:       branch.unpaidRent = Math.max(0, Number(branch.unpaidRent) || 0) + unpaid;
22548:       branch.suspended = true;
22549:     });
22550:     report.rents.push({ branchNumber: Number(branch.number), amount: rent, paid: result.paid, unpaid: result.unpaid });
22551:     report.paid += result.paid;
22552:     report.unpaid += result.unpaid;
22553:   }
22554: 
22555:   state.business.lastProcessedMonth = targetKey;
22556:   state.business.monthlyReports.push(report);
22557:   state.business.monthlyReports = state.business.monthlyReports.slice(-24);
22558:   const summary = report.unpaid
22559:     ? `${targetKey}分の固定費を処理しました。生活費${yen(MIN_LIVING_CASH_RESERVE)}を残し、未払いは${yen(report.unpaid)}です。`
22560:     : `${targetKey}分の固定費 ${yen(report.paid)}を支払いました。`;
22561:   addNotification('月初の固定費', summary, report.unpaid ? 'warning' : 'info');
22562:   const paymentMessages = [];
22563:   if (report.workshop) {
22564:     paymentMessages.push(report.unpaid && state.business.workshopUnpaid
22565:       ? `工房維持費 ${yen(report.workshop)}の支払い後、未払い残高は${yen(state.business.workshopUnpaid)}です。`
22566:       : `工房維持費 ${yen(report.workshop)}を支払いました。`);
22567:   }
22568:   if (report.rents.length) {
22569:     const rentTotal = report.rents.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.amount, 0);
22570:     const rentUnpaid = report.rents.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.unpaid, 0);
22571:     paymentMessages.push(rentUnpaid
22572:       ? `店舗家賃 ${yen(rentTotal)}のうち${yen(rentTotal - rentUnpaid)}を支払い、${yen(rentUnpaid)}が未払いです。`
22573:       : `店舗家賃 ${yen(rentTotal)}を支払いました。`);
22574:   }
22575:   state.tools.morningMessages = [...(state.tools.morningMessages || []), ...paymentMessages].slice(-10);
22576:   return report;
22577: }

22612: function outstandingPaymentTargets() {
22613:   const branches = contractedStoreBranches();
22614:   const currentNumber = Math.max(1, Number(state?.store?.branchNumber) || 1);
22615:   const orderedBranches = [...branches].sort((left, right) => {
22616:     const leftCurrent = Number(left.number) === currentNumber ? 0 : 1;
22617:     const rightCurrent = Number(right.number) === currentNumber ? 0 : 1;
22618:     return leftCurrent - rightCurrent || Number(left.number) - Number(right.number);
22619:   });
22620:   const targets = [];
22621:   const workshopDue = Math.max(0, Number(state.business?.workshopUnpaid) || 0);
22622:   if (workshopDue) targets.push({ kind: 'workshop', id: '', label: '工房維持費', due: workshopDue });
22623:   for (const branch of orderedBranches) {
22624:     const due = Math.max(0, Number(branch.unpaidRent) || 0);
22625:     if (due) targets.push({ kind: 'store-rent', id: branch.id, label: `${storeBranchDisplayName(branch)} 家賃`, due });
22626:   }
22627:   for (const branch of orderedBranches) {
22628:     const employee = storeBranchEmployee(branch);
22629:     const due = Math.max(0, Number(employee.wageUnpaid) || 0);
22630:     if (due) targets.push({ kind: 'store-wage', id: branch.id, label: `${storeBranchDisplayName(branch)} ${employee.name}さんの給与`, due });
22631:   }
22632:   const workshopStaff = workshopStaffState();
22633:   const workshopWageDue = Math.max(0, Number(workshopStaff.wageUnpaid) || 0);
22634:   if (workshopWageDue) targets.push({ kind: 'workshop-wage', id: '', label: '職人スタッフの給与', due: workshopWageDue });
22635:   const homeDue = Math.max(0, Number(state.business?.homeRentUnpaid) || 0);
22636:   if (homeDue) targets.push({ kind: 'home', id: '', label: '自宅家賃', due: homeDue });
22637:   return targets;
22638: }

22640: function totalOutstandingBusinessCost() {
22641:   return outstandingPaymentTargets().reduce((sum, target) => sum + target.due, 0);
22642: }
22643: 
22644: function outstandingPaymentTarget(kind, id = '') {
22645:   return outstandingPaymentTargets().find((target) => target.kind === String(kind || '') && String(target.id || '') === String(id || '')) || null;
22646: }
22647: 
22648: function applyOutstandingPayment(target, requestedAmount, prefix = '') {
22649:   if (!target) return 0;
22650:   const amount = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.floor(Number(requestedAmount) || 0), Math.floor(Number(target.due) || 0)));
22651:   if (!amount) return 0;
22652:   if (target.kind === 'home') {
22653:     state.business.homeRentUnpaid = Math.max(0, Number(state.business.homeRentUnpaid) || 0) - amount;
22654:   } else if (target.kind === 'workshop') {
22655:     state.business.workshopUnpaid = Math.max(0, Number(state.business.workshopUnpaid) || 0) - amount;
22656:     if (state.business.workshopUnpaid <= 0) {
22657:       state.business.workshopUnpaid = 0;
22658:       state.business.workshopSuspended = false;
22659:     }
22660:   } else if (target.kind === 'store-rent') {
22661:     const branch = (state.store.branches || []).find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(target.id));
22662:     if (!branch) return 0;
22663:     branch.unpaidRent = Math.max(0, Number(branch.unpaidRent) || 0) - amount;
22664:     if (branch.unpaidRent <= 0) {
22665:       branch.unpaidRent = 0;
22666:       branch.suspended = false;
22667:     }
22668:   } else if (target.kind === 'store-wage') {
22669:     const branch = (state.store.branches || []).find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(target.id));
22670:     if (!branch) return 0;
22671:     const employee = storeBranchEmployee(branch);
22672:     employee.wageUnpaid = Math.max(0, Number(employee.wageUnpaid) || 0) - amount;
22673:     if (employee.wageUnpaid <= 0) employee.wageUnpaid = 0;
22674:   } else if (target.kind === 'workshop-wage') {
22675:     const staff = workshopStaffState();
22676:     staff.wageUnpaid = Math.max(0, Number(staff.wageUnpaid) || 0) - amount;
22677:     if (staff.wageUnpaid <= 0) staff.wageUnpaid = 0;
22678:   } else return 0;
22679:   addFinance(`${prefix}${target.label}を支払い`, 0, amount);
22680:   return amount;
22681: }
22682: 
22683: function payOutstandingBusinessCostItem(kind, id = '') {
22684:   const target = outstandingPaymentTarget(kind, id);
22685:   if (!target) return showToast('この未払いはすでに解消されています。');
22686:   const available = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.game.money) || 0));
22687:   if (!available) return showToast('支払いに使える所持金がありません。', 'error');
22688:   const paid = applyOutstandingPayment(target, Math.min(available, target.due));
22689:   state.game.money = Math.max(0, available - paid);
22690:   if (paid) startMoneyFeedback(-paid);
22691:   saveGame();
22692:   const remaining = outstandingPaymentTarget(kind, id)?.due || 0;
22693:   showToast(remaining ? `${yen(paid)}を支払いました。残り${yen(remaining)}です。` : `${target.label}を完済しました。`, 'info', false);
22694:   render();
22695: }
22696: 
22697: function payOutstandingBusinessCosts() {
22698:   const total = totalOutstandingBusinessCost();
22699:   if (!total) return showToast('未払いはありません。');
22700:   const money = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.game.money) || 0));
22701:   let available = Math.max(0, money - MIN_LIVING_CASH_RESERVE);
22702:   if (!available) return showToast(`一括支払いでは生活費${yen(MIN_LIVING_CASH_RESERVE)}を残します。個別支払いを利用してください。`, 'error');
22703:   let paidTotal = 0;
22704:   for (const target of outstandingPaymentTargets()) {
22705:     if (!available) break;
22706:     const paid = applyOutstandingPayment(target, Math.min(available, target.due));
22707:     available -= paid;
22708:     paidTotal += paid;
22709:   }
22710:   state.game.money = Math.max(0, money - paidTotal);
22711:   if (paidTotal) startMoneyFeedback(-paidTotal);
22712:   saveGame();
22713:   const remaining = totalOutstandingBusinessCost();
22714:   showToast(remaining ? `${yen(paidTotal)}を優先順で支払いました。未払い残高は${yen(remaining)}です。` : '未払いをすべて支払いました。', 'info', false);
22715:   render();
22716: }

22734: function tokyoRealDateKey(date = new Date()) {
22735:   const parts = Object.fromEntries(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
22736:     timeZone: 'Asia/Tokyo', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit',
22737:   }).formatToParts(date).filter((part) => part.type !== 'literal').map((part) => [part.type, part.value]));
22738:   return `${parts.year}-${parts.month}-${parts.day}`;
22739: }
22740: 
22741: function autopilotDateValue(key) {
22742:   const match = String(key || '').match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
22743:   if (!match) return null;
22744:   return Date.UTC(Number(match[1]), Number(match[2]) - 1, Number(match[3]));
22745: }
22746: 
22747: function autopilotDateDifference(fromKey, toKey) {
22748:   const from = autopilotDateValue(fromKey);
22749:   const to = autopilotDateValue(toKey);
22750:   if (from == null || to == null) return 0;
22751:   return Math.max(0, Math.floor((to - from) / 86400000));
22752: }
22753: 
22754: function addAutopilotDateDays(key, days = 1) {
22755:   const value = autopilotDateValue(key);
22756:   if (value == null) return tokyoRealDateKey();
22757:   const date = new Date(value + Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(days) || 0)) * 86400000);
22758:   return `${date.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(date.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(date.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
22759: }

22761: function ensureAutopilotState() {
22762:   if (!state) return null;
22763:   const saved = state.autopilot && typeof state.autopilot === 'object' && !Array.isArray(state.autopilot)
22764:     ? state.autopilot
22765:     : {};
22766:   state.autopilot = {
22767:     lastRealDate: /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(saved.lastRealDate || '')) ? String(saved.lastRealDate) : '',
22768:     lastRunAt: typeof saved.lastRunAt === 'string' ? saved.lastRunAt : '',
22769:     totalDays: Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.totalDays) || 0)),
22770:     lastSummary: saved.lastSummary && typeof saved.lastSummary === 'object' && !Array.isArray(saved.lastSummary)
22771:       ? saved.lastSummary
22772:       : null,
22773:   };
22774:   return state.autopilot;
22775: }

22804: function mergeAutopilotSummary(target, source) {
22805:   for (const key of ['minedActions', 'roughFound', 'roughSold', 'polished', 'crafted', 'displayed', 'sold', 'ordersCompleted', 'toolsPurchased', 'repairsRequested', 'meals', 'income', 'expense']) {
22806:     target[key] = Math.max(0, Number(target[key]) || 0) + Math.max(0, Number(source[key]) || 0);
22807:   }
22808:   target.notes.push(...(source.notes || []));
22809:   target.notes = [...new Set(target.notes)].slice(-12);
22810:   return target;

22813: function autopilotEat(summary) {
22814:   if (hungerLevel() > 0) return true;
22815:   const meal = MEALS.chinese;
22816:   if (!meal || state.game.money < meal.price || !canSpendMealTime()) return false;
22817:   const before = hungerLevel();
22818:   state.game.money -= meal.price;
22819:   spendMealTime();
22820:   state.wellbeing.hunger = Math.min(state.wellbeing.maxHunger || 7, hungerLevel() + meal.recovery);
22821:   state.wellbeing.lastMeal = meal.name;
22822:   state.wellbeing.mealsEaten = Math.max(0, Number(state.wellbeing.mealsEaten) || 0) + 1;
22823:   state.daily.meals.push({ id: meal.id, name: meal.name, price: meal.price, recovery: state.wellbeing.hunger - before, autopilot: true });
22824:   addFinance(`自動操縦：${meal.name}で食事`, 0, meal.price);
22825:   summary.meals += 1;
22826:   summary.expense += meal.price;
22827:   return true;
22828: }

22830: function autopilotCanSpendHours(hours, summary) {
22831:   const actionMinutes = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(hours) || 0) * 60);
22832:   if (hungerLevel() > 0) return canSpendMinutes(actionMinutes);
22833:   if (!canSpendMinutes(MEAL_DURATION_MINUTES + actionMinutes)) return false;
22834:   return autopilotEat(summary);
22835: }

22837: function autopilotPayOutstandingCosts(summary) {
22838:   const money = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.game.money) || 0));
22839:   let available = Math.max(0, money - MIN_LIVING_CASH_RESERVE);
22840:   if (!available) return;
22841:   let paidTotal = 0;
22842:   for (const target of outstandingPaymentTargets()) {
22843:     if (!available) break;
22844:     const paid = applyOutstandingPayment(target, Math.min(available, target.due), '自動操縦：');
22845:     available -= paid;
22846:     paidTotal += paid;
22847:     summary.expense += paid;
22848:   }
22849:   state.game.money = Math.max(0, money - paidTotal);
22850: }

22852: function autopilotBuyTool(toolId, summary, reserve = 2000) {
22853:   const tool = WORKSHOP_TOOLS[toolId];
22854:   if (!tool || toolOwned(toolId) || !workshopToolUnlocked(tool)) return false;
22855:   if (!okachimachiFacilityAvailability('glab').open) return false;
22856:   if (state.game.money < tool.price + reserve || !autopilotCanSpendHours(1, summary)) return false;
22857:   state.game.money -= tool.price;
22858:   spendHours(1);
22859:   state.tools.items[toolId] = createWorkshopToolRecord(toolId);
22860:   syncLegacyToolFlags();
22861:   addFinance(`自動操縦：g-Lab.で${tool.name}を購入`, 0, tool.price);
22862:   addNotification(`${tool.name}を自動購入しました`, '自動操縦モードが、今後の作業に必要な設備として購入しました。');
22863:   summary.toolsPurchased += 1;
22864:   summary.expense += tool.price;
22865:   summary.notes.push(`${tool.name}を購入`);
22866:   return true;
22867: }

22869: function autopilotRepairTools(summary) {
22870:   for (const [toolId, record] of Object.entries(state.tools?.items || {})) {
22871:     const tool = WORKSHOP_TOOLS[toolId];
22872:     if (!tool?.repairable || !record || record.status !== 'unusable') continue;
22873:     const price = workshopToolRepairPrice(toolId);
22874:     if (!okachimachiFacilityAvailability('glab').open || state.game.money < price || !autopilotCanSpendHours(1, summary)) continue;
22875:     state.game.money -= price;
22876:     spendHours(1);
22877:     record.status = 'repairing';
22878:     record.repairCompleteDay = state.game.day + 7;
22879:     record.failureDueDay = null;

22881:     addNotification(`${tool.name}を自動で修理へ出しました`, `${gameDateLabel(record.repairCompleteDay)}に修理が完了する予定です。`);
22882:     summary.repairsRequested += 1;
22883:     summary.expense += price;
22884:   }

22887: function autopilotBuyMetal(metalId, targetWeight, summary) {
22888:   if (!metalMarketTradeReady()) return false;
22889:   const target = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(Number(targetWeight) || 0));
22890:   const owned = metalOwnedWeight(metalId);
22891:   if (owned + 1e-9 >= target) return true;
22892:   if (!okachimachiFacilityAvailability('materialShop').open || !autopilotCanSpendHours(1, summary)) return false;
22893:   const quantity = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(target - owned));
22894:   if (owned + quantity > metalStorageLimit(metalId) + 1e-9) return false;
22895:   const unitPrice = metalTradePricePerGram('buy', metalId);
22896:   const price = unitPrice * quantity;
22897:   if (state.game.money < price) return false;
22898:   state.game.money -= price;
22899:   state.inventory.metals[metalId] = roundedMetalWeight(owned + quantity);
22900:   spendHours(1);
22901:   addFinance(`自動操縦：${METALS[metalId].name}を${quantity}g購入`, 0, price);
22902:   summary.expense += price;
22903:   return true;
22904: }

22906: function autopilotBuyLoose(gemId, shapeId, targetQuantity, summary) {
22907:   const shape = normalizeLooseShape(gemId, shapeId);
22908:   let owned = looseAvailableQuantity(gemId, shape);
22909:   const target = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(targetQuantity) || 0));
22910:   while (owned < target) {
22911:     if (!okachimachiFacilityAvailability('looseShop').open || !autopilotCanSpendHours(1, summary)) return false;
22912:     const price = loosePurchasePrice(gemId, shape);
22913:     if (state.game.money < price) return false;
22914:     state.game.money -= price;
22915:     adjustLooseInventory(gemId, shape, 1);
22916:     spendHours(1);
22917:     addFinance(`自動操縦：${looseDisplayLabel(gemId, shape, { suffix: true })}を購入`, 0, price);
22918:     summary.expense += price;
22919:     owned += 1;
22920:   }
22921:   return true;
22922: }

22924: function autopilotCraftJewelry(draft, summary) {
22925:   if (!workshopOperating() || !toolUsable('jewelryBench')) return null;
22926:   const hours = productionHours(draft);
22927:   if (!autopilotCanSpendHours(hours, summary)) return null;
22928:   const requirements = materialRequirementsFor(draft);
22929:   if (!requirements.enoughLoose || !requirements.enoughMetal) return null;
22930:   if (state.inventory.jewelry.filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length >= state.inventory.capacity) return null;
22931:   if (draft.useLoose !== false) adjustLooseInventory(draft.gem, draft.looseShape, -requirements.requiredLooseQuantity);
22932:   state.inventory.metals[draft.metal] = roundedMetalWeight(requirements.ownedMetalWeight - requirements.requiredMetalWeight);
22933:   spendHours(hours);
22934:   const quality = qualityRoll();
22935:   const craftsmanship = craftProductionProfile(draft);
22936:   const jewelry = {
22937:     id: uid(),
22938:     ...draft,
22939:     name: itemName(draft),
22940:     quality,
22941:     cost: productionCost(draft),
22942:     recommendedPrice: craftsmanshipRecommendedPrice(draft, quality, craftsmanship),
22943:     ...craftsmanshipSnapshot(craftsmanship),
22944:     xp: 5,
22945:     status: draft.orderId ? 'order' : 'stored',
22946:     createdDay: state.game.day,
22947:     autopilot: true,
22948:   };
22949:   state.inventory.jewelry.push(jewelry);
22950:   state.daily.crafted.push(jewelry.id);
22951:   // 自動操縦による制作ではプレイヤーの職人経験値は増えない。
22952:   if (draft.orderId) {
22953:     const order = state.orders.find((entry) => entry.id === draft.orderId);
22954:     if (order) {
22955:       order.status = '完成';
22956:       order.jewelryId = jewelry.id;
22957:       addNotification('注文品が自動制作されました', `${order.customerName}さんの注文品を納品できます。`);
22958:     }
22959:   }
22960:   const brokenToolName = checkWorkshopToolFailure();
22961:   if (brokenToolName) addNotification(`${brokenToolName}が故障しました`, '自動操縦中の作業後に故障しました。次回以降、修理可能なら自動で修理へ出します。', 'warning');
22962:   summary.crafted += 1;
22963:   return jewelry;
22964: }

22966: function autopilotDeliverCompletedOrders(summary) {
22967:   const completed = state.orders
22968:     .filter((order) => order.status === '完成')
22969:     .sort((a, b) => Number(a.deadlineDay) - Number(b.deadlineDay));
22970:   for (const order of completed) {
22971:     const item = state.inventory.jewelry.find((entry) => entry.id === order.jewelryId);
22972:     const branch = storeBranchByNumber(order.branchNumber);
22973:     if (!item || !storeBranchOperating(branch) || state.game.day > Number(order.deadlineDay)) continue;
22974:     order.status = '完了';
22975:     order.closedDay = state.game.day;
22976:     order.deliveredDay = state.game.day;
22977:     item.status = 'sold';
22978:     item.removedDay = state.game.day;
22979:     item.soldDay = state.game.day;
22980:     item.soldPrice = Math.round(Number(order.price) || 0);
22981:     item.soldProfit = Math.round((Number(order.price) || 0) - Math.max(0, Number(item.cost) || 0));
22982:     item.soldBranchNumber = Math.max(1, Number(order.branchNumber) || 1);
22983:     item.soldChannel = 'order-autopilot';
22984:     state.game.money += order.price;
22985:     state.store.salesCount += 1;
22986:     state.store.totalRevenue += order.price;
22987:     state.store.totalProfit += order.price - item.cost;
22988:     state.store.deliveredOrderCount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(state.store.deliveredOrderCount) || 0)) + 1;
22989:     addStoreProgress({ branchNumber: order.branchNumber, rating: 1, orderDelivery: true });
22990:     const customerState = state.customers[order.customerId];
22991:     if (customerState) {
22992:       customerState.purchases += 1;
22993:       customerState.relation = customerState.purchases >= 3 ? '常連客' : 'リピーター';
22994:     }
22995:     addFinance(`自動操縦：${order.customerName}さんへ注文品を納品`, order.price, 0);
22996:     consumeStoreCase(branch);
22997:     summary.ordersCompleted += 1;
22998:     summary.sold += 1;
22999:     summary.income += order.price;
23000:   }
23001: }

23003: function autopilotFulfillOrders(summary) {
23004:   autopilotDeliverCompletedOrders(summary);
23005:   const pending = state.orders
23006:     .filter((order) => order.status === '受注')
23007:     .sort((a, b) => Number(a.deadlineDay) - Number(b.deadlineDay));
23008:   for (const order of pending) {
23009:     const feasibility = orderFeasibility(order);
23010:     if (!feasibility.artisanReady || !feasibility.materialsObtainable) continue;
23011:     for (const toolId of feasibility.requiredTools) autopilotBuyTool(toolId, summary, 2000);
23012:     if (!feasibility.requiredTools.every((toolId) => toolUsable(toolId))) continue;
23013:     let requirements = orderRequirements(order);
23014:     if (!requirements.enoughMetal) {
23015:       autopilotBuyMetal(order.metal, metalOwnedWeight(order.metal) + requirements.missingMetalWeight, summary);
23016:     }
23017:     requirements = orderRequirements(order);
23018:     if (!requirements.enoughLoose) {
23019:       autopilotBuyLoose(order.gem, order.looseShape, looseAvailableQuantity(order.gem, order.looseShape) + requirements.missingLooseQuantity, summary);
23020:     }
23021:     requirements = orderRequirements(order);
23022:     if (!requirements.enoughMetal || !requirements.enoughLoose) continue;
23023:     const draft = {
23024:       orderId: order.id,
23025:       item: order.item,
23026:       useLoose: true,
23027:       gem: order.gem,
23028:       looseShape: normalizeLooseShape(order.gem, order.looseShape),
23029:       metal: order.metal,
23030:       design: order.design,
23031:       finish: 'mirror',
23032:     };
23033:     if (!autopilotCraftJewelry(draft, summary)) continue;
23034:     autopilotDeliverCompletedOrders(summary);
23035:   }
23036: }

23038: function autopilotPrepareStore(summary) {
23039:   if (!state.store.rented) return;
23040:   const branch = salesStoreBranch() || currentStoreBranch();
23041:   if (!branch || !storeBranchOperating(branch)) return;
23042:   if (installedShowcaseCount(branch) === 0 && okachimachiFacilityAvailability('displayShop').open) {
23043:     const product = DISPLAY_SHOP_PRODUCTS.showcase;
23044:     if (state.game.money >= product.price + 10000 && autopilotCanSpendHours(1, summary)) {
23045:       state.game.money -= product.price;
23046:       spendHours(1);
23047:       branchShowcases(branch).push({ id: `showcase-auto-${Date.now()}-${state.game.day}`, slots: [null, null, null, null, null] });
23048:       branch.showcaseCount = installedShowcaseCount(branch);
23049:       mirrorCurrentStoreDisplay(branch);
23050:       syncFinishedJewelryCapacity();
23051:       addFinance('自動操縦：ショーケースを購入・設置', 0, product.price);
23052:       summary.expense += product.price;
23053:       summary.notes.push('ショーケースを設置');
23054:     }
23055:   }
23056:   if (installedShowcaseCount(branch) > 0 && storeCaseRemaining(branch) === 0 && okachimachiFacilityAvailability('displayShop').open) {
23057:     const quantity = 10;
23058:     const price = DISPLAY_SHOP_PRODUCTS.case.price * quantity;
23059:     if (state.game.money >= price + 2000 && autopilotCanSpendHours(1, summary)) {
23060:       state.game.money -= price;
23061:       spendHours(1);
23062:       branch.casesInstalled = Math.min(storeMaximumCases(), storeCaseRemaining(branch) + quantity);
23063:       state.store.casesInstalled = storeCaseRemaining(branch);
23064:       syncStoreLevel(branch);
23065:       addFinance(`自動操縦：ケースを${quantity}個購入・設置`, 0, price);
23066:       summary.expense += price;
23067:     }
23068:   }
23069: }

23089: function autopilotWholesaleStoredItems(summary) {

23132: function autopilotMineOnce(summary) {
23133:   const available = availableMiningLocations().filter((location) => canSpendHours(location.hours));
23134:   if (!available.length) return false;
23135:   const location = available.sort((a, b) => {
23136:     const expectedA = a.gems.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + roughSalePrice(entry.id) * entry.weight, 0) / 100 / a.hours;
23137:     const expectedB = b.gems.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + roughSalePrice(entry.id) * entry.weight, 0) / 100 / b.hours;
23138:     return expectedB - expectedA;
23139:   })[0];
23140:   if (!autopilotCanSpendHours(location.hours, summary)) return false;
23141:   spendHours(location.hours);
23142:   summary.minedActions += 1;
23143:   if (Math.random() < 0.4) {
23144:     const availableGemPool = location.gems.filter((entry) => entry.id !== 'diamond' || toolOwned('diamondPolishingLap'));
23145:     const gem = weightedPick(availableGemPool);
23146:     state.inventory.rough[gem] = Math.max(0, Number(state.inventory.rough[gem]) || 0) + 1;
23147:     state.daily.mined.push({ gem, qty: 1, autopilot: true });
23148:     state.miningProgress.successfulFinds += 1;
23149:     unlockMiningLocationsIfNeeded();
23150:     summary.roughFound += 1;
23151:   } else {
23152:     state.miningMisses = Math.max(0, Number(state.miningMisses) || 0) + 1;
23153:   }
23154:   return true;
23155: }

23159:   if (state.inventory.jewelry.filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length >= state.inventory.capacity) return false;

23166:     metal: 'silver',

23178: function runAutopilotDay() {
23179:   const summary = createAutopilotDaySummary();
23180:   state.game.minutes = Math.max(DAY_START_MINUTES, Math.min(DAY_END_MINUTES, Number(state.game.minutes) || DAY_START_MINUTES));
23181:   autopilotPayOutstandingCosts(summary);
23182:   autopilotDeliverCompletedOrders(summary);
23183:   autopilotRepairTools(summary);
23184:   if (!toolOwned('jewelryBench')) autopilotBuyTool('jewelryBench', summary, 2000);
23185:   autopilotFulfillOrders(summary);
23186:   autopilotPrepareStore(summary);
23187:   autopilotDisplayStoredItems(summary);
23188:   autopilotWholesaleStoredItems(summary);
23189:   autopilotSellRough(summary);
23190: 
23191:   let safety = 0;
23192:   while (safety < 12 && canSpendHours(1)) {
23193:     safety += 1;
23194:     const beforeMinutes = state.game.minutes;
23195:     const beforeMoney = state.game.money;
23196:     const beforeJewelry = state.inventory.jewelry.filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length;
23197: 
23198:     autopilotFulfillOrders(summary);
23199:     autopilotPrepareStore(summary);
23200:     autopilotDisplayStoredItems(summary);
23201:     if (autopilotWholesaleStoredItems(summary)) continue;
23202:     if (autopilotCraftStock(summary)) {
23203:       autopilotDisplayStoredItems(summary);
23204:       continue;
23205:     }
23206:     if (autopilotSellRough(summary)) continue;
23207:     if (autopilotMineOnce(summary)) {
23208:       if (state.game.minutes < OKACHIMACHI_CLOSE_MINUTES) autopilotSellRough(summary);
23209:       continue;
23210:     }
23211: 
23212:     const afterJewelry = state.inventory.jewelry.filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length;
23213:     if (state.game.minutes === beforeMinutes && state.game.money === beforeMoney && afterJewelry === beforeJewelry) break;
23214:   }
23215: 
23216:   autopilotDisplayStoredItems(summary);
23217:   autopilotWholesaleStoredItems(summary);
23218:   summary.income = Math.max(summary.income, Math.max(0, Number(state.daily.income) || 0));
23219:   summary.expense = Math.max(summary.expense, Math.max(0, Number(state.daily.expense) || 0));
23220:   return summary;
23221: }

23223: function autopilotSummaryBody(days, aggregate) {
23224:   const parts = [];
23225:   if (aggregate.minedActions) parts.push(`採掘${aggregate.minedActions}回`);
23226:   if (aggregate.roughFound) parts.push(`原石${aggregate.roughFound}個発見`);
23227:   if (aggregate.crafted) parts.push(`制作${aggregate.crafted}点`);
23228:   if (aggregate.displayed) parts.push(`陳列${aggregate.displayed}点`);
23229:   if (aggregate.sold) parts.push(`販売・納品${aggregate.sold}点`);
23230:   if (aggregate.income) parts.push(`売上${yen(aggregate.income)}`);
23231:   if (aggregate.expense) parts.push(`支出${yen(aggregate.expense)}`);
23232:   return `${days}日分を進めました。${parts.length ? parts.join('、') + '。' : '大きな取引はありませんでした。'}現在の所持金は${yen(state.game.money)}です。`;
23233: }

23235: async function processAutopilotIfDue({ renderAfter = true, showNotice = true } = {}) {
23236:   if (!state?.settings?.autopilotEnabled || autopilotRunning || sleepTransitioning || sessionTakenOver || illnessEventSuppressionActive()) return 0;

23245:   }

23248:

23250:   const aggregate = createAutopilotDaySummary();

23303: function settleDay({ showResult = true, save = true, hospitalCheck = false } = {}) {
23304:   const looseBeforeSettlement = looseInventorySnapshot();

23306:   const sold = [];

23491: function scheduleCustomerVisit() {
23492:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) {
23493:     clearCustomerVisitsForIllness();

23495:   }
23496:   if (pearlHumanEffectActive()) {
23497:     schedulePearlHumanGuaranteedCustomer({ preserveExistingToday: false });

23517:   const hasMetCustomer = normalCustomerIds.some((id) => Boolean(state.customers[id]?.met));

23615: function maybeStartForcedBirthdayRest() {
23616:   if (!birthdaySleepAvailableToday()) return false;
23617:   const eventState = birthdaySleepEventState();
23618:   if (!eventState.restPending && hungerLevel() > 1) return false;
23619:   eventState.restPending = true;
23620:   eventState.triggerReason = 'energy';
23621:   if (birthdayForcedRestBlocked()) return false;
23622:   return maybeStartBirthdaySleepEvent({ triggerReason: 'energy' });
23623: }

23625: function maybeStartBirthdaySleepEvent({ triggerReason = 'manual' } = {}) {
23626:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) {
23627:     suppressBirthdaySleepEventForIllness({ save: true });
23628:     return false;
23629:   }
23630:   const today = gameDate();
23631:   if (!birthdayMatchesDate(today)) return false;
23632:   const year = today.getFullYear();
23633:   const eventState = birthdaySleepEventState();
23634:   if (eventState.active) {
23635:     setScreen('birthdaySleepEvent', {}, false);
23636:     return true;
23637:   }
23638:   if (eventState.lastCompletedYear === year) return false;
23639:   eventState.active = true;
23640:   eventState.stage = 'phone';
23641:   eventState.eventYear = year;
23642:   eventState.restPending = false;
23643:   eventState.triggerReason = triggerReason === 'energy' ? 'energy' : 'manual';
23644:   saveGame();
23645:   setScreen('birthdaySleepEvent', {}, false);
23646:   playSfx('alarm', { gain: 0.52, rate: 0.92 });
23647:   vibrate([28, 80, 28, 80, 42]);
23648:   return true;
23649: }

23669: function advanceBirthdaySleepEvent() {
23670:   if (repairIllnessBirthdayDeadlock({ save: true })) {
23671:     setScreen('main', {}, false);
23672:     queueMicrotask(showNormalSleepConfirmation);
23673:     return;
23674:   }
23675:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) {
23676:     suppressBirthdaySleepEventForIllness({ save: true });
23677:     setScreen('main', {}, false);
23678:     queueMicrotask(showNormalSleepConfirmation);
23679:     return;
23680:   }
23681:   const eventState = birthdaySleepEventState();
23682:   if (!eventState.active) {
23683:     goMain();
23684:     return;
23685:   }
23686:   if (eventState.stage === 'phone') eventState.stage = 'greeting';
23687:   else if (eventState.stage === 'greeting') eventState.stage = 'congratulations';
23688:   else if (eventState.stage === 'congratulations') eventState.stage = 'thanks';
23689:   else if (eventState.stage === 'thanks') {
23690:     eventState.active = false;
23691:     eventState.stage = 'completed';
23692:     eventState.lastCompletedYear = eventState.eventYear || gameDate().getFullYear();
23693:     eventState.restPending = false;
23694:     saveGame();
23695:     setScreen('main', {}, false);
23696:     // v0.10.552: 誕生日イベントは一日の締めとして、そのまま就寝して翌日へ進む。
23697:     queueMicrotask(() => beginSleepTransition({ allowEarly: true }));
23698:     return;
23699:   }
23700:   saveGame();
23701:   playSfx('select', { gain: 0.46 });
23702:   render();
23703: }

23705: function confirmSleep() {
23706:   // v0.10.552: 誕生日当日に「寝る」を選んだ場合は、時刻より先に誕生日イベントを開始する。
23707:   if (!isAlienAbducted() && !illnessEventSuppressionActive() && birthdaySleepAvailableToday()) {
23708:     if (maybeStartBirthdaySleepEvent({ triggerReason: 'manual' })) return;
23709:   }
23710:   if (!canSleepNow()) {
23711:     showToast(sleepRestrictionMessage(), 'error');
23712:     return;
23713:   }
23714:   // 宇宙滞在中は既に宇宙人イベントが進行中のため、誕生日・怪異など別の就寝イベントを重ねない。
23715:   // 空腹度0で19時前の場合は専用確認から必ず翌日処理へ進める。
23716:   if (isAlienAbducted()) {
23717:     if (alienHungerEmergency()) showAlienHungerSleepConfirmation();
23718:     else showNormalSleepConfirmation();
23719:     return;
23720:   }
23721:   if (illnessEventSuppressionActive()) {
23722:     suppressBirthdaySleepEventForIllness({ save: true });
23723:     showNormalSleepConfirmation();
23724:     return;
23725:   }
23726:   if (maybeStartHauntingEvent()) return;
23727:   showNormalSleepConfirmation();
23728: }

23742: async function beginSleepTransition({ allowEarly = false } = {}) {
23743:   if (sleepTransitioning) return;
23744:   if (!allowEarly && !canSleepNow()) {
23745:     closeModal();
23746:     showToast(sleepRestrictionMessage(), 'error');
23747:     return;
23748:   }
23749:   sleepTransitioning = true;
23750:   closeModal();
23751: 
23752:   // v0.10.552: 通信や音声準備を待つ前に暗転を開始し、操作が受け付けられたことを即座に示す。
23753:   sleepCurtainEl?.classList.add('active', 'sleep-starting');
23754:   await new Promise((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve)));
23755: 
23756:   const stateBeforeSleep = structuredClone(state);
23757:   markNightTransitionCheckpoint();
23758:   // v0.10.611: 就寝前は復旧用の端末チェックポイントだけを保存する。
23759:   // 同じ遷移で直後に行う日次確定保存とクラウド書き込みを重複させない。
23760:   flushAutosaveLocally('sleep-checkpoint');
23761: 
23762:   try {
23763:     // 音声の読み込みが遅い端末でも、最大700msで翌日処理へ進む。
23764:     await Promise.race([
23765:       Promise.resolve(switchAudio(isAlienAbducted() ? 'space' : 'sleep'))
23766:         .catch((error) => console.error('就寝音声切り替えエラー', error)),
23767:       wait(700),
23768:     ]);
23769: 
23770:     const daySave = settleDay({ hospitalCheck: true });
23771:     await Promise.race([daySave, wait(1800)]);
23772:     await wait(420);
23773:     sleepCurtainEl?.classList.remove('sleep-starting');
23774:     sleepCurtainEl?.classList.remove('active');
23775:     await wait(120);
23776:     if (pendingDayMoneyDelta) {
23777:       startMoneyFeedback(pendingDayMoneyDelta, 1200);
23778:       pendingDayMoneyDelta = 0;
23779:       render();
23780:     }
23781:     await wait(580);
23782:   } catch (error) {
23783:     console.error('翌日処理エラー', error);
23784:     state = stateBeforeSleep;
23785:     screen = 'main';
23786:     screenData = {};
23787:     navigation = [];
23788:     pendingDayMoneyDelta = 0;
23789:     saveGame();
23790:     render();
23791:     try { showToast('翌日の処理を中断し、暗転前の状態へ戻しました。', 'error'); } catch (_) {}
23792:   } finally {
23793:     sleepCurtainEl?.classList.remove('active', 'sleep-starting');
23794:     sleepTransitioning = false;
23795:   }
23796: }

25263: // v0.10.891: 起動中のクラウド確認が応答待ちのままでも、正常な端末セーブを使って継続できるようにする。
25264: // Firebase自体は無効化せず、起動時の補助的なクラウド待機だけに上限時間を設ける。
25265: const STARTUP_CLOUD_TIMEOUT_MS = 4000;
25266: 
25267: function startupCloudTimeoutError(label) {
25268:   const error = new Error(`${label}が${Math.round(STARTUP_CLOUD_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000)}秒以内に完了しませんでした。端末保存を優先して継続します。`);
25269:   error.code = 'jxj/startup-cloud-timeout';
25270:   return error;
25271: }
25272: 
25273: function withStartupCloudTimeout(promise, label, timeoutMs = STARTUP_CLOUD_TIMEOUT_MS) {
25274:   let timerId = null;
25275:   const waitMs = Math.max(1, Number(timeoutMs) || STARTUP_CLOUD_TIMEOUT_MS);
25276:   const timeout = new Promise((_, reject) => {
25277:     timerId = window.setTimeout(() => reject(startupCloudTimeoutError(label)), waitMs);
25278:   });
25279:   return Promise.race([Promise.resolve(promise), timeout]).finally(() => {
25280:     if (timerId !== null) window.clearTimeout(timerId);
25281:   });
25282: }

25317:         render();
25318:         return;
25319:       }
25320:       // Keep the already-visible title shell while the signed-in save is checked.
25321:       // No loading-screen swap is needed here; the disabled start button is the gate.
25322:       screen = 'title';
25323:       render();
25324:       try {
25325:         // v0.10.826: セッション取得完了前に保存処理へ進むと、Safari/PWA/別タブが
25326:         // 同時に自分を所有者だと判断できるため、取得結果を確認してから監視を開始する。
25327:         try {

25342:           sessionClaimed = false;

=== FULL FUNCTION updateShowcaseDetailPricePreview L19075-L19098 ===

19076: function updateShowcaseDetailPricePreview(price, savedPrice, item) {
19077:   if (screen !== 'showcaseDetail' || !item) return false;
19078:   const panel = root.querySelector('.showcase-detail-panel');
19079:   if (!panel) return false;
19080:   const normalizedPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(price, item.recommendedPrice || savedPrice || 1000);
19081:   const normalizedSavedPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(savedPrice, item.recommendedPrice || normalizedPrice);
19082:   const priceStatus = sellingPriceStatus(item, normalizedPrice);
19083:   const expectedProfit = normalizedPrice - Math.max(0, Number(item.cost) || 0);
19084:   const priceValue = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-value]');
19085:   const expectedProfitValue = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-expected-profit]');
19086:   const priceStatusValue = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-status]');
19087:   const confirmButton = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-confirm]');
19088:   const downButton = panel.querySelector('[data-showcase-price-down]');
19089:   if (priceValue) priceValue.textContent = yen(normalizedPrice);
19090:   if (expectedProfitValue) expectedProfitValue.textContent = yen(expectedProfit);
19091:   if (priceStatusValue) {
19092:     priceStatusValue.textContent = priceStatus.name;
19093:     priceStatusValue.className = `price-status ${priceStatus.id}`;
19094:   }
19095:   if (confirmButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) confirmButton.disabled = normalizedPrice === normalizedSavedPrice;
19096:   if (downButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) downButton.disabled = normalizedPrice <= 1000;
19097:   return Boolean(priceValue && expectedProfitValue && priceStatusValue && confirmButton && downButton);
19098: }

=== FULL FUNCTION adjustShowcaseSellingPrice L19099-L19122 ===

19100: function adjustShowcaseSellingPrice(button) {
19101:   if (!button || button.disabled || screen !== 'showcaseDetail') return false;
19102:   const branch = button.dataset.branch
19103:     ? state.store.branches?.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.branch)
19104:     : currentStoreBranch();
19105:   const showcaseIndex = Number(button.dataset.showcase);
19106:   const slotIndex = Number(button.dataset.slot);
19107:   const slot = branchShowcases(branch)?.[showcaseIndex]?.slots?.[slotIndex];
19108:   if (!slot) return false;
19109:   const item = state.inventory.jewelry.find((entry) => entry.id === slot.jewelryId);
19110:   if (!item) return false;
19111:   const savedPrice = showcaseSellingPrice(slot, item);
19112:   const currentPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(
19113:     Number.isFinite(Number(screenData.pendingSellingPrice)) ? screenData.pendingSellingPrice : savedPrice,
19114:     item.recommendedPrice || savedPrice
19115:   );
19116:   const delta = Number(button.dataset.delta) < 0 ? -1000 : 1000;
19117:   const nextPrice = Math.max(1000, currentPrice + delta);
19118:   if (nextPrice === currentPrice) return false;
19119:   screenData.pendingSellingPrice = normalizeSellingPrice(nextPrice, item.recommendedPrice || 1000);
19120:   if (!updateShowcaseDetailPricePreview(screenData.pendingSellingPrice, savedPrice, item)) render();

20836: function aiCurrentCapabilities() {

20839:   const looseCount = looseInventoryTotal();
20840:   const metalCount = Object.values(state.inventory.metals || {}).reduce((sum, qty) => sum + Math.max(0, Number(qty) || 0), 0);
20841:   const storedCount = state.inventory.jewelry.filter((item) => item.status !== 'sold').length;
20842:   const activeOrders = activeOrderCount();
20843:   return {
20844:     remainingActionHoursToday: remainingHours,
20845:     canMine: hungerLevel() > 0 && availableMiningLocations().some((place) => place.hours <= remainingHours),
20846:     canPolishRoughStone: hungerLevel() > 0 && toolUsable('polishingMachine') && roughCount > 0 && remainingHours >= POLISHING_HOURS,
20847:     canCraftJewelry: hungerLevel() > 0 && toolUsable('jewelryBench') && looseCount > 0 && metalCount > 0 && storedCount < state.inventory.capacity,
20848:     canUseStore: Boolean(state.store.rented),
20849:     storeBusinessOpenNow: storeBusinessOpen(),
20850:     storeDeliveryOpenNow: storeDeliveryOpen(),
20851:     canServeCustomers: canServeCustomers(),
20852:     canAcceptOrders: canAcceptOrders(),
20853:     canAcceptAnotherOrder: canServeCustomers() && canAcceptOrders() && activeOrders < orderLimit(),
20854:       simultaneousOrderLimit: orderLimit(),
20855:     canBuyOrSellMetals: hungerLevel() > 0 && okachimachiFacilityAvailability('materialShop').open && remainingHours >= 1,
20856:     canSellRoughStones: hungerLevel() > 0 && okachimachiFacilityAvailability('looseShop').open && roughCount > 0 && remainingHours >= 1,
20857:     canBuyOrSellLooseStones: hungerLevel() > 0 && okachimachiFacilityAvailability('looseShop').open && remainingHours >= 1,
20858:     canUseJewelryShop: hungerLevel() > 0 && okachimachiFacilityAvailability('jewelryShop').open && remainingHours >= 1,
20859:     canUseDisplayShop: hungerLevel() > 0 && okachimachiFacilityAvailability('displayShop').open && remainingHours >= 1,

23384:     }

23390:     }
23391:     staffEffects.push({

23393:       name: employee.name,
23394:       level: afterDefinition.level,
23395:       levelLabel: afterDefinition.label,
23396:       workDays: employee.workDays,
23397:       wage: salary,

23399:       unpaidWage: wageResult.unpaid,
23400:       leveledUp,
23401:     });
23402:   }
23403: 
23404:   const workshopStaffResult = settleWorkshopStaffDay();
23405:   for (const branch of contractedStoreBranches()) {

23407:     branch.visitorsToday = 0;
23408:   }
